jobs.title: AI Algorithmic Trader — Interview Today, Start Tomorrow!
jobs.description: AI Algorithmic Trader — MemeLabs, Inc. MemeLabs, Inc., a new startup division of MemeHouse LA, is hiring a systematic trader\-researcher to answer one question: can an AI learn to trade and improve itself, or does it only look like it is learning? You will design the strategies, the tests and the learning loop, on the world's largest DEXs. PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE ABLE TO START RIGHT AWAY **This role starts immediately.** The 45\- and 90\-day milestones run from your first day, so we can only consider candidates who are available to begin now. If you need a notice period or a later start date, please do not apply for this opening. Job details **Company** MemeLabs, Inc. (a startup division of MemeHouse LA) **Location** Beverly Hills, CA — in person and remote **Employment type** Full\-time, part\-time, W\-2 employee, or contract **Annual base salary** $120,000–$280,000 **Additional compensation** $5,000 performance\-based signing incentive, earned through two initial\-delivery milestones targeted for the first 90 days About us MemeHouse LA is launching a startup division, MemeLabs, Inc., where we build AI software that turns information into useful decisions and reliable workflows. Our focus is practical: secure AI deployments, connected systems, and applications that deliver measurable value. One of those applications is a systematic crypto trading program on the world's largest decentralized exchanges, across BTC, ETH, SOL and other major markets. An AI agent writes the backtests, bots, analysis and hourly market reads; it keeps a memory of what it tried and grades its own past predictions. So far the evidence says the AI is not yet learning, which is why this role exists: * A grid fitted to our in\-house AI market model's levels made **\+0\.43%/day** on the data it was tuned on and **0\.25%/day** on the next eight weeks. * The model's trade setups, tested on 1,497 trades, matched **random entries with the same stops and targets** almost to the basis point. We want someone who finds these results interesting, not discouraging. About the role As our AI Algorithmic Trader, you are the human in the loop between an AI that can build a trading bot in an hour and a market that punishes anything untested. You will design systematic strategies, build the evaluation that decides which ones are real, and engineer the loop that lets the AI learn from every result. This is a hands\-on role with ownership of meaningful deliverables. You will explain trade\-offs to non\-traders, document decisions, and help establish repeatable practices as the team grows. What you will do * **Design strategies:** Create systematic strategies with clear entry, exit, sizing and kill rules, and turn each into a testable hypothesis. * **Build the self\-improvement loop:** Decide what the AI remembers, how it grades its own calls, which changes it may make alone and which need a human; then prove with numbers whether it improves. * **Evaluate quality:** Build repeatable backtests with realistic fills, fees and slippage, walk\-forward splits, held\-out data, and a control for every result (random entries, random levels, a plain grid). * **Grade the AI market model:** Score its levels, setups and stated odds against simple baselines, and decide what, if anything, should drive bots. * **Run paper and live bots:** Move survivors to paper beside a control, then small live size; monitor, scale or retire them. * **Operate dependable systems:** Exchange\-side stops, software loss limits, a 90%\-of\-equity deploy cap, observability, versioning and rollback for every bot. * **Protect sensitive information:** Least\-privilege keys, secrets management, dry\-run\-first transfer scripts, and safeguards against prompt injection into the AI's tools. * **Improve the function:** Review code, document decisions in shared memory, and help mentor additional researchers as the team expands. Strategies you'll build and test **Family** Examples we run or have tested **Grid and ladder** Static and dynamic grids, re\-centring ping\-pong ladders, staggered take\-profits across many small orders **Mean reversion** Buying support and fading resistance from model\-picked levels, VWAP and range fades **Breakout and momentum** Close\-above / close\-below triggers, trailing take\-profits, trend\-gated entries **Accumulation** DCA and TWAP drips with price gates and breakeven stops **Signal\-driven** On\-chain flows, funding, open interest, liquidation clusters, stablecoin dominance, TradingView alerts **Regime switching** Hourly on/off switchboards, volatility and chop filters, scheduled\-event kill switches The interesting work is not any single strategy. It is building the process that tells the AI which ideas work, why, and what to try next. What we are looking for * **Systematic strategy experience:** 3\+ years designing, building and running your own systematic trading strategies, with live results you can walk us through, across several types (grid, mean reversio nels, secrets managers (1Password, Vault) How we work * **Evidence decides.** A result counts only out\-of\-sample, after fees, against a control. * **Tune on one period, judge on the next.** In\-sample winners are a hypothesis, not a strategy. * **Paper before live, small before large.** A new bot earns size over weeks, not hours. * **The AI builds; a human gates money.** Agents research, code and test. Launching, sizing and moving funds stay with people. * **Ask the exchange, don't model it.** Verify every stop is live and every fill is real. * **Write it down.** Every test, result and mistake goes into shared memory so it is never repeated. Your first 90 days * **First 30 days:** Learn the strategy library, bots, AI memory files and risk controls; audit which backtest and live numbers you trust and why; set up your environment and evaluation approach. * **Target by day 45 (milestone one):** A shared test harness with controls built in (random entries, random levels, plain grid), plus a scorecard that tracks whether the AI's ideas and market calls are improving, with reproducible setup and first results. * **Target by day 90 (milestone two):** At least one strategy that beats its control on unseen data and in paper trading, running live at small size with monitoring, kill switches and a launch\-and\-rollback runbook, and a written first answer on whether the AI is improving. Compensation and $5,000 signing incentive The annual base salary range is $120,000–$280,000\. The starting offer will reflect the responsibilities of the position, demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and internal pay equity; the $5,000 incentive is separate from base salary. We offer a $5,000 gross performance\-based signing incentive, structured as a new\-hire milestone bonus rather than an upfront payment: * **Milestone one: $2,500\.** Earned on completion of the agreed test harness, AI scorecard and initial results, targeted for day 45\. * **Milestone two: $2,500\.** Earned on completion of the agreed validated strategy, live monitoring, runbook and written AI\-improvement assessment, targeted for day 90\. Written milestone requirements and objective acceptance criteria will be provided before employment begins. Each installment is earned when its criteria are satisfied and will be paid on the next regular payday, or earlier if required by applicable law, less required tax withholdings. The 45\- and 90\-day dates are delivery targets, not minimum\-service or automatic\-forfeiture dates. Once earned, an installment is not conditioned on continued employment through its payment date and does not have to be repaid if employment later ends. Milestones measure delivery of the agreed work, not trading profit. Benefits * **Health coverage:** Employer\-sponsored health insurance, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Retirement benefits:** 401(k) participation, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Time off:** Unlimited paid time off under the company's written policy, plus applicable paid sick leave and other legally protected leave. Why join us? You will own a live experiment in whether AI can learn to trade, and shape how it is built and run. We value clear thinking, candid communication, responsible handling of capital and data, and strategies that hold up beyond the backtest. Equal opportunity and accommodations MemeLabs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. How to apply Submit your resume, a GitHub profile or portfolio if available, and one page on a systematic strategy you built and later killed: what it was, what the backtest said, and what made you stop it. Applications to: saturntrader@abtrust.ai. Please do not submit confidential information or proprietary code belonging to a current or former employer or client.

jobs.title: Director of Product

Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes. ### **Come Build with Us** We're a NYC\-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office\-first company that values in\-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here. ### **The Opportunity** Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life\-saving therapies, and product helps to shape decisions related to which patients we reach next and how soon. As Director of Product, you will lead a team of product managers covering the full platform, reporting directly to the CEO. You will also keep a hand in the work running discovery, writing the spec, making the call — on the bets that matter most. The roadmap here is not handed down. You will decide what we build, in what order, and what we deliberately don't do, in a market where the right answer is rarely obvious and the stakes are patients starting therapy. If you have led product teams inside someone else's operating model and want to define your own, this is the seat. ### **What You'll Build** **A product team that makes its own calls.** You will coach to a standard in weekly one on ones and roadmap reviews, raise the bar on writing and discovery, and give your PMs enough room to be wrong and get better. The goal is a team that can size a bet and defend it without you in the room. **A roadmap the whole company can bet on.** Sales, implementation, and engineering all plan against what product says is coming. You will set the sequencing across a growing customer base, make the tradeoffs between what one strategic client needs and what the platform needs, and say no clearly enough that people trust the yes. Commitments hold, and when they change, everyone knows why in time to act. **Discovery grounded in how patients actually get to therapy.** Our users are the people running patient support programs, field teams, and hub operations. You will get your team in front of them, translate what you hear into product, and build the customer and market fluency that makes our roadmap hard to copy. Strong opinions are welcome here. Strong opinions without customer contact are not. ### **What Makes You Successful** * 10\+ years in product management at a B2B software company, with a track record of shipping products enterprise customers renewed and expanded. * 5\+ years managing product managers. You have hired, coached, and given hard feedback that made someone better. * Proven ownership of a roadmap end to end from customer discovery and strategy through launch and measured outcomes, not just execution against someone else's plan. * Strong technical fluency. You can work through data models, API integrations, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers and hold your own. Coding is not required. Depth is. * Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You think in documents, and your specs make the decision obvious. * Comfortable working directly with senior customer stakeholders, including the conversations nobody wants to have. * Experience building process where none existed, and the restraint to keep it minimal. **Bonus points if you have:** * Worked in health tech, pharma tech, or life sciences, or know patient support programs, hub services, or specialty pharmacy workflows firsthand. * Built products on top of complex data integrations or healthcare interoperability standards. * Shipped LLM\-powered features that customers actually use. * An early product hire who helped a company scale through growth. **Benefits** * 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision) * 401(k) with employer funded match * Unlimited Vacation * Commuter Benefits * Paid parental leave * Catered lunch on Fridays * Wellness stipend * Great Place to Work Certified The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $225,000\- $260,000 plus equity \+ benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. jobs.description: **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer / Technical Lead** **LOCATION** **Hybrid · Orlando, FL** **SALARY** **$110K – $160K** **REPORTS TO** **Founder \& CEO** **RELOCATION** **Expenses Covered** JOB SUMMARY BidBuddy is a software platform that helps property managers manage requests for proposals, communicate with vendors, receive bids, and compare proposals using AI\-assisted tools. We are bringing software development in\-house after working with an external development firm. We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to take technical ownership of the existing platform and lead its continued development. This role combines full\-stack development, AWS infrastructure management, and practical technical leadership. You will work directly with the founder to understand customer needs, prioritize improvements, and deliver reliable features. **This is a hands\-on development role—not a management\-only position.** We need someone comfortable working independently across an existing codebase, investigating problems, making sound technical decisions, and owning features from planning through production. DUTIES ▪ Lead a structured technical handoff from our current development partner, including the codebase, architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, integrations, and outstanding work. ▪ Take ownership of the existing application, improving it incrementally rather than assuming it requires a complete rewrite. ▪ Develop and maintain frontend features using React and TypeScript, and backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS Lambda. ▪ Improve workflows for property managers and vendors, including RFP creation, vendor invitations, bid submissions, document handling, proposal comparisons, and messaging. ▪ Develop and maintain APIs, data models, authentication, and role\-based access controls. ▪ Maintain AWS infrastructure, including DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and serverless services, using AWS CDK. ▪ Improve AI\-assisted document and bid\-analysis workflows, with attention to accuracy, source evidence, processing costs, and failure handling. ▪ Maintain automated deployments through GitHub Actions and strengthen testing, code review, and release practices. ▪ Monitor application reliability, troubleshoot production issues, and manage cloud and third\-party service costs. ▪ Protect confidential customer and vendor information through appropriate permissions, secure development practices, and careful data handling. ▪ Translate business requirements into clear implementation plans, communicate tradeoffs, and provide realistic delivery estimates. ▪ Document the system so the company retains technical knowledge and can onboard additional engineers as it grows. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Substantial professional experience developing and maintaining production web applications. ▪ Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js. ▪ Hands\-on experience building, deploying, and supporting applications on AWS, particularly serverless architectures. ▪ Experience with APIs, authentication, authorization, and database design. ▪ Experience with DynamoDB or comparable NoSQL databases. ▪ Familiarity with infrastructure as code, automated deployment pipelines, Git, and automated testing. ▪ Demonstrated ability to understand and improve an existing application developed by another team. ▪ Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical decisions clearly to a business\-focused founder. ▪ A practical approach to balancing development speed, reliability, security, and cost. ▪ Willingness to write and maintain code as the primary technical owner. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Experience taking over an application from an agency, consulting firm, or previous engineering team. ▪ Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms serving different user roles. ▪ Experience integrating LLMs into production applications, including structured outputs, evidence validation, evaluation, and usage\-cost management. ▪ Experience with PDF processing, document extraction, or comparison workflows. ▪ Familiarity with Material UI, TanStack Query, Hono, Zod, OpenAI, LangChain, or Ably. ▪ Experience in property management, construction, procurement, or vendor\-management software. ▪ Experience establishing engineering practices for a small company and helping hire or mentor additional developers. CURRENT TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT BidBuddy’s existing codebase includes: **Frontend** React, TypeScript, Vite, and Material UI **Backend** Node.js, TypeScript, Hono, and AWS Lambda **Data \& Infrastructure** DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and AWS CDK **Development \& Deployment** GitHub, GitHub Actions, and a monorepo with shared packages **AI \& Document Workflows** OpenAI and LangChain **Real\-Time Communication** Ably and WebSocket functionality *Experience with every individual library is not required. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to take ownership of the overall system are more important.* INITIAL PRIORITIES — FIRST 90 DAYS During the first 90 days, you will be expected to: **1\.** Complete the technical transition and establish independent development and deployment capability. **2\.** Document the architecture, service dependencies, and operational procedures. **3\.** Identify and prioritize the most important technical risks and product improvements. **4\.** Deliver agreed\-upon improvements through a repeatable testing and release process. **5\.** Establish a practical development roadmap with the founder. WORK ARRANGEMENT \& COMPENSATION **Location:** Hybrid, combining in\-person work at our Orlando, FL headquarters with remote work. **Relocation:** BidBuddy will cover relocation expenses for candidates moving to the Orlando area. **Base salary:** $110,000 – $160,000 per year, depending on experience. HOW TO APPLY Please provide your résumé and a brief description of: **1\.** An application you personally helped build and maintain, including your specific responsibilities. **2\.** Your experience with React, TypeScript, and AWS. **3\.** A time you inherited an existing codebase or took over work from another team. **4\.** Any experience with AI\-powered document processing or SaaS platforms. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Relocation assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Orlando, FL 32827

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT PROMPT.IO Inc.** Prompt.io Inc. is the winning and influence engine partnered with organizations of all size and scale to engage and activate supporters. Prompt.io Inc. is a non\-partisan company and we work with customers of all political stripes. We help companies, political campaigns, advocacy organizations, unions, nonprofits, and other mission\-driven organizations connect with their audiences through texting and engagement tools. We're a growing tech company where individual contributions can have an outsized impact. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas, move with purpose, and are excited to help build what comes next. **ABOUT THE ROLE** You'll own the Prompt.io Inc. solutions repository, a Next.js and Supabase app where we build the things the core platform doesn't cover: special integrations for customers, and internal tooling that keeps our own systems talking to each other. Most of what you build, you'll scope and ship yourself. You'll be part of a small solutions team. Beyond the team, you'll work with almost everyone: customer success and customers most days, sales when a deal needs something built, marketing when they need a demo, and product or engineering whenever a problem turns out to belong to the core platform. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Intake**: Sit with customers to figure out what they actually need. Most requirements come out of conversations with customers and our team members. You'll run those calls and turn what you hear into software that solves their problem. * **Triage**: Decide what should get built, and who should build it. When a customer problem comes in, the first question is whether it needs custom work at all, or whether the platform already has a workaround they can live with, and what happens if we do nothing. If it does need to be built, you build it. If part of it depends on changes to the core platform, or you believe all customers ought to have it, you write up what product needs to know and hand it off. * **Experiment**, **research, \& invent!** At Prompt.io, Solutions Engineering is often phase 0 of the product pipeline. Your solution to one customer's problem may become the blueprint for a platform feature that solves problems for all customers. Consider it a big win if the product team decides to migrate your work out of solutions, and into the core platform. * **Advise**: Help people build on top of Prompt.io. Vendors, technical customers, and partners are writing wrappers around our platform. You'll be their technical contact: showing them the MCP server and getting them to use it, and when they'd rather go straight to the API, acting as the person who knows it best and can tell them how to do what they want. * **Maintain the Repo**: Keep the developer surface current. The portal hosts our MCP server, which needs to track the platform as it changes. * **Take Initiative**: Notice when a process is broken and fix it, without waiting for someone to assign it. If a team member built an essential operational tracker in Google Sheets, and it should be in solutions; migrate it. If a support team member wrote an ad hoc, yet extremely useful python script that only they know how to use, you should port it over to the solutions environment, so the whole support team can use it. If the product team de\-scoped a feature you think could live in solutions, build it yourself! **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * U.S. or Canada based. No international applicants please. * You're comfortable with Next.js, TypeScript, and Postgres, and you've worked with git on a team: branches, pull requests, reviews, a release schedule. * Supabase experience helps. * Junior candidates are fine if the fundamentals are there. * You've connected systems before. Webhooks, REST APIs, large CSVs, cron jobs, authentication between services. * You are deeply fluent in Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor (or sim.), and can manage many agents simultaneously, steering them towards quality outputs, with great taste. * You're careful with other people's data and credentials. Much of what passes through this role is sensitive: contact lists, customer API keys, access to customer infrastructure. * You're comfortable on calls with customers and their vendors, and ready for a technical conversation. * Background in messaging, telephony, or CRM tooling is a plus, and so is any exposure to government, political, union, or nonprofit organizations, which make up most of our customer base. **HOW YOU WORK** Remote\-first. Weekly releases, small pull requests, one integration branch per release. We expect you to ship at least a couple small solutions your first month, and new solutions just about every week after that. **BENEFITS** **We believe great work starts with supporting great people.** Prompt.io Inc. offers a wide range of benefits, including a 401(k) match, health benefits for you and your family, unlimited flexible time off, annual team gatherings, professional development opportunities, and more. **COMPENSATION** The salary range for this position is **$100,000–$175,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. **A NOTE TO APPLICANTS** We don't expect every great candidate to check every box. If you're excited about the work and believe you can be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't perfectly match every item above. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** Prompt.io Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada and not require sponsorship of a visa, unless otherwise specified in the posting.

jobs.title: Responsible AI Engineering Senior Manager
jobs.description: **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 790,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, and we believe that scaling AI responsibly is what makes it durable. Technology is at the core of change today, and we combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data, and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capability. Our Responsible AI capability, within our broader AI \& Data practice, sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge, applied AI engineering, and trusted AI governance. We help the world's leading organizations build and run production\-grade AI and agentic systems that are safe, fair, transparent, and compliant by design, not by afterthought. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI risk in the abstract. We need a practitioner who has built, shipped, and run AI systems at scale, who understands exactly where the technical, ethical, and operational risks live, and who can engineer the guardrails directly into the architecture and the delivery model, across both onshore and offshore teams. **You Are:** You are a Responsible AI Senior Manager who makes trustworthy AI real by building it, not just reviewing it. You bring that credibility because you are, at your core, a deeply technical AI and Data delivery leader: you have designed and shipped production AI, agentic AI, and data science solutions yourself, and you have led large, distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations to do the same at scale. You are equally comfortable in a model architecture review, an agentic workflow design session, and a governance committee, and you use that technical fluency to embed fairness, transparency, safety, and compliance directly into how systems are designed, built, tested, and operated. You set the technical and ethical standard for how generative and agentic AI gets built, secured, and run, and you lead the engineering, data science, and delivery teams who build it. **The Work:** * **Embed Responsible AI across the lifecycle —** define and operationalize Responsible AI standards, including fairness and bias testing, explainability, model and data governance, privacy, safety evaluations, and human oversight, and build these controls directly into engineering and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines rather than bolting them on after the fact. * **Own AI risk and governance —** serve as the senior technical authority on responsible use of generative and agentic AI, running model risk assessments, red\-teaming and safety evaluations, and advising clients and internal leadership on regulatory, ethical, and reputational AI risk. * **Lead large\-scale, global delivery teams responsibly —** manage and mentor large onshore and offshore AI, data science, and engineering teams delivering production\-grade AI and agentic AI solutions, owning staffing, technical direction, quality, and delivery outcomes across geographies and time zones, with Responsible AI checkpoints built into every stage of delivery. * **Architect and build production AI and agentic systems with guardrails in place —** personally guide the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise AI, agentic AI, and data science platforms spanning multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others) and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, Google), ensuring solutions are production\-grade, scalable, maintainable, and governed. * **Set technical standards and reference architectures grounded in Responsible AI —** define reference architectures and technical standards for LLMOps, agentic AI orchestration, data science workflows, security, reliability, and cost governance across the AI estate, and hold engineering teams accountable to them. * **Drive cost and security governance —** establish FinOps\-for\-AI cost optimization practices and embed AI security and governance controls into platform design and delivery. * **Shape responsible AI solutions and grow the business —** partner with clients and pursuit teams to shape solutions, architectures, and delivery models for major AI and Responsible AI programs, and contribute to Accenture sales and proposal efforts when needed. * **Build organizational capability in Responsible AI —** develop playbooks, training, and governance frameworks that raise the Responsible AI and technical delivery maturity of teams across the practice, and continue to deepen your own expertise in AI engineering, agentic AI, data science, and Responsible AI. jobs.description: **Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”)** is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $76 billion\* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee\-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension \& Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025\. Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co\-investments. Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000\. The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide. Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto. * *As of June 30, 2026\. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request.* **Duties****:** Develop software applications focused on investment accounting and operations.Collaborate with software\-development team members and business stakeholders to ensure technical solutions align with stated business objectives. Plan, track, and personally execute project deliverables to meet aggressive deadlines while upholding enterprise quality standards. Gather detailed requirements, lead and participate in architectural design sessions, and document solution approaches. Design, develop, implement, and unit\-test full\-stack software features using JavaScript/Angular front ends and C\#/ASP.NET back ends, including RESTful APIs and SQL data stores. Perform peer reviews and enforce coding standards to maintain consistency, security, and maintainability across the codebase. Troubleshoot, triage, and resolve complex technical issues affecting critical business workflows. Report project status, risks, and effort estimations to technology leadership and business sponsors. Identify and implement opportunities to improve development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and application performance. **Requirements****:** Requires Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field of study, and 5 years of experience in any job title/occupation/position involving full stack development. Experience specified must include 5 years of experience with each of the following: JavaScript and Angular for web\-application development; C\#, ASP.NET (MVC and Web Forms), and WCF services; SQL development, performance tuning, and database design; designing, building and consuming REST/SOAP APIs; systems\-integration projects involving heterogeneous platforms; automated unit testing frameworks, continuous\-integration and continuous\-deployment (CI/CD) pipelines; application performance profiling and optimization; financial services, specifically asset or investment management or private\-equity environments; and interfacing with business users, gathering and clarifying requirements and communicating complex technical concepts verbally and in writing. Telecommuting is permitted up to 2 days per week. We offer a competitive U.S. benefits package designed to support health, financial security, and work\-life balance. Highlights include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) with immediate vesting and employer match; profit sharing; flexible spending accounts (FSA); and paid parental leave, including adoption. Employees also receive generous paid time off, commuter benefits, employer\-paid short\- and long\-term disability and life insurance, and access to additional voluntary benefits. jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** AHEAD is looking for an experienced Principal Engineer to help shape, build, and evolve the platforms that power our business. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. You’ll join an experienced engineering team that builds real products, adopts new tools early, sweats the details, and trades ideas constantly. Our current stack includes Next.js, JavaScript, Golang, dbt, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL. You’ll work across application, service, data, and platform layers, with the autonomy to make a visible impact on important enterprise systems. This is a principal\-level role for someone who can move comfortably between user needs, business outcomes, system architecture, implementation, and production support. We care about the depth of your engineering judgment more than a specific list of languages. Experience with equivalent technologies such as Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or similar is welcome. ### **Building in the Age of AI** AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We are building with an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) first mindset. AI tools and coding agents should accelerate research, design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational analysis, while human judgment remains accountable for what ships. We’re looking for engineers who use these tools fluently without trusting them blindly. * Use AI tools and coding agents throughout the development lifecycle to move faster on exploration, scaffolding, refactors, tests, documentation, and research. * Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, data quality, security, reliability, edge cases, and correctness. * Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, guardrails, and workflows that make the whole team more effective. ### **What you'll do** * Own complex initiatives end to end, from understanding the user’s need and business outcome through architecture, delivery, production support, and continuous improvement. * Design and build pragmatic, secure, and scalable solutions across Next.js applications, JavaScript services, Golang services, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations, data pipelines, and platform integrations. * Use AI tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery, then review, test, secure, and harden everything you ship. * Engage across the full development lifecycle: problem framing, analysis, design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, observability, debugging, and support. * Lead architecture reviews and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and raise the bar on quality, security, reliability, and maintainability. * Partner directly with product, design, data, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into executable plans. * Identify and reduce technical risk, including fragile integrations, poor data quality, unclear ownership, security gaps, operational blind spots, and unsustainable technical debt. * Mentor engineers, shape the engineering roadmap, and help define how AHEAD builds and operates software. ### **What does the ideal candidate look like?** * 8\+ years building and operating software systems, with 10\+ years preferred and a track record of leading significant work end to end. * Principal\-level engineering judgment. You can simplify complex problems, recognize weak solutions, explain tradeoffs clearly, and make decisions that hold up in production. * An AIDLC\-first mindset and demonstrated fluency with AI development tools or coding agents, paired with the discipline to inspect, test, secure, and own everything you ship. * Strong experience with modern web and service development, especially Next.js, JavaScript or TypeScript, and Golang. * Strong experience with data engineering and relational systems, including dbt, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, schema design, query performance, migrations, data quality, and data integrity. * Stack\-agnostic adaptability. Equivalent experience with Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, Elixir, Kotlin, or other modern languages and frameworks is welcome. * A strong foundation in software architecture and the practices that keep systems reliable, including secure development, automated testing, continuous integration, deployment automation, observability, and containerization. * Clear, direct communication. You can express technical intent precisely to engineers, stakeholders, and the AI tools you work with. * The instincts of a technical leader: you influence through credibility, mentor others, raise the level of the people around you, and help teams deliver with accountability. ### **Why you'll love it here** * Join an experienced team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation, curiosity, and practical engineering judgment are the norm. * Help define how a modern engineering organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle while maintaining a high bar for security, quality, and reliability. * Influence architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy beyond a single project or team. * Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where sustainable, effective work matters. *The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On\-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.* **Why AHEAD:** Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. **USA Employment Benefits include:** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * Paid company holidays * Paid time off * Paid parental and caregiver leave * Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details. **Use of AI:** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, assessing responses, or to capture recordings and create transcriptions or summaries during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Notice or contact us at privacy@ahead.com. You may opt\-out of the review or analysis of your application and resume by AI tools by using the General Application. Please include the role you wish to apply for in the Additional Information field. You may also choose to opt\-out of recording and transcription at any time, including after joining an interview. Candidates will not be penalized for choosing to opt\-out. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **About AiDASH** AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com. The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\. Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! **The Role** We're looking for a Staff Engineer to architect and build the services behind new products incubated in our product pods. In this role, you will own back\-end architecture for multi\-tenant SaaS products from first pilot through production scale, make and defend the language and framework calls for each new product, and design the APIs and tool surfaces that let AI agents work with our data. This is a hands\-on role: you will write code, ship pilots, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you. **How you'll make an impact:** * Architect multi\-tenant SaaS and distributed back\-end systems that scale with customer and data growth * Design PostgreSQL schemas, query patterns, and tenancy isolation models built for performance and security * Build well\-structured APIs and expose product capabilities as tool surfaces for AI agents using MCP or similar protocols * Make and defend language and framework decisions for new pod products, balancing speed to pilot with long\-term maintainability * Take new product ideas from concept to pilot to product, and make the call to stop work that isn't earning its place * Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentoring, and hiring **What we're looking for:** * 8\+ years of back\-end software engineering experience. * Deep experience architecting multi\-tenant SaaS and distributed systems at scale. * Expert PostgreSQL knowledge, including schema design, performance tuning, and tenancy isolation. * Strong API design skills, with hands\-on experience or clear depth building tool surfaces for agents (MCP or similar). * Expert in Java and proficient in Python or TypeScript, with a record of making and defending language and framework choices. * A track record of turning an idea into a pilot and then a product, and the judgment to know when to kill one. * Architected a system that is still running in production at scale. * **AI\-Native Product Engineering:** Proven ability to use AI coding tools and agents to rapidly build, evaluate, and ship end\-to\-end products. Candidates will complete a hands\-on, AI\-assisted product\-building interview to demonstrate their ability to direct AI tools, validate generated code, and make sound architectural trade\-offs across inference infrastructure and user\-facing application delivery. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. **What you'll love:** * **Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage:** 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children * **Health Reimbursement Account (HRA):** 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles * **401(k) Plan:** Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered * **Parental Leave:** Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers * **Generous Vacation Policy:** Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you * **Winter Break:** From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends! We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work. We offer a competitive annual pay range of $230,000 to $270,000 for this full\-time position, which includes a base salary and bonus based on performance. This range reflects the anticipated annual pay range (base \+ bonus) for new hires. We strive to ensure our compensation packages are equitable and aligned with industry standards. Your recruiter can share more about compensation during the hiring process. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs. Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy\-policy/

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you. **WHO WE ARE** Airtech is part of the IDEX Performance Pneumatics Group, delivering innovative solutions for vacuum, pressure, and flow control across critical industries worldwide. We specializes in custom\-engineered vacuum and pressure systems, offering advanced solutions for complex applications in life sciences, electronics, and industrial automation. Known for flexibility and technical expertise, Airtech partners with customers to solve unique challenges and deliver tailored systems that meet demanding performance requirements. Airtech combine engineering excellence, customer focus, and global reach to enable technologies that keep industries moving and improve everyday life. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Electrical Engineer is responsible for developing motor\-control algorithms and advanced electrical systems that power high\-speed rotating equipment. The role focuses on control strategies and embedded firmware for Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) used with AC motors, DC motor controllers for DC motor applications, motor\-control electronics, and the integration of industrial communication protocols. The engineer will own the firmware portion of the development and ensure robust, efficient, and reliable system performance through power\-electronics expertise, modeling, simulation, testing, and validation. The position requires close collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, product management, and external suppliers to take designs from requirements and specification development through prototyping, validation, and full\-scale production. The ideal candidate combines deep motor\-control and firmware expertise with the ability to communicate technical requirements clearly to hardware\-development partners and vendors. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Design and Development of Electrical Systems** * a. Support, Develop and optimize Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) for AC motors and DC motor controllers for DC motor applications. * b. Design, integrate and Diagnose CAN\-based communication architectures that support deterministic data exchange between motor controllers, sensors. * c. Support motor design activities. + **Performance Analysis** - Evaluating how the motor behaves under different operating conditions (speed, torque, load). - Using tools like MATLAB/Simulink or Ansys Maxwell to simulate motor efficiency, thermal performance, and electromagnetic characteristics. + **Control Algorithm Development and Firmware Development** - Develop, simulate, implement, tune, and optimize algorithms that control motor speed, torque, current, position, efficiency, and system stability across the operating envelope. - Develop and own embedded firmware for VFDs and DC motor controllers, including control loops, state machines, diagnostics, protection functions, parameter management, and industrial communications. - Apply motor\-control techniques such as PID control, vector control, field\-oriented control (FOC), sensorless control, modulation strategies, and fault handling to achieve smooth acceleration, deceleration, and reliable operation. * **Testing and Validation** * a. Conduct hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), dynamometer, and system\-level testing for VFDs, DC motor controllers, motors, and high\-speed rotating equipment. * b. Validate control algorithms, firmware, hardware interfaces, fault responses, performance, safety, reliability, and electromagnetic compatibility against product requirements and applicable standards. * c. Develop and maintain test plans, instructions, automated test scripts, acceptance criteria, and traceable validation reports using tools such as Python, C/C\+\+, and MATLAB/Simulink. * **Supplier Hardware Development and System Integration** * a. Work directly with suppliers to develop motor\-control hardware, power\-electronic assemblies, PCBs, sensing circuits, gate\-drive circuits, wiring harnesses, and associated electrical subsystems. * b. Write clear technical specifications, interface\-control requirements, performance requirements, and validation criteria for external hardware\-development partners. * c. Review supplier proposals, schematics, PCB layouts, component selections, design calculations, prototypes, test results, and corrective actions. * d. Communicate technical information to vendors and drive design reviews, issue resolution, verification, and qualification through production release. * e. Integrate supplier\-developed ha olders. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline * Minimum 10\+ years of experience in electrical engineering, embedded motor\-control algorithm development, firmware development, VFD or DC motor\-controller development, power electronics, product development, and/or system validation. * undefined * Hands\-on experience developing and validating control algorithms and embedded firmware for AC and/or DC motor\-drive applications. * Experience collaborating with suppliers on hardware development, including specification writing, schematic and PCB reviews, prototype support, design verification, qualification, and production release. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** *The physical demands described here are represented of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * While performing duties of the job, employee is required to move around and be still; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. * **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** ***The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Noise level is minimal with intervals of spikes. * Office working environment with occasional visits to the factory floor. * Required to wear safety glasses and utilize other safety equipment as required while present on shop floor. Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world? **Total Rewards** The compensation range for this position is $99,800\.00 \- $149,600\.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.**Benefits Package** Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our\-benefits\-and\-rewards/ **IDEX is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. IDEX gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other consideration or protected category made unlawful by federal, state or local laws. **Attention Applicants:** If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact our Talent Acquisition Team at lfcareers@idexcorp.com for assistance with an accommodation. These contact tools may be used only by individuals with a disability for accommodation requests. Do not inquire as to the status of an application. This posting is for an existing vacancy. ‌ Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess or select applicants.

jobs.title: CRM IT Business Analyst (Full Time, Remote, North Carolina Based)
jobs.description: The CRM Business Analyst gathers and documents business and functional requirements for CRM and ancillary applications, converts them into technical specifications and test plans, assists in building and validating CRM product changes, and safeguards products quality and HIPAA compliance across all CRM solutions. **This position will allow the successful candidate to work a schedule that will be primarily remote. While there is no expectation of being in the office routinely, they will be required to come into the Alliance Office for business and team meetings as needed.** **Responsibilities \& Duties\-** Elicit and Document CRM Requirements * Lead discovery meetings to capture business objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and organizational service needs * Create requirements artifacts such as Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), business process diagrams, and acceptance criteria that define the desired project outcomes Translate Requirements into CRM technical Specifications * Develop detailed functional and technical specifications for CRM product changes (Salesforce component changes) * Collaborate with CRM engineers, technical analysts, architects and developers to align solution designs that are sustainable and repeatable – utilizing sound architecture principles * Ensure specifications address scalability, security (including HIPAA related data encryptions), and maintainability of CRM solutions Plan and Execute Testing of CRM Solutions * Create test plans, test cases, and validation data sets for unit, integration, and user acceptance testing of CRM and ancillary application builds * Support business stakeholders with UAT; log defects, prioritize fixes, and oversee retesting cycles. Obtain business stakeholder sign\-off on product releases * Verify technical application performance against agreed upon thresholds. Validate performance of application after new releases Support Implementation and Ongoing Operations * Assist with go live activities such as preparation of runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and cut over checklists for CRM releases * Monitor initial production runs, perform change reconciliations, and address any discrepancies that arise * Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and documentation of lessons learned for continuous improvement in CRM application stack Maintain Documentation and Knowledge Base * Keep current inventories of CRM components, data dictionaries, application diagrams, and model documentation up to date * Author and refresh end user guides, technical “how to” documents, and component catalogs in line with IT departmental standards Communication and Collaboration * Translate complex technical concepts into clear language for both technical and non technical audiences * Partner with internal business customers, external entities, and vendor teams to ensure alignment on business and technical architecture * Contribute to CRM governance initiatives, supporting standards for efficiency, privacy, and compliance Continuous Improvement * Utilizes AI (Artificial Intelligence) to increase team productivity while conducting analysis. Demonstrate creativity in determining how to use AI in the day\-to\-day analysis tasks * Identify opportunities to streamline analytics workflows through reusable templates, automation (e.g., CI/CD pipelines), and self service tooling * Define and enhance DevOps process, collaborating with internal business customers * Recommend best practice enhancements to increase efficiency, application reliability, and user satisfaction **Minimum Requirements\-** Education \& Experience Vocational or Technical in in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; and six (6\) years of experience in Technical analysis; OR Associate’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; and five (5\) years of experience in Technical analysis; OR Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; and three (3\) years of experience in Technical analysis. **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities\-** * Salesforce Certified Business Analyst * Communication skills * Salesforce CRM platform experience * Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) * IT Business Analysis experience * SQL (preferably SOQL) skills * Service business process mapping experience * Health Care or Health Insurance experience * Documentation Tools and Platforms **Salary Range** $83,510 \- $106,475/ Hourly **Exact compensation will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, external market data and consideration of internal equity** An excellent fringe benefit package accompanies the salary, which includes: * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Long Term Disability * Generous retirement savings plan * Flexible work schedules including hybrid/remote options * Paid time off including vacation, sick leave, holiday, management leave * Dress flexibility **Employment for this position is contingent upon a satisfactory background check and credit check, which will be performed after acceptance of an offer of employment and prior to the employee's start date.** #### **Education** Required* Technical/other training or better in Computer Science Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: IT Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: **IT Implementation Engineer** **Remote** **Company Overview:** AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high\-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The **IT** **Implementation Engineer** for AMSURG IT Services, is responsible for working closely with Center Leadership and the IT Leadership Team to evaluate, plan, execute and transition IT support from the existing IT support model to the AMSURG Managed IT Services Team. This includes performing a discovery of the existing systems and workflows at the Center, creating a transition plan with communication, performing a transition of services, and documenting the environment for IT Service Delivery to take over operational support. This person will also be designing a solution for Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure for the centers to transition from on\-premises to the cloud. **Work Schedule:** This is a Remote First role. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Build relationship with Center Leadership (Operations Lead, Center Leader, IT provider) * Evaluate IT Security for the centers and provide guidance where needed * Evaluate current IT contracts and provide guidance where needed * Conduct site visits to centers to evaluate, document and plan for migration to AMSURG IT Services * Create documentation for Center configuration and systems * Understand and communicate AMSURG IT Services value and offerings * Architect, build and secure Microsoft 365 and Azure strategy to include Azure Virtual Network(s), Azure Virtual Machines and Azure Virtual Network Gateway * Monitor Azure Subscription to ensure the solution stays within budget guidelines * Work with existing IT providers to gather necessary information to transition IT support to the Service Delivery team * Evaluate current IT equipment, validate against the company standards and recommend replacements for centers as needed * Ability to understand, evaluate and document existing networks and associated dependencies to include VPN connectivity, VLANs and various vendor equipment * Ability to understand, evaluate and document existing server infrastructure and line of business applications * Regular and reliable attendance Other duties as assigned * **QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, decimals and percentages. **Language Skills:** Ability to understand, read, write and speak English. Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures or governmental regulations. Ability to successfully write business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information, respond to questions and professionally interact with managers, employees, clients, vendors and the general public. **Reasoning Ability:** Ability to recognize and define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions and correct errors. Ability to understand and interpret basic financial data. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions in a variety of forms and deal with abstract and concrete variables. **Other Qualifications:** Must be able to handle multiple, simultaneous tasks effectively and efficiently while maintaining a professional, courteous manner. Must be able to work well with others. Strong verbal and written communication skills required. Must be detail oriented and organized. High integrity, including maintenance of confidential information. Must be able to exercise good judgment and positively influence and lead others, including handling confrontations with poise and efficiency. Based on business need, the ability to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends as approved in advance. **Education/Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. Commensurate work experience will be considered in lieu of degree * Prior healthcare experience is preferred * Seven or more (7\+) years of IT experience in an enterprise environment * Project management experience * 5\+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 Administration architecture and management experience * Server management experience * Hypervisor experience managing VMWare ESXi and/or Microsoft Hyper\-V server * Network infrastructure experience * Knowledge of risk assessment tools, systems, and application architecture **Employment at AMSURG:** **Living Our Values Every Day** At AMSURG, our values define who we are and how we serve our patients, partners, and each other. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Security is moving from something builders stop for to something that runs quietly inside how they already work: guidance that shows up in their tools as they code, and continuous checks that replace the weeks\-long review queue. Knowing which controls a service actually needs, surfacing where real risk lives across a massive portfolio, whether the guidance we give is accurate enough to trust, and whether any of it is genuinely reducing risk. You'll lead the data science and data engineering team that answers those questions and makes that whole model measurable. Proving efficacy at scale is where you'll have the biggest impact. It's easy to ship guidance, but hard to know it's working: that it's accurate, that builders act on it, that fewer issues reach production because of it. You'll own the data that turns those into answers leaders can act on, and the feedback loop that uses every issue we find to make the guidance smarter so the same problem never recurs. You'll set the vision, raise the technical bar, and build the foundations good science depends on: trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. You'll love this role if you enjoy: * Turning security from a gate into a default, and proving with data that the shift actually works. * Finding where risk really lives, using data and models to surface the issues and high\-risk code that matter most before they reach production. * Answering hard measurement questions at scale: is our guidance accurate, are builders acting on it, are fewer issues reaching production? * Working across disciplines, using science, analytics, and engineering together so each makes the others stronger. * Standing up something new: shaping the strategy, culture, and standards for a team ready for its first dedicated data leader. * Growing engineers and scientists and watching them take on bigger scope because of how you invested in them. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Selection Intelligence \& Growth helps Amazon Sellers worldwide reach their full potential. Leveraging science and data across Amazon, we catalyze seller growth with comprehensive data, insights, actionable recommendations and growth plans. We strongly believe that any Amazon seller should be able to grow their businesses and reach their full potential by using our Ml powered, agentic and scaled self\-service tools. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you someone who thrives on building reliable, scalable systems and making the lives of engineers around you easier? As a System Development Engineer I at Amazon, you will play a key role in improving the development, testing, deployment, and operations of the systems your team depends on. You will solve real problems that directly impact how quickly and reliably your team delivers for customers. From writing clean, maintainable code to automating repetitive tasks and strengthening system resilience, your work will have a tangible effect on the quality and speed of everything your team ships. If you are curious, collaborative, and excited to grow your technical skills while making meaningful contributions from day one, this is the role for you. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Billing & Payments
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** As a Data Engineer supporting Billing \& Payments Engineering, you'll join the Finance Data Engineering team and build the foundation for accurate, scalable billing and revenue data across Anthropic. You'll work closely with Billing Engineering, Finance and Accounting, as well as Product and other partners, to turn billing and payments data into reliable metrics, reporting and insights. You'll make sure teams have trustworthy data that scales with our growth, and you'll lead your own projects to enable self\-serve insights that help teams make data\-driven decisions. **Responsibilities:** * Partner with Billing Engineering, Finance and Accounting to understand their data and reporting needs, and translate them into technical requirements * Design, build and maintain data models and pipelines in dbt that transform raw billing, usage and payments data into canonical datasets * Own revenue data accuracy and reconciliation, making sure billing, usage and revenue data tie out across systems * Define success metrics for billing systems, and build the data models and monitoring to track them * Set high data integrity standards and SLAs for timely, accurate delivery of billing and revenue data * Share on\-call and data operations responsibilities for Finance Data Engineering pipelines * Build dashboards and self\-serve data products that track core metrics and deliver insights across the company * Champion best practices for dbt, data modeling and SQL * Influence the Billing Engineering roadmap from a data systems perspective * Become an expert in our data models and data architecture **You may be a good fit if you have:** * 5\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer or in a similar role * Expertise in SQL and Python, and in building multi\-step data pipelines with tools like dbt * Experience with workflow orchestration tools like Airflow, and version control with GitHub * Familiarity with billing concepts such as invoicing, payments, credits, refunds and subscriptions, and experience working with data from billing systems * Experience building dashboards and reporting in tools like Hex for multiple cross\-functional teams * A bias for action and urgency, without letting perfect be the enemy of the effective * A full\-stack mindset: you do what it takes to solve a problem end to end, even when it goes beyond the original scope * Comfort with ambiguity, and the initiative to create clarity and keep work moving * A passion for Anthropic's mission of building helpful, honest and harmless AI **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience partnering with billing, finance or accounting teams on revenue metrics and reconciliation * Experience building an analytics or data engineering function from an early stage The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
