Own release sequencing across squads, dependency and risk management, capacity planning, and the DORA metrics that show delivery health. * **Business to architecture translation.** Work with business units and customers to understand process, constraints and pain points, then convert them into domain models, capability roadmaps and architecture decisions. * **Cross\-BU leadership.** Serve as senior technical interface to product management, field engineering, manufacturing systems, data science, IT and InfoSec. Chair architecture governance and hold one sequenced roadmap. * **Configurability.** Own the extension model: plugin and adapter interfaces, versioned APIs with backward compatibility guarantees, declarative configuration, and tenant isolation across silo, bridge and pool patterns. * **Systems integration.** Architect integration to equipment and factory automation interfaces, MES, EDA and yield management systems, historians and data lakes, behind stable anti\-corruption layers. * **Non\-functional ownership.** Own SLOs and error budgets, OpenTelemetry observability, resilience patterns such as circuit breaker and bulkhead, zero\-trust segmentation, and data governance for residency, retention and egress. * **Hands\-on leadership.** Stay credible across the technology stack, including Java and Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, .NET, React and Angular, and lead development directly where the risk warrants it. * **Modernization.** Own strangler\-fig migration of legacy systems onto the common platform, a published deprecation policy, and a funded tech  systems or design enablement, with enough depth to reason about customer process problems and not only their software symptoms. This is a hard requirement. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Direct engagement with leading logic and memory fabs as a software supplier, including participation in security and qualification reviews. * Experience taking an on\-premises product to a multi\-tenant SaaS delivery model, including the tenancy, metering, onboarding and operational changes that requires. * Experience with digital twin, simulation or virtual metrology software in a manufacturing context. * Familiarity with semiconductor data and equipment integration standards and factory automation interfaces. * Experience with open\-weight model deployment, GPU cluster scheduling and inference optimization frameworks. * Prior ownership of a reusable component library or internal developer platform adopted across a large application portfolio. * Experience establishing AI governance covering model risk management, acceptable use policy and evaluation standards in a regulated or IP\-sensitive enterprise. * Background in developer enablement at scale, including technical community building, hackathons, champion networks and measured adoption of engineering tooling. **Competencies** ================ **Architectural judgment.** Knows which decisions are expensive to reverse, and which are not, and spends rigor accordingly. **Business translation.** Hears a process problem described in the customer’s language and returns a design that solves it, without mistaking the stated request for the underlying need. **Delivery ownership.** Treats the date and the quality without authority.** Moves stakeholders who do not report to this role toward a shared platform and keeps them aligned when local incentives pull the other way. **Honesty about AI.** Applies AI where it produces measurable outcomes and declines it where a deterministic method is better. Position requires understanding of Applied Materials global Standards of Business Conduct and compliance with these standards at all times. jobs.title: Vice President, Commercial Development
jobs.description: **Position:** Vice President, Commercial Development – Full Time/Exempt **Department:** Rawhide Development **Reports to:** President \& CEO, Rawhide Development **Location:** Phoenix, Arizona **Format:** In\-person *Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a student or employment Visas (including, but not limited to F\-1, M\-1, J\-1, H\-1B, OPT and/or CPT programs, etc.).* **Rawhide Development Organizational Summary:** Rawhide Development Company is the real estate development platform established by the Arizona Cardinals Football Club. Its primary charge is a 217\-acre mixed\-use district at Scottsdale Road and Loop 101 in north Phoenix, one of the largest remaining infill development opportunities in the Valley. The district is anchored by the Cardinals’ new headquarters and Performance Center, now under construction, and a medical campus of up to 300,000 SF being developed with Dignity Health. Future phases are planned to include retail, office, hospitality, entertainment, and residential uses. Rawhide Development Company is built deliberately lean. The team is small, the scope is extensive, and the initial team will shape how the company operates for years to come. **Job Summary:** The Vice President of Commercial Development is the President \& CEO’s principal partner in leading the Paradise Ridge (working name) district from master plan to vertical delivery. The role owns the commercial engine of the project — transactions, feasibility, pre\-development, and accountability for planning, infrastructure, and project delivery that makes those transactions possible. This is a working executive role. On a given day, the VP may be negotiating a ground lease term sheet, rebuilding a phasing model in Excel, sitting across from a City of Phoenix staff planner, and briefing Ownership. The right candidate is equally credible in the boardroom and in an excel model and sees no contradiction between the two. **Primary Job Duties:** The Vice President, Commercial Development, will have the daily responsibilities including, without limitation, to the following: * Transactions and Business Development + Manage transaction execution across land sales, ground leases, build\-to\-suits, joint ventures, and anchor leases. + Support and coordinate opportunities with end users, developers, operators, and capital partners consistent with the district master plan and Rawhide’s return objectives. + Prepare investment memoranda with feasibility, underwriting, and clear recommendations for decision by the CEO and Ownership. + Oversee the drafting, review, and negotiation of LOIs, PSAs, ground leases, development agreements, CC\&Rs, REAs, and cost\-sharing agreements with the Rawhide and Cardinals legal team. + Protect the whole while closing the part: ensure each deal is evaluated for its long\-term impact on district value, use mix, access, parking, and future phases — not only its own economics. * Master Planning, Entitlements \& Infrastructure + Serve as a day\-to\-day lead with master planners, architects, civil engineers, and land\-use counsel to advance and refine the district master plan, design guidelines, and phasing strategy. + Help drive approvals processes with the City of Phoenix and other jurisdictions; build productive, durable working relationships with agency staff. + Oversee master infrastructure planning including sequencing, cost allocation among parcels and users, and alignment with pad delivery commitments. + Ensure obligations of the Development Agreement and other agreements are met and tracked. + Manage the evaluation and implementation of public finance tools (e.g., community facilities districts, SAID, and related mechanisms) with the CFO and outside advisors. + Lead efforts in identifying and applying for additional public funding sources for public infrastructure and improvements. * Pre\-Development \& Project Management + Lead feasibility and pre\-development for commercial parcels and vertical projects: market validation, program definition, site planning, underwriting, and schedule. + Coordinate closely with the Rawhide construction team on the procurement, scope, and management of consultants and contractors; hold them accountable to budget, schedule, and quality. + Ensure seamless coordination with, and hold accountable, the Rawhide project delivery team on the delivery of the headquarters, performance center, and shared site work, along with partners such as Dignity Health and their obligations. + Assist in building and maintaining the development management backbone of the company including master development schedule, reporting, decision logs, risk registers, and document control with a focus on simplicity and usability. * Financial Stewardship \& Reporting + Collaborating with FP\&A, prepare pre\-development, feasibility, and lease\-up/disposition budgets; report quarterly and manage to them. + Manage the f cture, engineering, or a related field. + Experience: At least twelve (12\) years of progressive commercial real estate development experience, with significant responsibility on large\-scale, multi\-phase mixed\-use projects or master\-planned communities. + Demonstrated record of transaction execution — land sales, ground leases, build\-to\-suits, anchor or major\-user leases, and/or joint ventures — as the lead negotiator. + Sound knowledge of horizontal development: infrastructure planning, phasing, cost allocation, and entitlements. + Command of commercial real estate documents, including PSAs, ground leases, REAs, CC\&Rs, and development agreements. + Strong financial acumen, including the ability to build, audit, and defend development pro formas and cash\-flow models in Excel. + Excellent written and verbal communication; able to lead with the answer and present concisely to Ownership, partners, and public officials. + Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays; hours may vary depending on business needs. + Must successfully complete pre\-employment screening, including a background check. * Preferred + Education: Graduate degree (MBA, MRED, or similar). + Experience in the Phoenix/Scottsdale market and with Arizona entitlement and public finance processes. + Experience with medical office, corporate campus, hospitality, or sports\-affiliated real estate. + Experience at a start\-up or early\-stage development platform, or in standing up a new business unit. + Proficiency with project management software. **The Profile We’re Looking For:** * Builder, not inheritor. Energized by creating structure where none exists yet, and comfortable operating without a large support staff. * Moves easily between strategy and detail — willing to draft the memo, check the math, and walk the site. * Knows which decisions belong to the CEO and Ownership, surfaces issues early, and brings a recommendation along with the problem. * Relationship intelligence. Builds trust across personalities and constituencies — owners, tenants, brokers, city staff, contractors, and colleagues. * Integrity and discretion. Represents a high\-profile organization with professionalism, a strong ethical code, and sound confidentiality. * Ownership mentality. Treats the project’s outcomes as personal, and the company’s resources as if they were their own. **Rawhide Development Benefits/Perks Summary:** Rawhide Development has developed a comprehensive benefits package that provides economic and inclusive benefits to full\-time employees. The Rawhide Development benefits offer care, protection, and support for employees and their loved ones. The Rawhide Development organization encourages an environment that is conducive to living a healthy, productive, and flexible lifestyle. Benefits and Perks include, but are not limited to: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance options; effective the first day of hire * 401 (k) retirement option with employer match contribution * Paid Time Off Accruals (including sick time accruals) * Paid Time Off for most Federal holidays * Time off for Maternity, Paternity, Military, and Bereavement * MDLIVE: 24/7 medical support * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Care Saving Account options * Discounts on Cardinals gear \& paraphernalia * Tuition reimbursement \& Professional Growth opportunities * Daily free lunch *The Arizona Cardinals Football Club and Rawhide Development is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.* *\#LI\-Onsite* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, migrates, and transforms customer technology environments across Microsoft, cloud, virtualization, servers, networking, security, and data protection. This is a Professional Services engineering role focused on project delivery and technical execution, from discovery and assessment through solution design, implementation, testing, documentation, and project completion. The Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer works directly with customers, project managers, architects, engineers, and technology vendors to translate business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. The role requires strong technical problem\-solving skills, the ability to independently execute complex implementations, and the ability to communicate technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. The engineer will lead and participate in infrastructure assessments, migrations, upgrades, integrations, and new technology deployments across single\-site and multi\-site environments. Upon completion, the engineer ensures solutions are fully documented, validated, and transitioned to the appropriate customer or operational team. This position reports to the Managing Consultant or designated Service Delivery leadership. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES\- MAY INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING** **INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING** * Design, implement, and migrate customer infrastructure across servers, Microsoft, cloud, virtualization, networking, security, and data protection. * Conduct infrastructure discovery and assessments to identify dependencies, configuration requirements, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement. * Design and implement Microsoft technologies including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Entra ID, and related identity services. * Design and implement Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments, including compute, storage, networking, identity, backup, monitoring, and migration services. * Implement VMware and Hyper\-V environments, including hosts, virtual machines, storage, resource allocation, high availability, and workload migrations. * Configure and troubleshoot networking technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, and firewalls. * Implement security controls across identity, endpoints, servers, networks, cloud, and applications, including MFA, least privilege, endpoint protection, and secure configuration. * Design and implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions using platforms such as Veeam and Cohesity * Troubleshoot complex technical issues encountered during implementations and migrations and perform root\-cause analysis. * Validate implementations against defined technical requirements and project outcomes. **PROFESSIONAL SERVICES \& PROJECT DELIVERY** * Participate in customer discovery, technical assessments, solution design, and project planning. * Translate customer requirements into practical, secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. * Execute installations, migrations, upgrades, integrations, and infrastructure transformations in accordance with project scope. * Work with Project Managers to identify technical dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and implementation timelines. * Coordinate technical activities with customers, architects, engineers, vendors, and third\-party providers. * Communicate technical findings, project status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly and proactively. * Execute implementation, testing, validation, and change activities during scheduled project windows. * Provide knowledge transfer and complete technical documentation for customer and operational handoff. * Contribute to engineering standards, reference architectures, reusable solutions, and delivery methodologies. Other duties as assigned Requirements: **MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * 3–5 years of experience in Professional Services, consulting, systems integration, or project\-based engineering. * Strong experience with Microsoft technologies, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID. * Hands\-on experience with Azure and/or hybrid infrastructure. * Experience with VMware and/or Hyper\-V. * Working knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, and firewalls. * Experience with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery technologies. * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and root\-cause analysis skills. * Developing technical designs, implementation plans, testing procedures, rollback plans, and as\-built documentation. * Ability to independently execute technical implementations and manage multiple project priorities. * Strong customer\-facing communication and collaboration skills. **PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Delivering infrastructure projects within a consulting, systems integration, or Professional Services organization. * Conduct infrastructure assessments and developing technical recommendations. * Ability to perform Azure migrations and hybrid infrastructure. * Deploy and implement Veeam, Cohesity or comparable enterprise backup platforms. * Understanding of switches, firewalls, and wireless * Microsoft Entra ID, automation, or other modern infrastructure technologies. * Relevant Microsoft, Azure, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA, or Veeam certifications. **OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Applies structured troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and sound technical judgment across interconnected application, server, cloud, virtualization, network, and security systems. * Communicates clearly and professionally, translates technical concepts for varied audiences, and produces accurate documentation suitable for customers and support teams. * Works effectively with customers, engineers, service desk personnel, project managers, vendors, and application owners in remote, office, data center, and client\-site settings. * Demonstrates ownership, professionalism, attention to detail, continuous learning, and disciplined adherence to security, change management, documentation, and service delivery standards. **TRAVEL:** This role may be performed remotely or in a hybrid capacity based on business needs. Travel to customer offices, data centers, and other project locations may be required for discovery, installation, migration, maintenance, troubleshooting, cutover, or recovery activities. Travel expectations will vary by assignment and customer location. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer, communicate verbally and in writing, participate in virtual and in\-person meetings, and remain stationary for extended periods. The employee may also perform hands\-on work in office, server\-room, and data\-center environments. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach, bend, work near equipment racks and cabling, and lift or move equipment or materials up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job involve normal vision for computer\-based work, equipment identification, cabling, and technical documentation review. **WORK ENVIRONMENT:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description: **About Assembly Software** Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it. When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement** Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement** Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback. * We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning. * We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another. * We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded. * We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value. * We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching. * We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity. **The Opportunity** Being a Technical Support Specialist at Assembly Software is not a script\-reading job. Our AI agent already answers the routine how\-to questions, which means the conversations that reach you are the ones that need a person: a login that fails after a Windows update, an integration returning an error code, a configuration that worked last week and does not today. As a Technical Support Specialist on our Tier 1 team, you own those issues from first contact through resolution, and you decide when to bring in a subject matter expert. You will work across Neos, our cloud practice management platform, and our on\-premise products, Needles and TrialWorks, and you will build real depth in at least one specialty area along the way. **Why Now** We are rebuilding how support works. AI handles the repetitive questions, so the humans on the team spend their time on troubleshooting, judgment calls, and making sure a fix gets written down once and reused by the whole team and by the AI agent itself. If you have a year or more in technical support and want the harder tickets, this is the version of the role where that is the job. **What You'll Do** You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, including conversations handed off from our AI agent. You will troubleshoot software, Windows, network, login, and remote desktop issues with a methodical approach: reproduce it, isolate the variables, document what you tried. You will use AI tools such as Intercom Copilot to find answers before escalating, and when you do escalate, you will send a clean, documented handoff that Tier 2 and our Customer Support Engineers can act on without sending it back. After training, you will handle first\-line API requests, including access, key resets, and basic integration checks. You will document new solutions, flag gaps in our knowledge base and AI content, and join the on\-call rotation once trained. Over time, you will become the team's go\-to person in a specialty area, whether that is on\-premise installs, hosting, API, or a Neos feature area. **What You'll Bring** At least a year in technical support, help desk, or IT support, ideally helping business software customers. A troubleshooting habit that favors evidence over guessing, the ability to teach yourself new software from documentation, and the ability to explain technical things clearly to people who are not technical. Comfort using AI assistants in daily work, and the judgment to notice when they are wrong. Solid Windows and Microsoft Office skills, including the ability to work through common permissions and connectivity problems. Experience with Windows Server, Office 365, SQL Server, APIs, Intercom, RingCentral, or legal software is a plus, as is time spent in a law firm, especially a plaintiff or personal injury practice. If you’re the person who wants the tougher tickets and takes pride in solving them, we want to hear from you. **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?** Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe. **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?** Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact. **3\. What's the benefits package like?** Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to: * Medical, dental, and vision plans * Short and long term disability coverage * Supplemental insurance options * 401(k) * Flexible time off * Paid parental leave * An Employee Assistance Program We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it. *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer

You'll be the bridge between research, product, customers, and engineering, driving AI adoption from strategy through production at scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in early\-stage environments, enjoys owning things end to end, and wants their work to have a measurable impact on an industry that desperately needs modern infrastructure. **What You’ll Do** ================== System Architecture \& Design * Design and evolve a modular architecture to power configurable healthcare workflows at scale. * Build a workflow orchestration engine capable of handling thousands of concurrent stateful tasks (credentialing, verification, enrollment). * Define and optimize integration frameworks to connect with thousands of external systems — web portals, APIs, PDFs, spreadsheets. * Drive reliability, auditability, and performance through observability, self\-healing, and clear fault\-domain boundaries. Leadership * Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to discover use cases, build features, and deliver value * Engage with customers to understand operational challenges, validate assumptions, and iterate solutions quickly * Provide technical mentorship to the engineering team **What We’re Looking For** ========================== Qualifications * 10\+ years experience building and scaling complex, distributed systems or workflow\-heavy SaaS platforms. * Deep experience implementing AI harnesses. * Recent experience in startups. * Proven ability to own architecture and make high\-stakes technical decisions in ambiguous, high\-growth environments. * Deep understanding of modern cloud architecture and full software stacks. * Excellent communication — able to clearly explain technical trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. You’ll Love This Role If You * Want to lead AI projects from idea to deployment. * Want to own architecture, projects, and culture. * Thrive in a 0 1 environment, building from scratch and scaling from concept to production. * Care deeply about impact — accelerating patient access by fixing the infrastructure of healthcare. * Believe great products emerge from tight collaboration between product, engineering, and operations. * Want your work to outlast you — building systems that become part of healthcare’s invisible infrastructure. **Why Join Assured** ==================== * High\-impact work \- Tackle bottlenecks that slow down provider access to patients * Real\-world AI – Build intelligent systems that reason, act, and automate in production. * Cross\-functional exposure \- Collaborate with customers, clinical ops, engineers, and founders * Early\-stage upside \- Equity, early influence, and a high\-growth trajectory * People\-first culture \- Mental health time, and a focus on outcomes, not hours **Benefits and Pay** ==================== Our headquarters are located in New York City. We provide competitive base compensation along with stock options. Compensation for this role depends on experience and interview performance. We offer generous employer\-sponsored health and dental coverage, nine company holidays, and unlimited PTO ("take what you need"). **EEO Statement** ================= Assured is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices, including hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeships. Assured bases hiring decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The world’s largest law firm won’t be a law firm. Join us in building it.** ============================================================================= August allows law firms to compound their expertise by building an autonomous organization of AI agents that run the firm's knowledge work. We partner closely with our firms and grow alongside them through sharing revenue on our agents and equity in the firms we transform. We believe that in five years, more than 95% of legal work will be concentrated among a select few elite law firms. The firms that get there will be the ones that rebuild how they deliver it. We're partnering with those firms and building the engine they run on to become the biggest legal service provider in the world. We invest in partnerships, not just licenses. We sell finished legal work alongside our firms and take a share of what it earns. This enables them to scale their services and lets us grow along with it. That means we’re chasing the legal services market ($1T), which dwarfs the global legal tech market ($40b). The problem is hard. An engine of agents sits underneath every matter we touch, connected to every step of a lawyer's workflow, in an industry where there is no margin for error. We’re challenged with building the perfectly accurate, infallibly secure, and yet all\-powerful engine for legal work. We're already live with several excellent firms and the early results are better than we expected. Lean team, in person, New York, backed by leading investors, growing fast. Every role at August is a chance to remake an industry while the window is open. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Solutions Engineer, you will work directly with law firms to turn complex legal workflows into working AI solutions. You will embed with clients, understand their processes and technical environment, and own deployments from discovery and prototyping through integration, go\-live, and adoption. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role: you will run working sessions, build and test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help people put AI to work. You should enjoy getting into the technical details as much as explaining what you’ve built to the people who will use it. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Embed with client organizations and run structured discovery across teams and practice groups, mapping workflows, systems, and data flows to identify where AI can have the greatest impact. * Work one\-on\-one with lawyers, paralegals, legal ops staff, and technical stakeholders to translate day\-to\-day pain points into clear requirements and practical solutions. * Build and test lightweight proofs\-of\-concept for document review, form filling, intake, drafting, redlining, and matter management, using APIs, scripts, and workflow automation tools where needed. * Configure AI workflows and connect them to client systems, working with technical teams on integrations, troubleshooting, and validation before rollout. * Run hands\-on demos and training sessions that help users understand how the solutions work and adopt them in their daily practice. * Own the go\-live from kickoff through adoption, coordinating technical resources on both sides and resolving issues as they arise. * Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for client stakeholders, running structured check\-ins and business reviews to understand what’s working and what needs improvement. * Translate findings from deployments into actionable feedback for August’s engineering team, including reproducible issues, integration needs, and opportunities to improve the product. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * Strong technical problem\-solving skills: you can break down an unfamiliar workflow, understand how its systems fit together, and build a practical solution. * Comfort writing lightweight scripts, working with APIs and structured data, and debugging integrations. Experience with Python or JavaScript is especially useful. * Strong product sense: you understand what makes a workflow painful and can translate that understanding into something people actually use. * Business acumen and clear communication: you can earn trust with a managing partner, a legal ops analyst, and a technical stakeholder, and explain complex ideas in straightforward terms. * Natural curiosity and comfort with ambiguity: you ask good questions, investigate beyond the obvious answer, and take ownership when there is no established playbook. * 1–3 years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, software engineering, or a similarly hands\-on technical role. Experience working directly with customers is valuable; a background in law or legal services is a plus. * Familiarity with AI tools, LLM\-powered applications, or workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n is helpful. * Excitement about working in person at our NYC office with a team that values precision, pace, and constant reinvention. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical insurance coverage * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave * Centralized office equipment ordering for all employees * Equinox or Chelsea Piers gym membership * In\-office perks: lunch, dinner, snacks, drinks, and more * Budget for intra\-office travel * Team\-building events * Relocation support to NYC (as needed) **Why Join August** ------------------- * **Founding Impact:** Shape not just your role but the company. * **Uncapped Upside:** Competitive base \+ commission, early equity ownership. * **Top\-tier Team:** Work alongside people who move fast, think clearly, and care deeply. * **Category\-Defining Work:** Help build the first true AI agents for the legal profession. * **Fast Growth:** Scale your career as we scale the company. * **In\-person in NYC:** Collaborative, talent dense and high energy environment * **Global Reach: Our clients span 4 continents and use August in multiple languages and jurisdictions** * **Frontier of Applied AI:** August has access to proprietary data inaccessible to foundation model providers. We build agents to automate all challenging knowledge work. Compensation Range: $100K \- $160K

jobs.title: ML Engineer, Behavior Planning
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are seeking a ML Engineer to join the Behavior Planning Team. This is a high\-impact role where you will sit at the frontier of autonomous vehicle technology. You won't just be applying AI and ML methods; you will be advancing the state\-of\-the\-art for how a self\-driving system reasons about the world, interacts with humans on the road, and masters complex, high\-dimensional decision\-making. **In this role you will** * Define the architecture of our onboard planning models: Develop and deploy large\-scale models trained with Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning that enable the Aurora Driver to navigate complex environments with human\-like fluidity and superhuman safety. * Revolutionize evaluation: Develop powerful offboard critic models that can evaluate driving behavior at scale, identifying subtle nuances in comfort, progress, and safety that traditional heuristics miss. * Build our next\-generation simulation engine: Architect cutting\-edge offboard foundation models that power our simulation engine, creating realistic "world models" to test the Aurora Driver against an infinite variety of edge cases. * Bridge research and production: Reach new frontiers of autonomous driving technology by pushing forward the state\-of\-the\-art, but also deploy your models on real production vehicles that drive on public roads and must meet the highest standards of safety. **Required qualifications** * BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of experience developing state\-of\-the\-art ML models, either in a research or production setting. * Hands\-on experience working on Imitation Learning or Reinforcement Learning applied to physical or simulated agents. * Experience training large models on massive datasets using distributed computing. * Fluency in Python, with a focus on writing high\-performance, maintainable code. * Deep experience with PyTorch (preferred) or another modern ML framework, and a mastery of modern ML architectures including Transformers and Diffusion Models. **Desirable qualifications** * A track record of publications in top\-tier ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CoRL, CVPR, AAAI). * Experience deploying complex ML systems in production environments. * Experience in developing generative models or neural simulators for synthetic data generation. * Fluency with C\+\+, with a focus on writing high\-performance, safe, and maintainable code. The base salary range for this position is **$139,000 \- $223,000 per** Year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avaya** --------------- Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections. The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships. We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.avaya.com **Job Description** ------------------- ### **Platform Engineer** **Build the Platform. Automate at Scale.** Are you passionate about building reliable, scalable cloud platforms and eliminating operational complexity through automation? Do you believe in infrastructure as code, modern DevOps practices, and creating platforms that empower engineering teams to deliver with confidence? We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to help build, optimize, and maintain the cloud platform technologies that support our applications and services. #### **The Opportunity** As a Platform Engineer, you’ll help design, implement, and evolve the platforms that power our cloud environments. You’ll collaborate with engineering and cloud operations teams to improve platform reliability, streamline deployments, and enable scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure. You’ll work across modern platform technologies, including Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Ansible, while applying GitOps, automation, and CI/CD best practices. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, improving operational efficiency, and building adaptable platforms that meet evolving business and application needs. **Your Mission\-Critical Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------- **Platform Architecture \& Engineering:** Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud platform solutions using modern architecture principles and infrastructure automation. **Infrastructure as Code \& Automation:** Apply automation and configuration management practices to improve platform consistency, repeatability, and operational efficiency. **Containerization \& Orchestration:** Support and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes, enabling reliable deployment and operation of applications and microservices. **CI/CD \& GitOps:** Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, incorporating version control and GitOps practices to support consistent, reliable deployments. **Platform Reliability \& Performance:** Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and redundancy. Identify opportunities to improve resilience, stability, and scalability. **Cloud Operations Collaboration:** Partner with cloud operations and application engineering teams to understand application requirements and ensure platform capabilities align with workload needs. **Security \& Risk Management:** Implement and maintain platform security practices and controls to help protect systems, applications, and sensitive data. **Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement:** Investigate platform issues, perform system debugging, and resolve complex technical problems while identifying opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency. **Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing:** Maintain clear documentation of platform architecture, configurations, operational procedures, and engineering practices. **Technology Evolution:** Stay current with emerging cloud\-native technologies, DevOps practices, and platform engineering trends to continually improve platform capabilities. **What You Bring to the Team** ------------------------------ **The Experience:** Proven experience in platform engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or a related software engineering role. **The Platform Mindset:** A solid understanding of cloud technologies, modern platform architectures, and the principles behind building scalable, reliable infrastructure. **The Automation Toolkit:** jobs.title: Clinical Data Business Analyst
jobs.description: **Role Overview** This role is the connective tissue between Biometrics and Data Engineering. It exists because clinical data has meaning that structure alone doesn’t carry: someone has to understand what the data represents clinically, what the standards require of it, and how it must therefore be modeled — and then make sure the engineering team builds systems that produce it correctly. The SME owns that translation. They bring clinical data domain expertise and a solid working command of CDISC standards, and they use it to guide the design of data products that are clinically correct, standards\-conformant, traceable, and ready to support analysis and an AI\-ready data strategy. **Working knowledge of CDISC, SDTM, and ADaM is mandatory** — specifically, at the level required to design systems and pipelines that enforce the standards, map source data into them, and extend them where the data demands it. The CDISC Expertise This Role Requires *This is worth being precise about, because it defines who fits.* **What we need:** someone who can look at source data and design the system that gets it correctly into SDTM — mapping source to target domains, enforcing controlled terminology through validation rather than manual review, and extending or customizing domains where the data genuinely requires it. This is applied, systems\-oriented CDISC expertise: knowing the standard well enough to build against it and to tell an engineering team what “conformant” actually means in code. **What we don’t need:** someone to author the standards themselves. This role doesn’t define new controlled terminology, sit on standards bodies, or own submission deliverables. It consumes the published standards and makes sure our systems honor them. ***What This Person Actually Does*** **Owns the clinical meaning of the data.** Serves as the authority on what the data represents — how it’s collected, what the clinical workflows behind it imply, and what constraints that places on how it can be structured. This is the judgment that engineering teams cannot supply for themselves. **Designs how the standards get enforced.** Specifies how source and EDC data maps into SDTM target domains, and how controlled terminology is validated in the pipeline rather than checked after the fact. Determines when data fits an existing domain, when supplemental qualifiers suffice, and when a domain needs to be extended or customized to represent the data honestly — then makes sure that logic is built consistently rather than reinvented per study. **Translates in both directions.** Turns clinical and business needs into requirements, mapping specifications, and user stories engineering can act on — and explains technical constraints and trade\-offs back to Biometrics stakeholders in terms they can decide on. **Protects traceability.** Ensures an unbroken path from source data through SDTM to analysis, so any value can be explained and defended. In a regulated environment this isn’t documentation hygiene; it’s what makes the data defensible. **Integrates the data that doesn’t arrive neatly.** Brings external sources — labs, PK, biomarkers, imaging, eCOA — into standardized structures, resolving the mismatches in keys, terminology, and timing these sources invariably introduce. **Guides delivery without owning the build.** Works alongside data engineers and architects, supplying clinical and standards input, reviewing designs, and validating that what’s delivered means what it’s supposed to mean. Engineering owns the how; this role owns the what and the why. **Closes the loop on adoption.** Supports validation and testing against real clinical scenarios rather than functional checks alone, and stays engaged until the people who asked for the data product are actually using it. **Sets the direction.** Drives clinical data strategy by embedding CDISC standards, data domains, and governance into how data is built — the discipline that makes datasets trustworthy enough to be analytics\- and AI\-ready. ***What We’re Looking For*** * **Solid working knowledge of CDISC**, sufficient to design systems and pipelines that produce conformant data. * **Demonstrated source\-to\-SDTM mapping**: the ability to take raw, EDC, or legacy clinical data and map it correctly into target SDTM domains. * **Practical command of controlled terminology** — enough to design validation that enforces it systematically, not to author it. * **Ability to extend or customize SDTM domains** where the data requires it, with the judgment to know when that’s warranted versus when existing domains or supplemental qualifiers are the right answer. * **Working understanding of ADaM** and how analysis\-ready data derives from SDTM, sufficient to guide design and preserve traceability. * Familiarity with what conformance and validation expectations mean in practice, and with the SDTM Implementation Guide as a working reference. **Also Required** * Clinical data domain expertise — a real understanding of how clinical data is collected and why that shapes how it must be modeled. * A demonstrated ability to gather clinical and business requirements and convert them into technical specifications and user stories engineering teams can build from. * Experience partnering with data engineering and architecture teams in a supporting, advisory capacity — comfortable guiding design without taking over implementation. * Working knowledge of clinical data workflows, external data integration, data standards, and data governance in a regulated (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11\) environment. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both directions — able to hold a conversation with Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory on one side, and data engineers and architects on the other. **Education \& Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Bioinformatics/Health Informatics, or a related technical or quantitative discipline. * Equivalent demonstrated experience in data architecture, data modeling, or data engineering will be considered in place of a formal degree. What matters is the ability to reason rigorously about data structure, relationships, and integrity — however that capability was acquired. **Preferred** * Master’s degree in a data\-oriented field — Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Biomedical/Health Informatics, or Biostatistics. * Formal coursework or credentials in data modeling, data architecture, or database design. * Certification in a relevant data discipline: – Data management or governance (e.g., CDMP / DAMA\-certified data management professional) – Data architecture or solution architecture – Cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or equivalent data\-focused certification) – Business analysis (e.g., CBAP/CCBA) or an equivalent requirements\-engineering credential * CDISC training or certification. Pay: $75\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pleasanton, CA 94588

jobs.description: **Compensation:** $175,000\-$250,000 per year **Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE \- Hybrid **The job:** As a Principal Cloud Engineer, AI Platform at Buildertrend, you’ll shape the cloud foundation that allows AI agents to support real customer workflows while protecting data, controlling costs and maintaining performance. You’ll own critical platform architecture, establish standards that help engineering teams move independently and make the technical decisions that determine how safely we scale AI across our products. AI agents are already changing how work gets done, and the infrastructure behind them determines whether that change is secure, reliable and sustainable. Your work will help builders and remodelers spend less time managing processes and more time growing their businesses. **What you will do:** * Design and maintain the infrastructure behind production AI agents, including workload identity, ingress and egress gateways, network isolation and platform\-level sensitive data redaction. * Lead decisions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) networking, private connectivity, zero\-trust egress and service perimeters to protect workloads without limiting the platform’s ability to grow. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines that help product teams deploy safely and independently, including temporary environments for validating changes before merge. * Establish a centralized, approved path for large language models (LLM) access, including routing, virtual keys, provider onboarding, observability and cost attribution. * Document platform and vendor decisions with total cost of ownership, barriers to entry, trade\-offs and open questions clearly defined so teams can make informed decisions and build on a consistent foundation. * Serve as a technical counterpart to major cloud and AI providers, escalate complex issues and validate roadmap commitments before they influence platform architecture. * Take incident command during critical production issues, make informed go/no\-go decisions under pressure and communicate risks and status clearly to technical leaders and executives. * Implement safeguards for credentials, secrets and AI usage, including automated secrets rotation and policy\-as\-code controls that reduce the risk of unauthorized AI deployments. * Lead blameless postmortems, identify systemic weaknesses and turn incident findings into measurable improvements in platform security, resilience and operational readiness. * Embrace using AI as a tool to enhance your work, while remaining open to learning, applying critical thinking, and owning the quality of your final work. **Who you are and what you need:** * 10\+ years of experience architecting enterprise\-grade GCP environments, with advanced knowledge of GCP\-native networking, including VPC Service Controls and Private Service Connect, as well as IAM perimeters and Workload Identity. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company. * Strong infrastructure as code practice. * Hands\-on experience running AI or ML workloads in production, such as model serving, agent runtimes or inference gateways, and understand how their needs differ from traditional web applications. * Practical depth in workload identity and machine\-to\-machine authorization, including service accounts, short\-lived credentials, certificate\-based identity, and token delegation, and the challenges of on\-behalf\-of authorization flows. * Track record\-owning production incidents, including calling deployments under pressure and updating executives during an outage. * Experience with agent development frameworks, agent runtime platforms and the emerging tooling around them. * Approach incidents without blame, communicate directly, take ownership of platform outcomes and turn lessons learned into practical improvements that help other engineers deliver reliable software. * Experience with automated secrets rotation, policy as code and governance that limits unauthorized “Shadow AI” deployments, with an eye on the new attack surfaces AI creates. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. jobs.title: Workforce Modernization Architect
jobs.description: Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting\-edge technology with compassionate, high\-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we're solving today's unemployment challenges with smart software, world\-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you'll feel right at home here. Career Team is looking for a Workforce Modernization Architect who designs solutions around people, processes, and compliance; not code. Many of Career Team's customers run federally funded workforce development programs. These programs must submit reports to federal agencies in strictly defined formats, such as the WIOA Participant Individual Record Layout (PIRL), and follow detailed logic rules. You'll make sure our government software platform is built to meet those requirements from the start, translate federal reporting specifications into clear business rules, work with technical teams to make sure the system calculates and formats data correctly, and help customers submit accurate, on\-time reports. ### **Role Overview:** * **Own federal reporting requirements.** Interpret federal reporting specifications, data standards, and program guidance, with a focus on PIRL and related U.S. Department of Labor and Department of Education reporting. Turn them into detailed functional requirements. * **Define reporting logic.** Write clear, testable business rules for how the system must calculate each reported value. This includes: * + Reporting periods and date ranges + Who counts in each reporting population, including participants, exiters, and co\-enrollments across WIOA titles (Title I, Title II, Title III, Title IV) + Unduplicated counts and deduplication + Enrollment, program participation, and exit logic + Age and status calculated as of specific dates + Handling of missing, refused, or conflicting data * **Specify output formats.** Document required file layouts, field definitions, code lists, ordering, and file naming conventions (CSV, XML, fixed\-width, or agency\-specific templates) so exports pass federal validation the first time. * **Solve compliance issues.** Find the root cause of reporting and compliance problems, whether they come from system logic, data entry, or unclear guidance, and lead them through to a documented fix. * **Resolve ambiguity.** Identify gaps or contradictions in federal guidance. Research agency FAQs, TEGLs, and technical assistance resources. Document how the system handles edge cases and the reasoning behind each decision. * **Lead testing and quality assurance.** Build test scenarios and expected results for reporting logic. Partner with QA to review system outputs against specifications and federal validation tools, such as DOL's WIPS edit checks. Trace errors back to the rule or data that caused them. * **Bridge state case management systems.** Apply your knowledge of how different state case management systems capture and structure participant data. Anticipate integration, mapping, and consistency challenges across customers in multiple states. * **Track regulatory change.** Monitor updates to federal specifications, PIRL versions, and reporting cycles. Assess how changes affect the system and customers, and plan updates ahead of deadlines. * **Build data quality in.** Recommend intake workflows, required fields, and validation checks that keep bad data out of the system, instead of fixing it at report time. * **Support customers during reporting cycles.** Help program staff understand their reports, troubleshoot validation errors, and answer questions from grant managers, monitors, and auditors. ### **Qualifications:** * Experience in workforce development, including programmatic experience in at least one WIOA program: Title I (Adult, Dislocated Worker, Youth), Title II (Adult Education and Family Literacy), Title III (Wagner\-Peyser Employment Service), Title IV (Vocational Rehabilitation), or Title V (Senior Community Service Employment Program) * Hands\-on experience with PIRL and federal reporting for grant\-funded programs * Hands\-on experience with more than one state case management system * Experience with government software, either as a user, implementer, or administrator in a public\-sector setting * Grant management experience, including an understanding of how reporting ties to performance, funding, and compliance * A proven ability to read and interpret technical federal specifications and translate them into precise, unambiguous requirements * Strong logical reasoning. You're comfortable expressing rules as clear conditions (if/then logic, inclusion and exclusion criteria, date calculations) and working through edge cases methodically * Familiarity with testing and quality assurance practic onsumer Privacy Act ("CCPA").** Career Team is committed to complying with the CCPA and all data privacy and laws in the jurisdictions in which it recruits and hires employees. Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business\-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. Below are the categories of Personal Information we collect and the purposes for which we intend to use this information: **Identifying information**, such as your full name, gender, date of birth, and signature; **Demographic data**, such as race, ethnic origin, marital status, disability, and veteran or military status; **Contact information**, such as your home address, telephone numbers, email addresses, and emergency contact information; **Dependent's or other individual's information**, such as their full name, address, date of birth, and Social Security numbers (SSN); **National identifiers**, such as SSN, passport and visa information, and immigration status and documentation; **Educational and professional background**, such as your work history, academic and professional qualifications, educational records, references, and interview notes; **Employment details**, such as your job title, position, hire dates, compensation, performance and disciplinary records, and vacation and sick leave records; **Financial information**, such as banking details, tax information, payroll information, and withholdings; **Health and Safety information**, such as health conditions (if relevant to your employment), job restrictions, workplace illness and injury information, and health insurance policy information; **Information Systems (IS) information**, such as your search history, browsing history, login information, and IP addresses on the Company's information systems and networks; **Biometric information**, such as facial recognition, fingerprints, iris or retina scans, keystroke, or other physical patterns; and **Geolocation data**, such as time and physical location related to use of an internet website, application, device, or physical access to a Company office location. The Company collects Personal Information to use or disclose as appropriate to: (1\) Comply with all applicable laws and regulations; (2\) Recruit and evaluate job applicants and candidates for employment; (3\) Conduct background checks; (4\) Manage your employment relationship with us, including for: (a) onboarding processes; (b) timekeeping, payroll, and expense report administration; (c) employee benefits administration; (d) employee training and development requirements; (d) the creation, maintenance, and security of your online employee accounts; (e) reaching your emergency contacts when needed, such as when you are not reachable or are injured or ill; (f) workers' compensation claims management; (g) employee job performance, including goals and performance reviews, promotions, discipline, and termination; and (h) other human resources purposes; (5\) Manage and monitor employee access to company facilities, equipment, and systems; (6\) Conduct internal audits and workplace investigations; (7\) Investigate and enforce compliance with and potential breaches of Company policies and procedures; (8\) Engage in corporate transactions requiring review of employee records, such as for evaluating potential mergers and acquisitions of the Company; (9\) Maintain commercial insurance policies and coverages, including for workers' compensation and other liability insurance; (10\) Perform workforce analytics, data analytics, and benchmarking; (11\) Administer and maintain the Company's operations, including for safety purposes; (12\) For client marketing purposes; (13\) Exercise or defend the legal rights of the Company and its employees, and affiliates, customers, contractors, and agents; and (14\) to comply with requirements of government grants, including, but not limited to, program and audit requirements.

blockchain architectures (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Layer 2 solutions) and crypto wallet infrastructure. * Experience running blockchain infrastructure, not only deploying to it. jobs.description: **About Chartmetric** Chartmetric, Inc. is a 10\-year\-old startup specializing in music data analytics. We are trusted by Universal MusicGroup, Sony, Warner, and Apple Music, as well as hundreds of other music companies and industry professionals. Our team has created a self\-service data dashboard for the music industry to better understand the activity happening around artists. You’ll also build AI agents for internal workflows and customer\-facing product experiences. We’re looking for someone with strong technical judgment, broad engineering depth, and experience leading important projects from idea through production. **What you'll do*** Lead significant technical projects from architecture and design through deployment and production support * Use Claude Code, Codex, and AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining a high quality bar * Build AI\-powered product features and internal agents using RAG, prompts, tools, and evaluations * Design scalable APIs, services, and data\-intensive systems * Improve engineering productivity through reusable tooling, automation, and development workflows * Mentor teammates and contribute to architecture, code reviews, incident response, and engineering standards * Build and own full\-stack product features across React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS **Qualifications*** Strong senior\-level experience building and operating production software * Strong system design, debugging, testing, and production engineering skills * Strong ownership, product judgment, and ability to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions * Previous experience as a Tech Lead, project lead, or technical owner is strongly preferred * 6\+ years experience Bonus Points * Data Engineering experience with Python, ClickHouse, Snowflake, or Airflow * Experience building analytics or other data\-intensive products **The pay range for this role is:** 140,000 \- 160,000 USD per year(New York) 140,000 \- 160,000 USD per year(HQ)

jobs.title: AI Networking Hardware-Mechanical Technical Leader
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026This is an onsite position at the San Jose, CA location. Meet the Team Our team develops switching hardware for hyperscale AI data centers, connecting the large\-scale compute infrastructure used for AI training and inference. We bring mechanical design and electronic hardware together across component, printed circuit board (PCB), and system interfaces, working with specialist engineering teams to turn requirements into integrated products. Depending on the assignment, the work may extend from semiconductor packaging and substrates to cooling hardware and complete system assemblies. We collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing teams throughout development, verification, and production. As a Mechanical Engineering Technical Leader, you will combine design with technical decisions that shape how future Cisco networking hardware comes together. Your Impact * Define mechanical architectures and interface requirements for assigned switching hardware, translating product requirements into concepts and specifications that balance electronic packaging constraints, manufacturability, and cost. * Lead mechanical design decisions and technical reviews, working with silicon, signal integrity, power, board\-layout, electronics, and thermal engineers to evaluate tradeoffs, resolve interface requirements, and document the engineering basis for major decisions. * Verify mechanical designs through prototypes and testing, investigate failures and root causes, and close design issues by reviewing results against requirements and incorporating needed changes into the design. * Develop part and assembly CAD models, engineering drawings, and tolerance analyses to establish mechanical interfaces and assembly fit, so designs can be prototyped, assembled, and verified against requirements. * Deliver manufacturable designs and work with suppliers and manufacturing teams through production to resolve fabrication, assembly, and material issues, incorporating design for manufacturing early in development and evaluating processes that improve product cost or manufacturability. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years of related experience, master’s degree with 6\+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3\+ years of related experience. * Experience designing and integrating mechanical assemblies for electronic hardware, such as board\-level assemblies or system packaging. * Expertise in mechanical CAD for developing part and assembly models. * Experience creating engineering drawings and performing tolerance analysis for mechanical assemblies. * Experience leading mechanical design decisions and resolving interface requirements across engineering teams, such as electrical, thermal, or board\-layout engineering. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing networking, server, high\-performance computing, or data\-center hardware. * Experience with semiconductor packaging, substrates, or mechanical integration of ASIC packages, PCBs, or high\-speed interconnects. * Experience in one or more supporting areas: liquid\-cooling integration, electronics thermal management, or structural analysis using finite element analysis (FEA). * Experience with design for manufacturing, supplier collaboration, or production introduction for electronic hardware. * Experience mentoring engineers or coordinating technical work across multiple engineering teams or product programs. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. We collaborate closely with many partners, including the Houston Planning and Development Department, METRO transit agency, Harris County, private developers, contractors, and neighborhood associations to ensure that projects are coordinated.
