jobs.title: GIS Developer
jobs.description: **ABOUT CIVILGRID** CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer. Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000\+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain\-of\-custody documentation. Teams at PG\&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig\-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running. We're a venture\-backed Series A startup tackling a $4\.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10\+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for. **WHY THIS ROLE** We are seeking a GIS Developer with deep expertise in python and spatial data engineering to design, build, and optimize geospatial workflows. You’ll play a critical role in our utility database footprint expansion, updating ETL workflows, and improving general data processes. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown Kansas City, MO office with 2 days a week onsite. The role reports to our Director of GIS. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Generating internal tools to help our GIS Analysts perform their daily tasks * Create, update, manage, and use spatial ETL pipelines connecting Esri, PostGIS, and open\-source environments * Design and develop Python\-based geoprocessing tools and automation scripts using both Esri and open\-source GIS libraries. * Build and maintain RESTful APIs and web applications that integrate spatial data and visualization tools for internal use * Assist in database footprint expansion via building tools that help us gain efficiencies * QA/QC of converted GIS data **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * Bachelor’s Degree in GIS adjacent field (GIS, Geography, Environmental Science, Computer Science, etc.) * 3\-5 years of professional experience in GIS development or spatial data engineering; preferably with ESRI or QGIS * Experience with ArcGIS Server * Expert proficiency in Python with libraries such as ArcPy, GeoPandas, Shapely, Fiona, Rasterio, PyProj * Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS and SQL query optimization * Proficiency with github * Familiarity with web development frameworks (Flask, Streamlit), front\-end technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS), and AI web development * Detail\-oriented and self\-motivated, with the ability to operate independently while working remotely **BONUS POINTS** * Experience working with utilities and/or government agencies * Experience with Leaflet, Mapbox GL JS, or ArcGIS API for JavaScript * Experience with geoparquet, duckDB, and other open source data formats * Experience with AutoDesk and Microstation **HOW WE WORK** We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in\-person collaboration where it matters and remote\-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** **The base salary range for this role is** *$100,000 – $117,000* Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early\-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category\-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location. In addition to base and equity, we offer: * Company\-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including plans for all 3 at no cost to the employee * FSA (health and dependent care) * Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it * 401(k) plan * Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment * A high\-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help. Compensation Range: $100K \- $118K

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - Part-time position
jobs.description: About the Role T. Mark Fay Consulting, Inc. (Claim Toolkit) builds software that enterprise property and casualty carriers across the US and Canada rely on for claims audit, compliance, total loss, and auto liability work. We are hiring a full\-time, remote, US\-based Full Stack Developer. You will be the in\-house technical owner of our production applications. That means keeping them running, secure, and compliant day to day, delivering enhancements our carrier clients request, and helping lead the modernization of our legacy Classic ASP applications. You will work alongside a small internal team and our external development partner, with wide latitude to design, build, test, and release your solutions. Products You Will Support You will support all four Claim Toolkit product lines, with the heaviest day\-to\-day load in Total Loss and Compliance. * **Total Loss:** calculates state\-specific taxes and fees on total loss vehicle settlements. Main touchpoints are monthly tax and fee updates, state programming, vendor rate issues, new clients, Notice to Owner, and form letters. * **Compliance:** tracks claims handling against state regulatory requirements. Main touchpoints are MFA and login reporting, SSO, new customer setup, and enhancements such as an interest calculator. * **Audit:** supports carrier claim file audits. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. * **Auto Liability:** supports auto liability claim evaluation. Main touchpoints are SFTP, Guidewire integration, SSO, enhancements, and product redesign. Key Responsibilities **Production support and incidents (all products)** * Own incident response for all products, including 500 errors and failed scheduled jobs, with same\-day diagnosis and resolution * Write programming specs in real time when issues are found, and follow them through to release * Manage the code deployment and release process * Keep UAT documentation current, including server screenshots * Contribute to hardware and infrastructure discussions **Total Loss system** * Complete monthly tax and fee updates and program future\-dated changes * Program state\-specific rules in CORE and maintain them as regulations change * When tax rate issues surface, retrieve XML files and work directly with vendors such as Thomson Reuters to investigate * Set up new clients, modify vehicle types and categories, and add user access for select clients * Maintain address validation, form letters, and Notice to Owner PDFs * Rotate Dealertrack/Vitu credentials securely * Produce client tax and fee reports on request (for example, all first\-party claims finalized in a date range, with all taxes and fees) * Explain how calculations are programmed so internal staff can answer client questions * Support billing setup, invoices, and billing\-related emails **Security and compliance** * Prepare for and respond to the annual penetration test, and implement remediation * Keep MFA compliance reporting accurate and troubleshoot compliance reports * Research enterprise SSO gaps, such as logins not captured when users reach Compliance through Total Loss * Evaluate and, if approved, implement the Shibboleth upgrade * Finish the WAF (Sucuri) rollout: confirm which sites are protected, add the remaining sites, and update .asp pages to prevent false blocking * Set up new Compliance customers, in\-house and external, using the onboarding checklist **Integrations, SSO, and SFTP** * Install and maintain SSO for all products, including annual certificate renewals, and coordinate rollouts with developers * Manage SFTP and Guidewire integrations for Audit and Auto Liability **Enhancements** * Review enhancement requests with the Account Manager and help set priorities * Define and run the enhancement process: intake, mockup, customer approval, customer review, build, release * Build project timelines and keep work on schedule **Product modernization** * Help choose the target language and framework for rewriting legacy products, working with outside experts as needed * Redesign products collaboratively with the team, translate designs into clear specs, and build with the development team **Customers and team** * Work directly with new and existing carrier clients when technical context is needed * Mentor assigned team members and attend meetings as needed Technical Qualifications **Required** * Hands\-on production experience with Classic ASP/VBScript, plus ASP.NET, React and C\#,GitHub * Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, jobs, and database design * SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Integration Services (SSIS) for reports and automated data imports * JavaScript, jQuery, and React for front\-end work * RESTful API design and integration * SSO implementation and certificate management (SAML, Shibboleth, or similar) * IIS and Windows Server administration, including SFTP * Full software development life cycle: requirements, specs, development, testing, deployment, and support * Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues quickly **Preferred** * Node.js or other modern React frameworks * Experience modernizing or rewriting legacy applications * Web application firewall (WAF) configuration, MFA, and penetration test remediation * Guidewire integrations * P\&C insurance or claims industry experience, especially total loss taxes and fees or state regulatory rules The Successful Candidate The right person is accurate, transparent about status, and disciplined about process, because our carrier clients depend on calculations and compliance data being right the first time. * **Accurate and honest about status.** You report exactly where work stands, including what is not done or not yet validated. You never present something as complete before it is. * **Respects the QA process.** Every fix goes through QA before anyone tells a client it is resolved. You keep incidents assigned and tracked through resolution. * **Flags blockers early.** If testing is incomplete or something is blocking a release, you say so the same day rather than leaving it for someone to discover. * **Precise with regulated logic.** You treat tax, fee, and compliance calculations as near\-zero\-error work and test against every affected state, client, and vehicle type. * **Documents as you go.** You comment code to our standard, write clear specs and procedures, and turn undocumented knowledge of state rules and client setups into written reference material. * **Security\-minded.** You handle credentials, certificates, and server access carefully and raise anything that looks wrong, such as unexpected remote access or unfamiliar IPs. * **Responsive with clients and vendors.** You engage directly with client questions and vendor escalations instead of passing them along, and you write in plain, direct language that leaves a clear paper trail. * **Applies feedback.** You take feedback, change how you work, and do not repeat the same issue. * **Flexible and organized.** You shift priorities when a production issue lands and still manage scope and timelines on longer projects. * **Curious about AI and automation.** You are comfortable using AI tools in development and interested in our work on automated reporting, natural language queries, and AI\-assisted workflows. * **Lives our core values:** Excellence, Challenging Goals, and Kindness. Work Requirements This role must be US\-based and available during US business hours, because production issues and client escalations need same\-day response. * Must reside and work in the United States; some client contracts require US\-based development * Available during core US business hours for incidents, vendor calls, and client escalations * Able to respond to production issues, such as a 500 error at 2:00 PM, the same day * Willing to pass a background check and follow our data access, credential, and security policies, since the role involves sensitive client data and production system access Benefits and How to Apply * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off * Holiday Paid time off * Fully remote work Send your resume to Info@ClaimToolkit.com. Strong candidates will be invited to a conversation and a real\-world business and technical skills test. Pay: $46\.49 \- $62\.50 per hour Expected hours: No less than 15\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * Bereavement leave * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid jury duty * Paid time off * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Compute and Platform Recovery Architect
jobs.description: Job Title: Compute and Platform Recovery Sr. Staff Engineer Location: Milpitas or Irvine (2\-3 days hybrid) Duration: 6 months (Contract to Hire) **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * **Design the recovery topology.** Active, active and active, passive cluster design across two production data centres, so that node, cluster and site failure are survivable inside the committed recovery window for tier one compute. * **Own dual site compute.** Own the compute layer of the dual data centre design so that either site can carry full factory load. * **Protect virtualisation continuity.** Recovery design for the virtualisation estate, including platform transition risk. Recovery must hold through a hypervisor or licensing change rather than break because of one. * **Solve high performance compute continuity.** Define what recovery actually means for high performance compute, where classical disaster recovery assumptions fail. Decide what is recovered, what is rebuilt, and what is deliberately accepted as loss. * **Produce the evidence.** Design and execute compute recovery tests against the committed window, and produce the evidence pack that supports enterprise readiness reporting. * **Scale the reference model.** Carry the compute reference model into additional manufacturing sites as the programme extends across the region. * **Direct without managing.** Set and enforce compute resilience requirements for the managed service provider in region, validate delivered service directly, and provide technical direction and mentoring to compute and data centre engineers. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS***We are looking for the right capability rather than a specific number of years. The experience indication below is typical, not a filter; an engineer who has genuinely done this work in less time will be considered.* * Typically ten or more years in infrastructure engineering, with deep hands on virtualisation and enterprise compute. * You have personally designed and executed a multi site compute failover, with evidenced results against a defined recovery objective. Authoring a plan does not meet this bar. * Real depth in clustering, hypervisor level high availability, storage attached compute dependencies, and the genuine failure modes of each. * Credible in at least one adjacent domain: storage, network or cloud. * You have set a technical standard that other teams adopted without reporting to you. * Able to operate with substantial autonomy at distance from your reporting line. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Semiconductor, or another continuous operations manufacturing environment where downtime carries direct production cost. * High performance or engineering compute exposure. * Hypervisor platform migration at enterprise scale. * Effective working across United States and Asia time zones without losing influence. Pay: $85\.00 \- $90\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Typically ten or more years in infrastructure engineering, with deep hands on virtualisation and enterprise compute. * You have personally designed and executed a multi site compute failover, with evidenced results against a defined recovery objective. jobs.title: Data and Cyber Recovery Architect
jobs.description: **Data and Cyber Recovery Arch/Sr. Staff Engineer** **Location: Milpitas or Irvine** **2\-3 days hybrid** **ABOUT THE ROLE** This role answers the hardest question an executive can ask: after a destructive cyber event, what exactly can we get back, how fast, and how do we know. You own the engineering of immutable backup, isolated recovery environments and orchestrated restore for tier one systems. The capability has to be engineered to a recovery objective rather than procured to a vendor feature list. You will own the technical evaluation and recommendation for the cyber recovery platform, and then build and prove the capability you recommended. Proof is a successful restore. It is never a successful backup job. You will be building something that does not exist here today, which is the appeal of the role and also the difficulty of it. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * **Architect cyber recovery.** Immutable backup, air gapped or logically isolated vaulting, and the clean room recovery environment in which tier one systems are rebuilt after a destructive event. * **Own the platform decision.** Lead the technical evaluation and recommendation for the cyber recovery platform, on engineering merit against recovery objectives. * **Sequence the restore.** Recovery sequencing across the dependency chain. Identity and management planes before the workloads that depend on them. * **Set the backup standard.** Define the retention and immutability standard the storage and backup team builds to. * **Engineer data tier resilience.** Replication, high availability and recovery point design across two production data centres for the data underpinning factory critical systems. * **Run the restore yourself.** Engineer the capability and personally execute the clean room restore, producing evidence that holds up to audit scrutiny. * **Hold suppliers to the objective.** Hold vendors and the managed service provider to the recovery objectives directly, and provide technical direction to storage and backup engineers. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** *We are looking for the right capability rather than a specific number of years. The experience indication below is typical, not a filter; an engineer who has genuinely done this work in less time will be considered. The cyber recovery requirement below is the exception and is not negotiable.* * Typically ten or more years in data protection, storage and recovery engineering at enterprise scale. * Direct hands on experience engineering cyber recovery: immutable backup, an isolated recovery environment, and orchestrated restore following a destructive event. This requirement is not negotiable. * You have executed a full scale recovery exercise and produced evidence against a defined recovery objective. * Database resilience fluency: replication, high availability, and recovery point trade offs. * You can present a technical risk position to executive and audit level audiences without softening it. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * You have worked a real ransomware or destructive event recovery. * Manufacturing environment with production cost downtime exposure. * Recognised external standing in data protection or cyber recovery. **LEVEL EXPECTATIONS** * Works across teams on ambiguous problems that have no established playbook. * Leads adoption of a technology capability the organisation does not currently hold. * Establishes standards that are adopted beyond the immediate team. Pay: $90\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Milpitas, CA 95036

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check\-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore. We are customer\-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are. It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. But most of the people who need us have never heard of us. By the end of 2027, we expect half of America's seniors will know who we are. You will be the author of what they see. This isn't about directing a campaign. It's about building a courageous, iconic household brand close to scratch, with real budget and real creative license behind you. We aren't trying to rent attention. We want the kind of organic awareness that comes from people recognizing us, remembering us, and telling each other about us. If that's what you want to spend the next few years on, we'd love to talk. **What you'll own** ------------------- * You will set our creative direction as we scale from \<10% of American seniors and their families knowing about us to \>50% in 2027\. That’s millions of impressions. Super\-bowl\-commercial scale. * You'll decide how Community Phone looks everywhere it shows up: TV, paid social, web, direct mail, the box, and our social channels. A family should recognize the same brand whether they see us at 9pm on TV or open the box at mom's house. * You will be the steward of our brand, ensuring all platforms, from paid ads to customer newsletters, meet our brand standards. * You'll take the brand identity system our design agency is launching in mid\-October and make it world\-class. Their work is the starting point. Scaling it across every surface and pushing it further is your job. * You'll do the real work yourself. You'll design the website, the box, and the pieces that define us, and you'll be excited to make things rather than just advise on them. * You'll build the creative machine for paid social and guarantee the quality of its output. * You'll own creative performance alongside growth. Beautiful work that doesn't move CAC isn't done yet. * You'll build the team that scales the brand with you. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * You have 8\+ years in creative direction, and you've built a phenomenal consumer brand. * You have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative work across digital, retail, social, packaging, experiential, film, photography, and product storytelling. * You have both agency and in\-house experience. You know how to get great work out of a studio, and you know what it takes to live with a brand every day. * You grew up on the visual side of creative direction (art direction, design, motion), and you have real experience leading copy and concept too. * You still love making the work. Your best days are the ones where you're designing, not sitting in review meetings. * You believe in the power of AI in creative work. You use it every day, you know where it makes the work better, and you're excited about what it makes possible next. * You've made creative that performs at scale, ideally across TV, paid social, and physical. * You have experience managing production budgets, agencies, freelancers, and complex creative programs. * You have excellent taste. * You have superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. Great creative reveals truths that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as a pursuit of beauty. The people who can do it seem to possess these three qualities to a high degree. * You have the judgment to operate as the entire creative function today, and you want to push and be pushed by the growth team. **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've designed packaging and unboxing for a consumer hardware or DTC product. * You've worked on eldercare, health\-adjacent, or other trust\-sensitive consumer brands. **How we work** --------------- We're a fast\-growing, YC\-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to our Cofounder who runs Revenue and Operations, and you'll have a very direct line from your work to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right. **How to apply** ---------------- Send us your portfolio, including the consumer brand you're proudest of building and what happened to it in market. Tell us briefly why building a brand for this kind of customer is interesting to you.

jobs.title: Network Design Engineer

compliance — not day\-to\-day operation of a vessel's IT systems post\-delivery. **Key Responsibilities** **Network Architecture \& Design** * Design IP network topology, VLAN segmentation, and multicast routing (IGMP/PIM) for AV and broadcast traffic, and specify switches, routers, and fiber/copper infrastructure sized for AV\-over\-IP protocols (SMPTE ST 2110, QLAN, Dante, NDI) * Engineer QoS/traffic prioritization and PTP timing/synchronization to support real\-time, low\-latency media flows **Redundancy \& Standards Compliance** * Design resilient, redundant network paths (e.g., SMPTE 2022\-7 style dual\-path protection) for mission\-critical broadcast and production traffic * Design network segmentation and produce topology documentation that clearly demarcates the AV/broadcast network from the vessel's safety\-critical OT systems, supporting the ship's overall IACS UR E26/E27 compliance **Newbuild \& Refit Execution** * Produce network architecture diagrams, IP addressing schemas, and port/cable schedules for shipyard installation teams * Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, and sea trials — verifying multicast flows, latency, and redundancy failover performance **Documentation \& Coordination** * Maintain as\-built network documentation and asset inventories to support class and cybersecurity requirements * Define integration and handoff points with the vessel's core IT/OT network, coordinating with (not operating) the owner's IT infrastructure team **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years designing IP networks specifically for AV, broadcast, or media production environments — not general enterprise IT/network administration * Strong grounding in network fundamentals: VLAN segmentation, multicast routing, QoS/traffic prioritization, redundant topology design * Familiarity with AV\-over\-IP standards and protocols (SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022\-7, AES67, QLAN, Dante, NDI) * Ability to produce network architecture diagrams, IP addressing schemas, and port/cable schedules * Willingness and ability to travel (10\-25%), including international shipyards * Valid passport or ability to obtain a passport as a condition of employment **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience in cruise (newbuild or refit) or themed entertainment industries. * Familiarity with IACS UR E26/E27 cyber resilience requirements, particularly how they drive network segmentation and boundary documentation between IT/entertainment networks and OT/safety\-critical systems * Vendor certifications relevant to AV/media networking (e.g., SDVoE, Cisco, Arista, Audinate Dante) Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description: **Join Our Community** At Crutchfield, our innovative company culture is centered around helping our employees succeed while delivering best\-in\-class service to our customers. We’re looking for a Senior UX Designer (Design \& Front\-End Development) to join our team based in our Charlottesville location. If you haven’t heard of us, we’re a unique blend of things: an acclaimed, national online retailer, a family\-owned business that’s Virginia\-based, and a community\-oriented group of consumer electronics enthusiasts. In short, we sell fun stuff and love doing it! For the 4th year in a row, we’ve been named as one of the ***Best Places to Work*** by Virginia Business Magazine and Best Companies Group. **Position Overview:** Crutchfield is seeking a Senior UX Designer (Design \& Front\-End Development) to create intuitive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. Our UX team designs and maintains customer and employee experiences across Crutchfield’s digital ecosystem, including eCommerce websites and internal applications. Successful candidates can balance customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, and accessibility considerations while helping teams move from ideas to shipped experiences. This hybrid role blends UX design, front\-end implementation, and cross\-functional collaboration throughout the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving customer problems, collaborating across disciplines, and bringing designs to life through code. **As a Senior UX Designer you will:** * Partner with business stakeholders, Portfolio Owners, Full\-Stack Developers, UX Researchers, UX Strategists, product experts, and domain experts to understand customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints. * Create user flows, information architecture, customer journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs using Figma. * Analyze insights from user research, usability testing, analytics, and stakeholder feedback to inform design decisions. * Support UX Research partners with usability test planning, discussion guides, observation sessions, and synthesis of findings. * Translate design concepts into front\-end code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related technologies. * Contribute production\-ready front\-end code and collaborate with developers to maintain implementation quality. * Help evolve design systems, reusable patterns, UX standards, and front\-end implementation guidelines. * Support and maintain responsive digital experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms. * Advocate for accessibility and inclusive design throughout the product development lifecycle. * Facilitate collaborative design discussions, workshops, reviews, and stakeholder alignment sessions. * Participate in Agile ceremonies including planning, refinement, retrospectives, and design reviews. * Create clear documentation and communicate design decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Technologies You'll Work With:** * Figma * Miro * HTML * CSS / SASS * JavaScript * Vue * TypeScript (preferred) * Azure DevOps Our digital ecosystem includes both modern and legacy applications. UX Designers regularly contribute front\-end code and collaborate closely with developers, but prior experience with C\#, ASP.NET, or other backend technologies is not required. **Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of professional UX design experience within a software development organization. * Proficiency with Figma and modern UX design practices. * Experience creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs. * Experience designing and validating responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms. * Demonstrated experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to maintain and enhance production web experiences. * Familiarity with CSS preprocessors such as SASS. * Familiarity working within modern front\-end frameworks such as Vue and component\-based design systems. * Experience working directly with software development teams throughout the design, implementation, and release lifecycle. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies. * Familiarity with digital accessibility principles and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). * Excellent communication and presentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience contributing front\-end code within a production software environment. * Experience evaluating, designing, reviewing, or testing accessible digital experiences. * Familiarity with TypeScript. * Experience contributing to design systems or reusable component libraries. * Experience using Miro or similar collaboration tools. * Experience designing eCommerce, retail, or other complex transactional experiences. * Experience participating in usability testing activities and applying research findings to design decisions. This position follows a hybrid work model, with **3 days onsite each week** and the remaining days remote. Candidates should be able to commute to our office regularly and collaborate in person with team members. All remote work must be done within the Commonwealth of Virginia. We are unable to offer sponsorship or relocation assistance for this position. **Salary and Benefits:** The starting salary range for this role is $85,000 \- $105,000 depending on skills and experience. This full\-time position comes with a comprehensive benefit package including two health insurance plans to choose from along with dental and vision insurance plan options. We also offer a competitive wellness program, tuition reimbursement, 401K retirement plan, relaxed dress code, and discounts on the fun stuff we sell. All full\-time employees are also offered: short\-term disability insurance and long\-term disability insurance options, employer\-paid life insurance and voluntary life insurance options, including those for spouse and children. FSA and HSA options are also available. Ask us about these benefits in your interview \- we're glad to provide details! For any questions or inquiries about this position, please contact our recruiting team at (434\) 218\-6046\. Crutchfield is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ethnic origin, religion/belief, disability, veteran status, or age. \#Crutchfield

jobs.title: Electrical Schematic/PCB Design Engineer (Semiconductor Test Hardware)
jobs.description: **About the role:** We’re looking for an engineer who can translate customer inputs—Word specs, Excel netlists/BOMs, interface requirements, and legacy drawings—into robust **electrical schematics** that drive high‑quality **PCB designs** for semiconductor test hardware (probe, final test load boards, interface/fixture boards, handler interface, and related assemblies). You’ll own schematic capture and collaborate closely with PCB layout, mechanical, test, and manufacturing partners to deliver first‑pass success on fast‑moving customer programs. **What you’ll do:** * Own schematic capture **from ambiguous or mixed customer inputs; clarify requirements, define architecture, and drive parts selection and library needs.** * **Create well‑constrained designs** that account for ATE realities (signal integrity, crosstalk, leakage, guarding/guard rings, Kelvin connections, relay/mux topologies, pogo/contactor constraints, ESD, thermal). * **Partner with PCB layout** to enforce design rules for high‑density, high‑pin‑count boards (fan‑out, length/phase matching, differential pairs, controlled impedance, reference plane strategy, return current). * **Generate and maintain deliverables**: schematics, netlists, constraints, design notes, BOMs, test points, release packages, and ECOs. * **Interface with customers** (design reviews, DFM/DFT tradeoffs, risk/mitigation plans) and internal cross‑functional teams (ME, Test, Supply Chain, CM). * **Shepherd designs through build**: fab/assembly bring‑up support, issue triage, corrective actions, and documentation updates. * **Continuously improve** our libraries, checklists, and design standards for ATE hardware. **Required qualifications:** * 3–8\+ years **in electrical design for** PCB‑based products**; at least** 2\+ years **specifically in** semiconductor test hardware **or** high‑density mixed‑signal boards **(probe/final test, load boards, DUT/contactor boards, or similar).** * **Schematic capture proficiency** in multiple CAD environments, including **Cadence Allegro/Concept HDL** **OrCad** and **Altium Designer** (you can interpret and adapt across tools). * Strong grasp of **signal integrity** and **power integrity** fundamentals: termination, return paths, reference plane stitching, decoupling strategy, controlled impedance, crosstalk mitigation. * Experience with **mixed‑signal** and **low‑leakage/low‑noise** design (sensor or precision analog helpful), **switch/mux/relay** trees, level shifting, protection, and **EMC/ESD** practices. * Comfortable reading/creating **BOMs, netlists, constraints**, and coordinating part selections with the library/CM team (second sources, lifecycles, lead times). * Ability to convert **informal customer artifacts** (spreadsheets, drawings, legacy PDFs) into a **clean, reviewable schematic** with clear notes/assumptions. * Excellent documentation, version control, and **ECO discipline**; clear, concise communication with customers and vendors. **Nice to have:** * **Background in** ATE platforms **(e.g., Advantest, Teradyne) and** DUT/socket/contactor **constraints.** * Experience with **high‑current power distribution**, **RF/coax routing basics**, or **wide‑bandwidth measurement paths**. * Familiarity with **DFM/DFT for probe and final test**: stacking height, planarity, warpage, fiducials, test access, probe card specifics. * Prior work with **constraint‑driven flows** (rules for length/phase, topology, via budgets) and **SI/PI simulation** tools (e.g., Sigrity, HyperLynx). * Scripting/automation for CAD (Altium scripts, SKILL, Python) and **PLM/ERP** integration. * Experience collaborating with **overseas layout partners** or CMs and doing supplier bring‑up. **What success looks like in 30 days:** * **You’ve shipped at least one schematic package from customer inputs to layout handoff with** zero critical ECOs**.** * You’ve introduced at least one **library or checklist improvement** that reduces review time or rework. * You’re the **go‑to** for translating messy specs into **clear, test‑ready schematics**. **Compensation \& benefits:** * Competitive salary with performance bonus; 401(k) with match; paid time off and holidays. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Do you have at least 3 years of experience in electrical design for PCB\-based products, with at least 2 of those years specifically in semiconductor test hardware or high\-density mixed\-signal boards? * Do you have proficiency with schematic capture in multiple CAD environments, including Cadence Allegro/Concept HDL, OrCad, and Altium Designer? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers' most difficult problems. We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications. **The Role:** The Datacor Engineering Software Group (DESG) is seeking a curious, motivated early\-career Software Engineer to join our Flow Simulation team and help build the future of our software. You will work on Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream, our industry\-leading fluid flow simulation applications, which engineers around the world use to design and analyze piping systems, from steady\-state operation to transient events like a pump trip. This is a generalist role for someone with a solid computer science foundation who wants to grow into a well\-rounded engineer. There are no skill silos here: you will work across the whole application, from user interface and application logic to data models, file formats, integrations, and the tooling that builds and tests it all. A structured onboarding plan and an experienced teammate will guide your first weeks, and you will take on more ownership as you grow. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain features across all layers of our Windows desktop applications, working from requirements with guidance from senior engineers. * Diagnose and fix defects anywhere in the codebase, including customer\-reported issues escalated from our Support team. * Contribute to internal tooling, build automation, CI/CD pipelines, and test infrastructure. * Take part in our ongoing modernization, including new architecture and user interface frameworks. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback. * Share team responsibilities such as build pipeline and bug\-triage rotations. * Collaborate with engineers, QA, Product Management, and domain experts to deliver solutions that meet user needs. * Stay on top of industry trends, and use modern tools, including AI coding assistants, responsibly to continuously improve your skillset. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **If you are an internal applicant, please log into Workday and submit your application via the Jobs Hub.** Join the Discovery family, where quality and service are at the heart of everything we do! **This role will be located at one of Discovery Land Company’s Corporate Office locations in Beverly Hills, California.** **Discovery Land Company** is seeking a full\-time, year\-round **Principal AI Engineer** to join the **Artificial Intelligence** Department. **Job Summary:** Discovery Land Company (DLC) develops and operates private club communities across the U.S. and internationally. DLC's AI team builds the platforms, agents, and workflows that help corporate and club teams work faster with less manual effort. The Principal AI Engineer is the senior technical leader for DLC's AI program, reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence. You will co\-own DLC's AI strategy and roadmap with the VP of AI, set the technical direction and engineering standards for all AI solutions, and own the highest\-impact AI use cases end to end: scope the business problem with department leaders, design the solution, build it, ship it, and measure the hours saved. Time will be split across technical strategy and standards, product ownership, and hands\-on engineering. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Set Technical Direction and Standards: + Co\-own DLC's AI strategy and 1\-year and 3\-year roadmap with the VP of AI, including platform choices and investment priorities. + Define and own DLC's AI reference architecture across agents, MCP integrations, retrieval, and Microsoft 365 automation. + Set and enforce engineering standards for evaluation, logging, guardrails, security, and code review across all production AI solutions. + Lead technical evaluation and selection of AI platforms, models, and vendors. + Mentor engineers and Department AI Leads, and serve as final technical reviewer on AI solution designs. * Own Product Delivery: + Partner with departments across DLC to identify and prioritize use cases by hours saved and risk. + Write clear requirements, success metrics, and solution plans for each AI use case. + Manage the backlog and maintain a consistent delivery cadence. * Drive Adoption: + Deliver training, documentation, and feedback loops for end users at the corporate and club levels. + Track adoption metrics and use them to improve deployed solutions. * Build and Deploy AI Solutions: + Build agents, skills, and automations on Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, Claude API, and Claude Agent SDK). + Build and maintain MCP server integrations that connect Claude to business systems (CRM, marketing automation, ERP, and document stores). + Build workflows in n8n and/or Microsoft Power Automate and Copilot Studio, integrated with SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Outlook via Microsoft Graph. + Build retrieval and knowledge base solutions on Microsoft 365 and related tooling. + Implement evaluation, logging, and guardrails for all production AI solutions. * Co\-lead AI Governance and Security: + Follow DLC data classification rules and ensure member, guest, and employee data is handled under the strictest applicable privacy standard (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA). + Lead technical vendor security reviews for new AI tools and connectors. * What Success Looks Like: + First 6 months - Ship 3 or more production AI use cases with documented hours saved. - Define reusable MCP and Power Automate integration patterns that scale across properties and publish them as DLC standards. - Track adoption metrics and report them monthly to the VP of AI. - Publish DLC's AI reference architecture and engineering standards, applied to all new AI builds. Deliver the technical portion of DLC's 1\-year and 3\-year AI roadmap jointly with the VP of AI. - **Skills \& Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of combined experience in software engineering and product management, including at least 3 years shipping LLM\-based products or internal tools to production. * Hands\-on production experience with Claude and the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude Code, the Claude API (tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs), MCP, and Agent Skills. * Strong experience with the Microsoft 365 stack: Entra ID, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and Teams. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL. * Experience integrating enterprise SaaS platforms via REST APIs and connectors. * Track record of translating ambiguous business requests into shipped solutions with measurable outcomes. * Demonstrated ownership of technical strategy, reference architecture, or engineering standards adopted across multiple teams or business units. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews. * Clear written communication for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience with Oracle CX (Sales Cloud, Eloqua), Sage Intacct, or CData Connect AI preferred. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Power BI, or Dataverse preferred. * AWS experience (Bedrock, IAM, Lambda) preferred. * Experience with RAG, evaluation frameworks, and LLM observability. * Background in hospitality, real estate, or multi\-site operations preferred. Experience building internal AI training or enablement programs preferred. * **Additional Requirements:** * Flexibility and ability to pivot to new projects and desire to work in fast\-paced environment. * Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to deliver service to members, guests, and team members. * Ability to work in a team environment. * Ability to stay calm and focused during the busiest of times. * Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English; additional languages preferred. * Must be able to work flexible work hours/schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Long hours may be required due to business demands. Ability to meet the physical demands of the position including, but not limited to, working indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, standing, walking, and moving for periods of greater than eight (8\) hours, and lifting and carrying items sometimes greater than fifty (50\) pounds. * **Benefits** * Competitive Pay * Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits * 401k Contribution * Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays * Employee Meals, Referral Incentives, and Recognition Programs * Holiday Pay * Professional development and upward mobility opportunities Work\-Family Culture * Discovery Land Company's good faith estimate of the salary range it reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire is $250k plus bonus. **About Us** Discovery Land Company is a U.S.\-based real estate developer and operator of private residential communities with a world\-renowned portfolio of domestic and international properties. The mission of Discovery Land Company is to create one\-of\-a\-kind environments that provide individuals and families the freedom, security, and resources to learn, grow, and play in some of the most beautiful places in the world. For more information about our company, please visit: http://www.discoverylandco.com .

jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager
jobs.description: **Location** Our Scaled Account Manager will be an integral part of DoiT's Account Management organization in AMER. This role is remote and open to candidates located in North America. **Who We Are** DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud\-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state \- from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. **The Opportunity** DoiT's Account Management team is responsible for retaining and growing our existing customer base by building trusted relationships, identifying high\-value opportunities for deeper engagement, and serving as a strategic point of contact for cloud\-provider teams supporting customer growth. The team's goal is to protect 100% of existing business while identifying customers with the strongest potential for expansion, advocacy, and long\-term partnership. As a Scaled Account Manager, you will own the commercial relationship and customer strategy across a large portfolio of primarily SMB and mid\-market accounts. You will use an efficient, repeatable coverage model to identify and prioritize customers who are scaling quickly, developing larger cloud and technology footprints, or showing a need for deeper technical engagement. You will focus your time where DoiT can create the greatest impact—whether that means expanding the current relationship, integrating additional cloud or technology environments not yet managed through DoiT, or introducing standalone DoiT products that address clear customer needs. You will act as the business lead for your portfolio, combining account insight, commercial judgment, and customer discovery to uncover qualified growth opportunities. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, DoiT specialists, and cloud\-provider teams to understand customers' evolving environments, align DoiT's expertise and products to their priorities, and help them make better decisions about their cloud strategy. Success means protecting the existing business, identifying high\-growth customers early, increasing adoption of DoiT's products and expertise, expanding DoiT's role across customers' broader technology footprints, and creating durable commercial growth through both integrated services and standalone product placement. **Responsibilities** * Own a scaled portfolio primarily in the SMB and mid\-market segments, using Salesforce to maintain customer context, stakeholders, priorities, risks, opportunities, renewals, and next steps. * Use data to prioritize engagement across the portfolio, focusing on high\-potential and at\-risk accounts; build multi\-threaded relationships and understand each customer's business priorities, cloud footprint, FinOps maturity, and desired outcomes. * Drive retention and renewal outcomes by identifying risk early, coordinating mitigation plans, and leading commercial conversations with internal partners on pricing, commitments, contracts, and approvals. * Identify, qualify, and manage expansion pipeline across new workloads, migrations, cost optimization, managed commitments, DoiT products, and services; maintain accurate opportunity stages and forecasts. * Partner with Sales, CSMs, FDEs, DoiT specialists, and cloud\-provider teams on account plans, funding, deal registration, and execution, delegating delivery work while owning the commercial relationship. * Run portfolio\-appropriate customer cadences, including account and FinOps reviews, product demonstrations, commitment planning, security and AI discussions, onboarding, and escalation reviews. * Coordinate escalations to the right DoiT owner, keeping customers informed and driving accountability through resolution. * Use customer data, dashboards, CRM workflows, and appropriate AI or automation tools to improve coverage and create repeatable operating rhythms. * Capture and share actionable customer feedback, product requests, and market insights with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales. * Maintain account reviews and plans for priority and high\-potential customers, tracking outcomes, engagement, spend trends, risks, renewal timing, and growth plans. **Qualifications** * 2\+ years of experience in an Account Management/Customer Success/Customer Engineering role * 3\+ years of experience in a technology company * Strong verbal/written communication skills in English * Strong technical skills that enable you to engage productively with technical teams and the ability to build influential relationships * Great operational/administration skills, analytical, detail\-oriented and able to "zoom" in/out from the big picture to the minutiae * A desire to grow within the organization and continuously broaden your skill sets * A great sense of humor and enjoys having fun at work **Bonus Points** * Experience with AWS, GCP, or other major public clouds * Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, cloud operations, Kubernetes, AI, data platforms, or related cloud technologies. * Cloud Certifications (AWS cloud practitioner or Google Cloud Digital Leader certifications) **Are you a Do'er?** Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button. * Unlimited Vacation * Flexible Working Options * Health Insurance * Parental Leave * Employee Stock Option Plan * Home Office Allowance * Professional Development Stipend * Peer Recognition Program **Many Do'ers, One Team** DoiT unites as *Many Do'ers, One Team*, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. \#LI\-Remote

The company is seeking talented software engineers to contribute to innovative projects focused on evaluating AI\-generated code, solving complex programming challenges, and improving the reasoning, accuracy, and performance of advanced AI models. This opportunity offers the flexibility of remote contract work, competitive compensation, and the chance to contribute to cutting\-edge artificial intelligence initiatives alongside highly skilled technical professionals. **Job Description** Our client is seeking talented Junior Software Engineers to participate in an innovative artificial intelligence initiative focused on improving the quality, accuracy, and technical capabilities of advanced AI models. This fully remote, contract\-based opportunity is designed for software engineers with experience at leading technology companies who are interested in applying their programming knowledge to real\-world AI development challenges. Selected professionals will evaluate AI\-generated code, develop complex programming challenges, analyze technical solutions, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, efficiency, maintainability, and overall software quality. * Develop challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases. * Review and assess AI\-generated technical reasoning involving algorithms, data structures, debugging, software architecture, and system design. * Identify errors, inefficiencies, and potential improvements in AI\-generated software solutions. * Provide clear, detailed, and actionable written technical feedback to support continuous AI model improvement. * Apply software engineering best practices to assess code quality and technical decision\-making. * Contribute to projects focused on advancing the capabilities of next\-generation AI systems. **Position Details** * **Job Title:** Junior Software Engineer – AI Code Evaluation * **Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote * **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor * **Compensation:** USD $150–$200 per hour * **Available Opportunities:** Up to 100 positions * **Preferred Location:** United States and other English\-speaking countries * **Industry:** Artificial Intelligence / Software Engineering **Why Consider This Opportunity?** This position offers software engineers the opportunity to apply their technical expertise to advanced artificial intelligence projects while working remotely. Candidates will contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI\-generated software, gaining exposure to emerging technologies and complex engineering challenges. **Join an exciting initiative helping shape the future of AI\-powered software development.** **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Minimum of **1 year of professional experience as a Software Engineer at a leading technology company**, with at least part of that experience gained within the last 3 years. * Strong programming fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, debugging, and code optimization. * Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, and software engineering best practices. * Ability to review, evaluate, and identify errors or inefficiencies in complex code. * Experience analyzing technical solutions and assessing code correctness, quality, and maintainability. * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and provide detailed feedback. * Ability to work independently in a fully remote, contractor\-based environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working at a top\-tier technology company or within a highly technical software engineering environment. * Based in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, or another English\-speaking country. * Experience conducting code reviews, developing technical assessments, or designing programming challenges. * Familiarity with evaluating AI\-generated code or working with AI\-assisted software development tools. * Ability to create challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases. * Strong understanding of software engineering concepts involving algorithms, debugging, architecture, and system design. **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are particularly interested in software engineers who have gained hands\-on experience at leading technology organizations and can demonstrate strong technical judgment, programming proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex engineering concepts clearly. Candidates should be comfortable evaluating sophisticated software solutions, identifying technical weaknesses, and contributing to the improvement of advanced AI systems. **Important:** This opportunity is intended for engineers with relevant professional experience. Recent graduates without qualifying software engineering experience may not meet the selection criteria. **Additional Information** **Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor **Compensation:** USD $150–$200 per hour **Open Positions:** Up to 100 opportunities **Preferred Locations:** United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and other English\-speaking countries. **About the Opportunity** This is a project\-based opportunity for software engineers interested in contributing to advanced artificial intelligence development. Selected candidates will work remotely on technical assignments involving AI\-generated code evaluation, software engineering challenges, debugging, and technical reasoning. **Application and Selection Process** Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an application and may be required to participate in technical assessments to demonstrate their software engineering knowledge, analytical capabilities, and written communication skills. Participation in the selection process does not guarantee an assignment or contract offer. **Important Considerations** * Candidates must have relevant professional software engineering experience. * Previous employment at a leading technology company is an important selection criterion. * Strong written English communication skills are essential. * Applicants should be comfortable working independently and providing detailed technical evaluations. * Final selection, compensation, project assignments, and contractual terms are subject to client evaluation and approval.

jobs.title: Data Advisor_BCDA1J
jobs.description: **What You Can Expect** In this role, your objective is to serve as the bridge between the US B2B Supply Business teams and our Data \& Architecture teams, gathering and challenging requirements and translating what the business needs into clear functional and technical specifications. Deliverables include source\-to\-target mappings, business rules, transformation logic, data quality expectations, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from with confidence. You will analyze data lineage and gaps to validate feasibility early, then own functional and user acceptance testing on the resulting data products by writing test cases, logging and tracking defects, and coordinating resolution until business users sign off and adopt the solution. Beyond delivery, you contribute directly to our Data and AI Governance foundation by maintaining business glossaries and data dictionaries, clarifying data ownership and stewardship, documenting metadata and lineage, and defining the data quality KPIs that measure whether our information is trustworthy. Success in this position is measured by the accuracy and completeness of specifications, the quality and timeliness of releases, defect resolution and UAT sign\-off rates, and the adoption of the data products you help deliver. You will work daily with business stakeholders, product owners, and data engineers, reporting to the Director of Architecture. Work on Data Governance teams on company\-wide standards, and present findings and recommendations to IT and business leadership — all while championing a team culture built on adaptability, innovative thinking, problem\-solving, and a genuine thirst for learning. **What You’ll Bring** You will have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Analytics, or a related curriculum * You will have a minimum of seven (7\) years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, or a related role supporting data platforms and analytics delivery * + Including a minimum of 3\+ years of experience with: + - Writing functional/technical specifications and source\-to\-target mapping documents * + - SQL and hands\-on data analysis, profiling, and validation * + - Data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, relational structures) - Functional and user acceptance testing of data pipelines, reports, or analytics products - Agile concepts and practices (user stories, backlog grooming, acceptance criteria) * You will have developed a working knowledge of cloud data platforms and tooling (AWS and/or Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, S3\) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) * You will have established a familiarity with Data and AI governance concepts: data quality, metadata management, lineage, data classification, privacy, and responsible AI * You have gained exposure to Python and Big Data technologies (Spark/PySpark) sufficient to communicate effectively with engineering teams; hands\-on development not required * Knowledge of ENGIE Domains; such as energy, retail, or trading * You will have a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset * You are versed in translating concepts to both technical and business audiences, verbally, in writing or digitally * You have established a team\-oriented approach and a collaborative working style * You have gained the ability to quickly take on new tasks and adapt to new circumstances in a dynamic environment * You are recognized as a trusted, credible partner by peers, business stakeholders, and clients **Additional Details** * This role is eligible for our hybrid work policy, currently three days a week in office * Must be available to travel domestically / internationally on limited occasions * Must possess a valid U.S. driver’s license/clean driving record * Must be willing and able to comply with all ENGIE ethics and safety policies * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is not exposed to weather conditions * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate * Could involve some lifting / up to 35 lbs * Must be willing and able to comply with all ENGIE * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with the needed assistance to perform the essential functions * Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job **Compensation** **Salary Range:** $117,300\.00 – $179,860\.00 USD annually This represents the average expected pay range for a qualified candidate. ENGIE complies with all federal, state, and local minimum wage laws. Actual salary offered may vary depending on geography, experience, education, internal pay alignment, or other bona fide factors. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for a competitive bonus / incentive plan. Your Talent Acquisition Partner can share more specific information regarding the benefits or the salary for the position based on the work location. At ENGIE, we take your well\-being seriously. Our comprehensive benefits package includes options for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, employer\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, ESPP, generous paid time off including wellness days, holidays and leave programs. We also help you plan for retirement by offering a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a company match. But that's not all – we're dedicated to the health and happiness of your entire family, offering supplemental benefits for full time employees that enhance emotional and physical well\-being through all stages of life from family forming to caregiver benefits. Explore our benefits package to see how we can support you. Learn more. **Why ENGIE?** ENGIE North America isn’t just participating in the Zero\-Carbon Transition, we’re leading it! Join us as we develop energy that is renewable, efficient, and accessible to everyone. At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in the adventure of the century. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. jobs.description: ***This is a contingent position, and employment is dependent upon Element 84 receiving the contract award and the candidate successfully obtaining a NOAA badge. We anticipate hiring multiple people for this position.*** **About Element 84** ==================== Element 84 is a woman\-owned small business that works with public, private, and non\-profit sector clients to develop geospatial data processing pipelines \& build software that helps answer big questions about our health, our infrastructure, and our changing planet. We solve challenging problems across a wide range of industries, but our super power is cloud\-based geospatial data processing, remote sensing, and Earth science systems. Our headquarters is located in Alexandria, VA and we have a satellite office in Philadelphia, PA. Element 84 also supports a large remote workforce from a variety of other states. **A Few Other Things You Should Know** -------------------------------------- * Element 84's values are: We Invest in Each Other, We are Reliable, and Our Work Benefits our World. * Element 84 works on meaningful projects that are challenging—from a technical, people, and team perspective. We make an impact on large projects through our leadership and expertise, both formal and informal. * Element 84 values life outside of work. We offer parental leave for everyone and support each other through family challenges like medical problems, adoptions, and new babies. * Element 84 has had a flexible work schedule since our founding in 2010\. * Element 84 is committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and respect for all individuals as we constantly strive to create a work environment where everyone feels welcome and supported. **About You** ============= You are curious about the world, are constantly learning, driven to lead (formally or informally), and have a strong work ethic. You're interested in solving impactful problems in science, medicine, and other projects that have a societal good. You can work independently or with a team, prioritize your projects, and be effective without micromanagement. You'll care about writing. Our team is remote and written communication is essential. In addition to caring about a well\-crafted email and a succinct conference abstract, you understand that good writing is good design and engineering. **About the Role** ================== Element 84 is seeking a highly experienced and motivated **Senior DevOps Engineer** with a strong background in architecting reliable, scalable cloud systems and a proven record of utilizing infrastructure as code in complex deployments to support our innovative projects. In this role, you'll be instrumental in leading the design, implementation, and operation of cloud\-native solutions for complex operational systems, collaborating closely with technical teams and customers. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise\-grade software within cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on infrastructure as code principles. While direct experience with geospatial applications isn't required, a curiosity and aptitude for working in this domain will be beneficial. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * Leading the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and secure cloud\-native solutions on AWS. * Collaborating with security experts to translate organizational security requirements into secure and compliant cloud implementations. * Developing and maintaining infrastructure\-as\-code to manage and provision infrastructure across numerous Azure and AWS accounts, ensuring consistency and efficiency. * Maintaining and optimizing CI/CD automation pipelines to facilitate rapid and reliable software deployments. * Crafting automation scripts in Python, Bash, JavaScript, and other relevant languages to streamline operational workflows. * Contributing to the development and maintenance of infrastructure supporting Generative AI applications on domain\-specific datasets. * Automating the creation and management of front and back\-end applications, pipelines, security tooling, etc. * Defining and advocating for best practices and standards for DevOps success across Element 84 and our customer organizations. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 6\+ years of experience in software development, with 3\+ years specifically focused on Cloud Technologies. * Strong, hands\-on experience with IaC is a must, including writing, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex configurations for cloud environments. * Strong experience developing in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, JavaScript). * Demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and managing infrastructure and services on a major cloud platform. * Ability to clearly document and communicate intricate architectural concepts at various levels, including delivering presentations, creating visual representations of architectur ermanent resident)** and authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, and/or Certified Kubernetes Administrator certifications. * B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree). * Experience with Generative AI technologies. * Experience working in regulated contexts (e.g., NIST 800\-53, PCI, HIPAA). * Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g., SAML, SSO, AWS Cognito, JWT, OAuth, OPA, Ranger). * Demonstrated ability to proactively learn and integrate new technologies into existing workflows. * Familiarity with geospatial data processing, analysis, or visualization tools and concepts. * Experience using containerized workloads for local development and enterprise deployments (e.g. docker, EKS, EKS\-automode, minikube, podman) * Experience with data warehousing or data lakehouses (e.g. Databricks or Snowflake) * Active NOAA CAC badge; Alternative Eligibility \- candidates who do not currently possess a NOAA badge are still highly encouraged to apply. However, you must be fully eligible and able to successfully clear the NOAA background investigation process to obtain one **\[Start date may be contingent upon successful processing and acquisition of NOAA badge]** **Additional Information** ========================== Paying attention to who we are as a company–people, family members, friends, and colleagues–is our primary focus at Element 84\. There are lots of ways to run a company, and, for us, we prioritize wanting to come to work, being around people we enjoy, taking on big things with people you trust, and sharing our achievements as a team. * You’ll get credit when things go right and we’ll have your back when things go wrong. * We only take on work that is challenging and right for us. There are projects we will turn down and the team has a say. * We may be a small company, but we have big company benefits meant to support the idea that we're here for the long term and happiness comes from much more than where you work. * We have an extraordinary retention rate because we hire extraordinary people. We hope that’s you. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * **Salary Range:** $145,000 – $180,000 / year (Full\-time, Salaried) * **Bonus Potential:** Eligible for performance\- and company profit\-based bonuses. * **Total Rewards:** Base pay is just one part of the Element 84 compensation package.
