jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Endiatx** Endiatx is a medical device company developing microrobotic systems for diagnostic use inside the human body. Our flagship platform, PillBot™, is a propeller\-driven endoscopic capsule designed to enable real\-time visualization of the stomach without traditional endoscopy. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators building a new category of medical diagnostics at the intersection of robotics, imaging, and AI. **Role Summary** We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to lead development and deployment of our endoscopic image analysis systems. This role owns the full ML lifecycle—from data strategy through production deployment—and contributes directly to how our devices interpret and interact with the physical world. You will work on computer vision models for gastric imagery, image enhancement under constrained in vivo conditions, and perception systems supporting navigation and localization. You will collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and simulation teams to integrate ML into a real\-world medical device system. This is a mid\-level role with significant ownership and the opportunity to mentor junior contributors. **What You Will Do** \- Own the end\-to\-end ML pipeline: data curation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring \- Design, train, and validate computer vision models using frameworks such as PyTorch \- Develop image enhancement pipelines \- Optimize models for performance across accuracy, latency, and compute constraints \- Implement neural compression techniques \- Build and maintain dataset infrastructure \- Deploy models into production environments with CI/CD and monitoring \- Contribute to localization and pose estimation \- Support perception systems for navigation and scene understanding \- Collaborate with simulation and visualization teams \- Mentor interns and junior engineers \- Communicate technical work clearly **Required Qualifications** \- 4\+ years of ML engineering experience or equivalent \- Experience deploying production computer vision models \- Strong foundation in deep learning \- Proficiency in Python and PyTorch \- Experience with MLOps tools \- Strong software engineering fundamentals \- Strong communication skills \- Experience in image enhancement, compression, or perception systems **Nice to Have** \- Medical imaging experience (e.g., DICOM) \- C\# or Unity familiarity \- SLAM or localization experience \- Robotics or autonomous systems experience **Location** On\-site in Hayward, CA. Limited hybrid flexibility. **Compensation** $130,000 – $180,000 base salary, plus equity and benefits. **Work Authorization** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. **Equal Opportunity** Endiatx is an equal opportunity employer. **Accommodations** Reasonable accommodations provided. **Employment Status** At\-will employment. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Experience: * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch: 2 years (Required) * Deep learning: 1 year (Required) * MLOps tools: 1 year (Required) * image enhancement, compression, or perception systems: 1 year (Required) * Machine Learning engineering: 4 years (Required) * deploying production computer vision models: 3 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Devices Team is responsible for the creation and lifecycle management of IoT devices enrolled in EnergyHub programs used to balance the power grid. The team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a core platform that enables other internal teams to build new features and functionality quickly. This is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real\-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future. We are continuing our journey to migrate from a monolithic to a microservices architecture and deliver well defined APIs to the broader organization. The primary focus is to integrate any Distributed Energy Resource (DER) into our platform in a way that enables multiple use cases without compromising quality and scalability. As a senior engineer, you support our mission by helping drive major initiatives, providing expertise and guidance from past industry experience, and autonomously developing high\-quality solutions that balance multiple constraints while ensuring long\-term flexibility. Main Responsibilities: What you'll do * Design and implement core platform features that solve for multiple constraints and use cases. * Help drive the transition from a monolithic architecture to a microservices\-based approach, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and improved system resilience. * Lead technical initiatives and provide data modeling, contract definition, and API development. * Develop front and back end solutions, ensuring well\-structured, high\-quality code with automated testing. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product managers, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders to drive high\-impact projects. * Work within real\-world constraints to develop creative solutions that maintain platform flexibility and scalability. * Contribute to best practices for CI/CD, data modeling, and iterative development (e.g.,PoCs, rapid prototyping, milestone\-based execution). * Mentor and support other engineers, fostering a strong technical culture of respect, open communication, and collaboration. Required Skills and Experience: What you need * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong full\-stack development experience, including frontend, backend, and relational database modeling and development. * Proficiency in React and Java (preferably Java 11\+). * Experience with web services, gRPC/RESTful APIs, and contract\-driven development. * Ability to operate independently, help provide technical vision and guide the team toward scalable solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills, capable of balancing multiple use cases while enabling flexibility. * Proven expertise in building dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React and TypeScript. * Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools in development and testing to accelerate delivery and enhance code quality. * Strong communication skills, with an emphasis on cross\-functional collaboration and working on challenging technical problems. Preferred Skills and Experience: Nice\-to\-haves * Experience with PostgreSQL, Asynchronous messaging (SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ), MongoDB, AWS, Datadog, and Robot Framework. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices. * Proven ability to deliver high\-quality, iterative value while maintaining execution speed. * Experience or familiarity with energy industry Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time. **Why work for EnergyHub?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people:** Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other. * **Make an immediate impact:** New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team! * **Gain well rounded experience:** EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. * **Work with the latest technologies:** You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault\-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs. * **Be part of something important:** Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate. **About EnergyHub** EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power. To learn more, visit energyhub.com. **Company Benefits** EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program. **EnergyHub is an Equal Opportunity Employer** EOE, Including Disability/Vets. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact accommodations.apply@energyhub.net. In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government\-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision. **Notice To Third Party Agencies:** EnergyHub understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third\-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you.

jobs.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer** About the Role Enterprise Electrical is seeking a **Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer** to provide technical ownership of the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, identity and access management, endpoint management, network infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, and data protection and recovery capabilities. As Enterprise Electrical continues to expand its internal IT department, this role will be responsible for designing, administering, documenting, and continuously improving secure, reliable technology infrastructure that supports corporate offices, company facilities, and active construction job sites. Working closely with the company’s Managed Service Provider (MSP), the Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer establishes infrastructure standards, guides security and operational improvements, coordinates technical projects, and ensures that systems align with business objectives, cybersecurity requirements, and operational needs. This role serves as the organization's internal infrastructure subject matter expert, focusing on architecture, security, resilience, governance, and long\-term technology strategy while supporting escalated operational issues as needed. Key Responsibilities Microsoft 365, Identity \& Endpoint Management * Design, administer, and maintain Microsoft 365 tenant architecture and configuration standards across Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Intune. * Manage identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, role changes, offboarding, guest access, directory services, and hybrid synchronization where applicable. * Administer least\-privilege access models, privileged roles, service accounts, emergency access procedures, and MSP administrative access. * Design, test, deploy, and maintain Conditional Access policies supporting multifactor authentication (MFA), device compliance, location\-based policies, and risk\-based access controls. * Manage Microsoft Intune enrollment, Autopilot deployments, compliance policies, security baselines, application deployment, endpoint protection, encryption, and update management. * Configure and maintain Microsoft Defender for Office 365 capabilities, including anti\-phishing, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, quarantine management, and email security standards. * Implement and support Microsoft Purview capabilities, including sensitivity labels, retention policies, data loss prevention (DLP), and information governance controls. * Monitor Microsoft Secure Score, tenant health, and security recommendations while prioritizing remediation initiatives based on business risk. Security \& Operational Resilience * Develop and maintain security baselines across identities, endpoints, servers, networks, and email systems using industry best practices and security frameworks. * Translate cyber insurance requirements and customer security obligations into enforceable technical controls. * Administer endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and security monitoring processes. * Coordinate security investigations, alert triage, containment activities, and remediation efforts with the MSP. * Conduct recurring privileged access reviews and account audits for employees, vendors, guest users, service accounts, and MSP personnel. * Maintain incident response documentation, technical runbooks, and recovery procedures. * Participate in tabletop exercises, security reviews, and operational readiness assessments. * Prepare security posture reports, technical evidence, client security questionnaires, and cyber insurance documentation. Network \& Server Infrastructure * Configure and maintain firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, routers, VLANs, segmentation policies, PoE systems, and secure remote access solutions. * Support job\-site connectivity solutions, including LTE/5G deployments, failover configurations, temporary offices, and construction trailers. * Assess and optimize wireless coverage across offices, warehouses, fabrication facilities, and project locations. * Administer cloud and on\-premises server environments, virtualization platforms, directory services, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure services. * Monitor server health, availability, capacity, patch compliance, and configuration standards. * Coordinate infrastructure projects, maintenance windows, upgrades, and change management activities with internal stakeholders and the MSP. Backup, Recovery \& Business Continuity * Administer backup and recovery solutions supporting servers, business\-critical systems, and Microsoft 365 workloads within approved recovery scopes. * Monitor backup performance and proactively address failures or protection gaps. * Maintain backup security controls and recovery access protections. * Perform and document scheduled restore testing and recovery validation exercises. * Support disaster recovery planning, recovery time objectives (RTOs), recovery point objective ring, or distributed workforce environments. * Familiarity with construction software platforms such as: * + Vista + Sage 300 CRE + Foundation + Procore + Accubid Leadership \& Team Collaboration * Partner with IT leadership to develop and implement infrastructure strategies and operational standards. * Serve as the primary internal technical counterpart to the company’s Managed Service Provider (MSP). * Coordinate infrastructure projects and change management activities across business units. * Lead infrastructure planning, technical reviews, and operational improvement initiatives. * Collaborate with department leaders, business stakeholders, vendors, and project teams. * Provide technical guidance and direction to MSP personnel and project resources within delegated authority. * This position has no direct employee supervisory responsibilities. Work Environment Work Environment * Primarily based onsite in the Houston office. * Occasional travel to company locations, warehouses, fabrication facilities, and active construction job sites. * Frequent interaction with technology equipment, infrastructure systems, vendors, and business stakeholders. * Jobsite visits may involve noise, dust, uneven terrain, varying temperatures, and active construction operations. * Compliance with all company safety policies and PPE requirements is required during field visits. Physical Requirements * Prolonged periods of computer and workstation use. * Ability to inspect, configure, troubleshoot, and connect network and IT equipment. * Ability to move throughout office environments, facilities, and construction sites. * Ability to occasionally lift, move, or install computers, networking equipment, and related devices. * Ability to travel as required to support business and infrastructure operations. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Schedule \& Travel * Full\-time position. * Primarily works standard business hours onsite. * Occasional evening, weekend, and after\-hours maintenance activities may be required. * Participation in infrastructure upgrades, project deployments, and critical incident response may require schedule flexibility. * Travel may be required based on operational and project needs. * Additional hours may be necessary to support outages, projects, maintenance activities, and business priorities. You will focus on delivery configuration (VCL), caching, HTTP behavior, and the Fastly Control Panel, with growing exposure to serverless Compute. Security product cases (such as WAF and DDoS) and general IT requests are handled by other teams. **What You'll Do:** * **Written\-first customer support:** Resolve technical inquiries primarily through email and ticket, and also through chat (Slack) and portal engagements. Process Engineer** **Compensation: $70,000** **Fibergrate Composite Structures** is a leading manufacturer of fiberglass\-reinforced plastic (FRP) products and engineered composite solutions used in industrial, commercial, and infrastructure applications worldwide. jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the Company** At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real\-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state\-of\-the\-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open\-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you. **About the Role** We are hiring a **Head of Enterprise Infrastructure** to own the internal cloud environments that host Atlas, our proprietary platform for building and testing the AI Co\-Workers we deliver to customers, along with the cloud services, enterprise repositories, LLM accounts, and tooling that support engineering and the wider organization. In this role, you'll operate and manage these systems to the standard a global enterprise expects, setting internal service levels, evidencing compliance with our regulatory and customer obligations, managing cost with discipline, and building continuity through documented processes. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and work closely with IT, Security, Platform, and Delivery to keep our infrastructure reliable, secure, and audit\-ready. **Responsibilities** * Own environment management: provisioning and maintaining internal platform environments, AICW namespace setup, and configuration parity, moving from ad hoc requests to a documented, repeatable self\-service process. * Lead release and change management for internal cloud environments, including approvals, scheduling, post\-change verification, and an auditable change record. * Own security and vulnerability remediation across internal environments to the standards and timeframes Security defines, tracking and reporting status to Security, assurance, and external auditors. * Manage access control for enterprise systems and repositories in line with the access model Security defines, including onboarding and offboarding, periodic access reviews, and least\-privilege enforcement. * Act as major incident commander for internal environments, establishing on\-call coverage and escalation paths, and running post\-incident reviews that convert into permanent fixes. * Own cloud cost reporting, forecasting, and optimization, as well as vendor and tooling management, including contract negotiation and renewals in partnership with Finance and Legal. * Uphold enterprise\-grade compliance standards, such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring your work is independently verified by Security and fully evidenced. **Minimum Qualifications** * Hands\-on operational ownership of cluster and substrate infrastructure at enterprise scale, including upgrade, patch, capacity, and lifecycle management. * Proven release and change management within a controlled framework, producing an auditable record that stands up to external scrutiny. * Track record of vulnerability remediation to defined service levels, working alongside an independent security function. * Deep experience provisioning and configuring environments as code, including namespace and baseline configuration management. * Operational access management at scale across enterprise systems, source repositories, and platform environments, with least privilege and evidenced access reviews. * Demonstrated major incident command, including severity assessment, escalation, stakeholder communication, and post\-incident improvement. * Cloud financial management: cost reporting, forecasting, and optimization with spend attributed to teams. * Commercial capability in cloud and vendor contract negotiation, renewals, and commitment management. * Experience operating inside a formal control framework such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2, and supporting external audit and customer assurance. * Demonstrated people leadership: hiring, developing, and retaining infrastructure engineers, and running sustainable on\-call. * Sound judgment about what to automate, what to document, and what to decommission. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience standing up a platform or enterprise engineering function from an interim or unowned state. * Exposure to investor or IPO diligence, or to enterprise customer security assessments, on technology operations. * Multi\-cloud operating experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP. * Background operating infrastructure supporting an AI or data\-intensive product, including model account and API tenancy management. **Why Join Us?** * A high\-performance culture * State\-of\-the\-art technology * Experience world\-class leadership * Scale of impact and purpose * A competitive salary and a huge growth trajectory * Work with the best in the industry * Flexible work environment * Diversity and creativity **Disclaimer:** We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in\-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website. **Future Secure AI Privacy Policy** ----------------------------------- At Future Secure AI, we are committed to protecting your privacy and adhering to the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at www.futuresecure.ai (the "Website") and use our services.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Mechanical Design
jobs.description: GAM Enterprises manufactures precision mechanical products used in the robotics and motion control industry. We have an opportunity for an Engineering Manager to lead our mechanical design and development department. The manager will be expected to not only lead and manage the department activities, but also partake in the design and development aspect. GAM’s mantra is – “GAM Can!” \- and it’s the spirit of our entrepreneurial culture. We live and breathe our core values of **Teamwork**, being **Action\-Oriented**, building **Long\-Term Relationships**, being **Professional** at what we do, and having **Fun**. Our Engineering Manager needs to embody those same values. The ideal candidate will be someone who will excel working in our fast\-paced company, where the velocity from the time of order, design, manufacture, and ship is very high. It is also an environment where everyone makes a difference. The position reports directly to the President of the company and is based at our Mount Prospect, IL headquarters. **We are looking for an Engineering Manager to:** · Lead, manage, and oversee our mechanical design department of four engineers for impactful results while maximizing employee satisfaction. · Establish and implement new processes, procedures, and standards that will help us achieve our ever\-increasing standards of professionalism. · Develop and mentor the other engineers so they may grow in their knowledge and career path. · Create new product designs and develop new product lines. · Modify existing product designs and design components that will meet customer requirements. · Collaborate with customers to develop unique product designs for new applications, investigate and analyze problems, determine changes, make corrections, and set requirements. · Perform engineering analysis on customer returns and field engineering support and assistance. · Create/modify engineering documentation such as: assembly instructions, BOMs, process documents, testing/root cause analysis reports, and ECRs. · Edit technical product content in marketing and sales materials (technical aides, website, databases and application materials). · Provide technical support to GAM teammates in sales and customer service roles. Communicate directly with customers in special circumstances where technical expertise is needed. · Guide GAM in its efforts to implement gear manufacturing in\-house. **The ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications:** · 10\-15 years of experience in a mechanical engineering design capacity, including the design of mechanical assemblies. · 5 years of experience in supervisory role with a proven track record of impactful results · BSE or MSE in Mechanical Engineering or General Engineering. Other disciplines will not be considered as this position requires the technical and specific knowledge obtained by an ME or GE. · Knowledge and experience in designing gears. · Experienced in the design of gearboxes, or drivetrain assemblies. · Knowledge and experience in metal gear manufacturing · Experience with component selection, sizing, and ratings · Experience with AGMA, ANSI, and GD\&T standards · Advanced practical and applied CAD experience (SolidWorks preferred). · Knowledge of manufacturing methods, particularly CNC machinery. · Preferred but not required experience with servo gearboxes; creating, modifying, and editing databases in MS\-Access, or SQL; experience with FEA; experience with PDM. **Required Skills and Characteristics:** · Strong communication skills \- both written and verbal. Can effectively communicate and collaborate with peers, upper management, and customers. · Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines (multitask). · Can work well in a team environment. · Creative problem solver, who is calm under pressure, organized, and able to adapt to changes in priorities. GAM offers a compensation and benefits package that includes a competitive salary, choice of 3 medical plans, dental reimbursement, company paid life insurance and disability, 401(k) with match, paid time off, holidays, flexible work schedule, business casual environment, and more. We encourage you to contact us to apply and join the very best! Please, no 3rd party contacts – candidates only. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Do you have knowledge and experience in the design of power\-transmission assemblies? If you have experience in the design of gearboxes, then please indicate that. * Do you have experience designing products that were then marketed and sold in the industrial market? * Do you have knowledge and experience in the design of metal gears? * Do you have experience in metal gear manufacturing? Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Experience: * supervisory: 5 years (Preferred) * mechanical design: 10 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Engineer I
jobs.description: **About the Team** An instrumental part of GOAT Group, the Marketing team oversees a wide range of activities, which aim to build awareness, consideration and loyalty for our brands. As a member of this team, you will work to execute thoughtful, data\-driven marketing campaigns that drive meaningful growth for the company. **Role Overview** GOAT Group is seeking a Marketing Engineer I to build the AI systems that run our marketing. This is an AI\-first role: we are hiring primarily for demonstrated ability to build with LLMs and agent tooling. Marketing knowledge and experience are preferred, but not required. Reporting to the AVP of Growth, you will work inside the Marketing team to replace manual, repetitive workflows with agents, pipelines, and internal tools. Your first focus is CRM and lifecycle automation, expanding into performance marketing and organic marketing over time. We expect strong candidates to arrive with more AI experience than marketing or engineering experience. If you have been shipping agents and can show us what they do, we will help you close the rest. **In this role, you will:** * Build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that marketing teams use daily, taking them from prototype to production rather than stopping at a demo. * Automate campaign development in Braze, including template\-driven generation, reusable segmentation logic, product\-level personalization, and pre\-send QA. * Write evaluation suites that measure agent output for brand voice, factual grounding, and tone, and that catch regressions before they reach customers. * Maintain a version\-controlled library of prompts, skills, and agent definitions as shared team infrastructure. * Integrate marketing and product systems through APIs and MCP servers so agents can act on real GOAT data. * Train marketing partners on what you build, and track adoption and outcomes for everything you ship. **How Success Is Measured** Agents shipped into recurring use, hours of manual work returned to the marketing team, and measurable movement in the KPIs your systems touch. **We are looking for:** *Required Qualifications* * A demonstrated portfolio of AI builds: agents, LLM workflows, or internal tools you shipped that real people used. Personal projects, internships, and open\-source work count. Be prepared to walk us through one. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic or OpenAI, including prompt design, structured outputs, and tool use. * Practical experience with agent orchestration platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or Gumloop, and with AI development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. * Evaluation literacy: you can explain how you would know whether an AI system is working, and you have built or used evals to find out. * Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose programming language, Python preferred. You can read, debug, and modify code you did not write, and explain why your own code works. * Working knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, and JSON, plus comfort with Git and version control. * 1\-2 years of professional experience in any field. We are evaluating what you can build, not where you have worked. *Preferred Qualifications* * Exposure to a CRM or marketing automation platform. Braze (Liquid, Canvas, REST API) is most directly relevant. * Experience building simple internal interfaces with React, Streamlit, Retool, or similar. * SQL or experience querying a data warehouse. * Familiarity with RAG, context engineering, or building on structured product catalogs. * Interest in or knowledge of sneakers, streetwear, collectibles, and resale marketplaces **Growth and Development** You will receive direct mentorship from our AVP of Growth, and work alongside partners in Engineering and Marketing. As the Marketing Engineering function matures here, the role is expected to grow in scope and ownership. GOAT Group uses geographic pay tiers based on the employee's home state to align compensation with market differences across the U.S. Hiring Range: Tier 1 (Includes states such as California, New York (including New York City), Washington, Illinois and other higher\-cost markets) $113,210 \- $130,000 USD Tier 2 \- (Includes mid\-cost markets across the U.S.) $90,300 \- $101,000 USD Tier 3 \- (All other U.S. locations) $80,000 \- $89,085 USD GOAT Group represents the leading platforms for authentic sneakers, apparel and accessories. Operating four distinct brands–GOAT, Flight Club, Grailed and alias–GOAT Group has a global community of more than 60 million members across 170 countries. GOAT is the global platform for the greatest products from the past, present and future. Since its founding in 2015, GOAT has become one of the leading and most trusted sneaker platforms in the world, and has expanded to offer apparel and accessories from select emerging, contemporary and iconic brands. Through its unique positioning between the primary and resale markets, the company offers styles across various time periods on its digital platforms and in its retail locations, while delivering products to over 60 million members across 170 countries. Established in New York City over 15 years ago, Flight Club revolutionized sneaker retail as the original consignment store for rare shoes. Carrying the rarest exclusives and collectible sneakers, Flight Club has evolved from a one\-stop sneaker destination, to a cultural hub for sneaker enthusiasts and novices alike. With three brick\-and\-mortar locations in New York City, Los Angeles and Miami, Flight Club remains the premier source for authentic, rare sneakers. Founded in 2013, Grailed is the leading community\-driven marketplace for rare luxury, streetwear and vintage fashion. The marketplace was built for enthusiasts, by enthusiasts, and features products from brands including Supreme, Raf Simons, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Prada and more. With a highly curated selection of resale pieces including inventory exclusive to the platform, Grailed makes fashion accessible. The company is backed by strategic investor Foot Locker, Inc. as well as some of the leading names in venture capital including Park West Asset Management, T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., Franklin Templeton, Adage Capital Management, Ulysses Management, D1 Capital Partners, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Matrix Partners, Upfront Ventures, Webb Investment Network and Y Combinator. *GOAT Group will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, if applicable. By applying, you authorize GOAT Group to send you text messages regarding your job application, interview and/or onboarding process, and other job opportunities at GOAT Group.* *If you are a California resident, please review our* *California Privacy Rights Notice for Job Applicants**.* *If you are an EU or UK resident, please review our* *EU / UK Candidate \& Employee Privacy Notice.*

jobs.title: Battery Electrochemistry Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Gamma Technologies (GT), the global leader in multi\-physics system simulation software, develops a suite of integrated solutions designed to guide and accelerate the engineering transformation of today’s products. Fusing advanced physics with AI algorithms, our platform, GT\-SUITE, is used to simulate a broad range of systems from early stage development to digital twin applications across multiple industries including transportation and mobility, marine, aerospace and defense, power and energy, data centers and HVACR. At Gamma Technologies, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for Battery Electrochemistry Development Engineer who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success. **What You Will Do** We are looking for a creative, talented, and self\-starting development engineer to join our Product Development Group to continuously improve our software. This role will require you to be in the office 60% of the time. * Generous vacation, sick days, holidays and including parental leave. * Onsite fitness center. * Growth and development opportunities. * The expected annual base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $120,00\. * Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. jobs.title: Software Engineer- Equity Derivatives Trading Desk
jobs.description: ***We are Gelber Group \- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.*** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA\-registered broker\-dealer, a self\-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM\-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets. Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed **The Opportunity** ------------------- As a Software Engineer at Gelber Securities, LLC, you will work directly with a successful trading desk that trades derivatives listed on the U.S. markets. You will work side by side with experienced traders, quants, and other talented engineers to design, develop, and support systems and applications used by both human and algorithmic traders, having a direct and meaningful impact on PnL. An amazing opportunity to learn and grow from a team of intelligent and skilled individuals. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast\-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, clear communication, and a very strong interest in working at a trading firm. ***This position can either sit in our Chicago Headquarters office or remote within the United States.*** ### ***What you'll do:*** * Communicate with engineers, traders, and quants to architect, design, develop, deploy, and support our proprietary trading applications and tools * Have a significant impact in development for our existing infrastructure in C\#, as well as adding new features and applications for our human and algorithmic traders * Become an expert in the entire trading pipeline and the software and technology that it is built upon, including the back end, front end, and everything in between * Provide real time support and bug fixes for live trading applications ### ***What you'll need:*** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 3\+ years of work experience working in C\#, Java, or C\+\+ * Strong understanding of and experience with an Object Oriented Programming language * Excellent communication skills specifically when it comes to understanding requirements and translating that into code and fixing bugs * Self\-motivation and ability to work with others in a remote environment * Understanding of the financial markets is not required, but preferred and must have a strong interest * Working knowledge of Options, Volatility, and SQL not required but is a plus **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- *The approximate annual base salary for this position in* ***Chicago, Illinois/Nationwide*** *is $100,000 to $150,000\. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. jobs.title: Director — FDE Office (Forward Deployed Engineering)
jobs.description: **About GlobalFoundries:** GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. **Summary of Role:** GlobalFoundries is scaling the next generation of enterprise AI and agentic workflows through the CIO FDE Office. The Director leads a blended team of internal engineers, NCG resources, and contractor FDEs (partners) to incubate, industrialize, and operationalize AI\-powered solutions across HR, IT, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other business domains. This is a supervisory role that combines people leadership, portfolio and demand management, architecture direction, executive engagement, and financial stewardship of the AI platform. The Director sets the operating model and standards for a small, high\-impact organization, ensures solutions ship with the right security, observability, governance, and cost controls, and serves as the CIO's trusted partner for translating enterprise AI strategy into delivered, measurable value. Roughly 70% of the role is strategy, leadership, and stakeholder engagement \& management; \~30% is retained technical fluency and architecture judgment. **Essential Responsibilities** : **1\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development** * Lead, coach, and develop the team 5 direct reports plus 5 NCG resources; build a durable talent pipeline and career paths within the pod. * Manage a blended workforce of internal GF FDE engineers and contractor resources; scale capacity up and down as demand requires. * Set the CIO FDE Office operating model, engineering standards, roles/responsibilities, and delivery methodology. * Own staffing plans, investment proposals, and capability\-building; foster a culture of ownership, safety, and measurable outcomes. **2\. Portfolio, Intake Governance \& Delivery** * Own the CIO FDE portfolio — prioritize use cases, sequence delivery, and align capacity to the highest\-value opportunities. * Run intake governance for new technology requests: apply formal intake templates and screening questions to ensure strategic alignment and reusable patterns. * Drive use cases from incubation to production without surprises in risk, security, or cost; hold go/no\-go and production\-readiness gates. * Represent solutions at Design Review Board (DRB) and enterprise architecture reviews. **3\. Enterprise AI \& Agentic Platform Strategy** * Set technical direction for enterprise AI agents built across various enterprise applications such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Supply Chain, HR, and IT Operations. * Guide architecture for MCP integrations, APIs, multi\-agent orchestration, cloud (AWS / ADP BYOC), identity (Entra ID, OBO, token brokering), and observability. * Champion reusable components, reference implementations, and standards that reduce delivery time for future use cases. * Retain enough hands\-on depth to pressure\-test designs, make credible build\-vs\-buy decisions, and unblock the team on hard technical calls. **4\. Cost, Budget \& AI Tokenomics Stewardship** * Own budget accountability for the CIO FDE Office — platform licensing, SOWs/contracts (e.g., Redpanda ADP), contractor spend, and cloud/AI consumption. * Build and maintain AI tokenomics visibility: showback/chargeback models across Copilot, Cowork, AWS Bedrock, GitHub Copilot, and other GenAI tools, with dashboards for leadership. * Forecast AI/cloud consumption, model ROI and total cost of ownership, and drive cost transparency and spend governance for business units. * Balance speed of incubation with disciplined cost control; make model, harness, and local\-LLM trade\-off decisions that optimize value per dollar. **5\. Executive \& Business Engagement** * Serve as the CIO's delivery partner and a trusted advisor to C\-suite and business unit leaders (CEO/XT, CHRO, PO manufacturing and functional leadership). * Translate business strategy into an agentic roadmap; run workshops to identify automation opportunities and secure sponsorship. * Communicate status, decisions, risks, and value in concise, executive\-level briefings, decision memos, and steering forums. * Manage vendor and partner relationships, negotiate SOWs, and align external delivery to GF priorities and standards. **6\. Production Readiness, Risk \& Operations** * Ensure deployed agents meet enterprise bars for security, identity, data quality, observability, and production support. * Oversee UAT, defect tracking, go/no\-go criteria, and operational runbooks for agents entering production. * Partner with platform, cloud, network, and security teams on scalability, resilience, and compliance (including SOX\-relevant systems where applicable). * Institutionalize telemetry and cost\-aware operating practices across the agent lifecycle. **Other Responsibilities:** Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety \& Security requirements and programs. * **Required** **Qualifications** : * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (advanced degree a plus). * 12\+ years of technology experience, including 5\+ years leading engineering, delivery, or platform teams. * Proven people\-leadership track record: hiring, coaching, and scaling blended internal/contractor teams and early\-career talent. * Demonstrated ownership of budgets, licensing/SOWs, and technology cost governance. * Strong architecture fluency across APIs, enterprise integration, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and modern application development. * Experience partnering with senior business and C\-suite stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes. **Preferred** **Qualifications** * Experience delivering enterprise AI agents, MCP servers, LLM platforms, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, CrewAI, or Redpanda ADP. * Familiarity with AI tokenomics, showback/chargeback, and cloud FinOps for GenAI workloads. * Experience with AWS, Azure and BYOC solutions. Hands on experience with cloud solutions preferred. * Integration experience with ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, or Microsoft Graph APIs. * Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, APQC) and EA tooling (LeanIX, Bizzdesign). * Comfortable leading in ambiguous, fast\-moving incubation environments where requirements evolve through prototyping. **Success Measures — First 12 Months** Mature a durable CIO FDE operating model with clear roles, standards, and a healthy talent pipeline Deliver production\-ready agentic solutions for priority use cases across multiple business domains with no surprises in risk, security, or cost. Establish AI tokenomics transparency — showback/chargeback dashboards and forecasts adopted by leadership and business units. Reduce delivery time for new use cases through reusable MCPs, API assets, and reference patterns. Earn trusted\-advisor status with the CIO and C\-suite, with a prioritized, sponsored agentic roadmap in flight. **Expected Salary Range** $191,000\.00 \- $332,000\.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. An offer with GlobalFoundries is conditioned upon the successful completion of pre\-employment conditions, as applicable, and subject to applicable laws and regulations. GlobalFoundries goal of excellence in business necessitates the attraction and retention of highly qualified people. Qualifications: * Bachelors of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar fields. * A minimum of 5\+ years programming experience * Plant Controls Engineers are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers. Prior experience with the following technical areas:* PLC \& HMI programming. Beckhoff, RSLogix5000/500/5 preferred. * Plant SCADA systems. * Prior experience with industrial control networks; Ethernet 1/P, Control Net, DeviceNET, DH\+, Remote 110 * MS Office; Strong knowledge of MS\-Excel, some VB preferred. * AutoCAD / AutoCADLT / equivalent drafting and understanding electrical, pneumatic and process flow prints. * Ability to design and troubleshoot electrical and pneumatic systems. jobs.title: Construction Account Manager
jobs.description: **Why join us?****Handoff is the AI agent that runs a construction company.** We help remodelers automate estimating, streamline operations, and win more work \- backed by real\-time cost data, intuitive design, and workflows that “speak contractor.” With over 10,000 monthly active users and $6B in annualized project volume already flowing through our platform, we’re becoming the trusted partner for the people who build our homes. In this role you'll lead implementation for building material suppliers, dealers, and construction companies — configuring their accounts, training their teams, supporting their rollout, and translating their feedback into improvements our engineers and researchers can act on. This role is ideal for someone who has real construction estimating experience and knows how the work actually gets built — and who can take that credibility into a room of estimators, purchasing staff, or operations leads and help them get more out of our technology. If you've spent time in the field or at a supplier desk and you're ready to bring that expertise into a fast\-moving AI company, this is the role for you. ### **What you'll do** * Serve as the primary point of contact for estimating, purchasing, and construction staff at our enterprise accounts * Build and own the implementation plan per account, with 30/60/90 milestones the customer has agreed to * Configure and maintain customer accounts: cost data, product preferences, catalogs, estimate formats, and presets — validated against real estimates * Train customer users and build the training materials that scale that process * Own first\-line support: answer customer questions same day and escalate bugs with reproducible steps and customer impact * Translate customer requirements and feedback into structured, prioritized specs for our forward\-deployed engineers, researchers, and product team * Review customer usage weekly per account and work adoption blockers with the team * Prepare and run customer check\-ins and business reviews * Build the repeatable playbook: onboarding checklist, configuration standards, support process ### **About you** * You've personally done takeoffs from drawings and built estimates and material lists — residential or commercial. This is a requirement, and we'll verify it in the take\-home. * You have end\-to\-end knowledge of the construction process, including field and installation work. You know what a quantity means on site, can catch a missing scope, and can explain it in a customer's language. * You've trained people, supported accounts, or managed customer relationships. You're comfortable in front of a room of estimators, purchasing staff, or sales reps. * You're a clear writer who gets the details right. You can turn a customer conversation into a precise requirement or a reproducible bug report someone else can act on. * You use AI tools every day and can teach them to someone who doesn't. * Bonus: experience with takeoff software (PlanSwift, Bluebeam, OST), estimating or construction management platforms (Buildertrend, JobTread, Procore), software implementation or onboarding, procurement/purchasing at a material supplier, or working alongside product or engineering teams. ### **What we offer** * Competitive Salary \+ Equity * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * Life \& Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA) * Relocation Allowance * Top\-Notch Equipment * Team offsites around the world! Construction is one of the largest industries in the world, and it's still running on spreadsheets and gut feel. We're changing that. This role puts you at the center of it — working directly with the customers building our product's future, and bringing your construction expertise into a company that will actually use it. If that sounds like your kind of work, we'd love to hear from you. ***Handoff is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *Handoff is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Handoff will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Handoff encourages applicants of all ages. Handoff also participates in E\-Verify.*

Collaborate with technical teams to ensure connectivity, authentication, data flow, and architecture alignment support intended agent behavior. Monitor agent outputs, tool calls, workflow consistency, and production behavior to identify issues, drift, or reliability concerns. Debug agent failures, integration errors, prompt breakdowns, or logic conflicts and implement corrective improvements. Support controlled rollout and stabilization of new agent capabilities. * Governance, Security, and Guardrails: Ensure agent configurations operate within approved governance, access, privacy, and security boundaries. Support coding standards, reproducibility, maintainability, and reusable design patterns across agent implementations. Contribute to technical best practices for AI\-enabled workflow development and lifecycle support. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Improvement: Partner with AI Trainers, software engineers, analysts, product/initiative leads, and subject matter experts to improve deployed agent performance and utility. Translate feedback from users and stakeholders into technical enhancements, configuration changes, or architecture improvements. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company's primary focus is to develop distributed power generators that can operate on various fuel sources to future\-proof against an ever\-changing energy economy. **Job Purpose** The **Manufacturing Engineer** designs, implements, and improves assembly processes and equipment within the Industrialization team. This position develops the assembly lines, fixtures, and material flow systems that convert KARNO prototype and development builds into repeatable, scalable production operations — and then works to remove waste, labor content, and variation from those operations. Working closely with industrialization leadership, design engineering, production, quality, and supply chain, the Manufacturing Engineer owns assigned assembly processes and stations: line and station design, fixture and tooling design, material presentation and handling, process qualification, and continuous waste reduction. This position applies Hyliion's standards for how assembly processes are designed and documented, participates in design reviews, and contributes to measurable improvement in cycle time, first\-pass yield, labor content, and ergonomics across the assembly areas. **AI at Hyliion** At Hyliion, AI is core to how we work. We equip every team member with leading AI tools and count on you to use them — to move faster, solve harder problems, and help us realize the full potential of KARNO technology for the world. **Duties and Responsibilities** * **Assembly Line and Cell Design**: Design and improve assembly lines, cells, and workstations for KARNO core, module, and subassembly operations. Establish work sequencing, balance work content to takt, define station layouts and footprints, and design lines that accommodate planned rate increases rather than requiring rebuild to reach them. * **Fixture, Jig, and Tooling Design**: Design assembly and inspection fixtures, jigs, and tooling from concept through qualification. Own datum and locating strategy, tolerance stack\-up and GD\&T, error\-proofing (poka\-yoke) features, and fixture qualification including repeatability and gage R\&R studies. Participate in peer design reviews of fixtures and tooling. * **Material Handling and Flow Optimization**: Design material presentation and handling systems that put the right part at the point of use in the right orientation — kitting strategy, cart and rack design, sequencing, kanban and pull loops, and travel distance and motion reduction. Partner with Supply Chain and Production Control on line\-side stocking, min/max levels, and WIP control. * **Waste Reduction in Assembly Operations**: Systematically identify and eliminate waste across assembly operations — motion, waiting, rework, overprocessing, transport, and excess inventory. Reduce labor content and cycle time per unit through standard work, work sequencing, changeover reduction, error\-proofing, and station design. Quantify the value of each change before implementation and verify the result afterward. * **Prototype Development and Production Scaling**: Collaborate with design engineering to develop prototype build processes and transition them to efficient, repeatable production\-scale operations, including cross\-site process transfer between the Milford, OH and Cedar Park, TX facilities. * **Process Development and Optimization**: Design, develop, implement, and qualify manufacturing processes for engine, generator, electric machine, and precision electromechanical assembly operations, including processes involving high\-voltage systems, sealed pressure systems, and additively manufactured components. * **Process Documentation and Control**: Author and maintain the process documentation set — PFMEAs, control plans, work instructions, travelers, and routings — and ensure the manufacturing BOM structure reflects how the product is actually built. Verify on the floor that the documented process is the process being followed. * **Technical Collaboration and Support**: Provide technical guidance to production teams and technicians on assigned processes, participate in design reviews, and represent Manufacturing Engineering on assigned projects to influence design for manufacturability. * **Capital Equipment and Automation**: Support the specification, justification, procurement, installation, and qualification of capital equipment, semi\-automated assembly aids, and material handling equipment. Contribute to business cases and vendor evaluations, and own installation and process qualification for assigned equipment through to validated production use. * **Additive Manufacturing**: Integrate additive manufacturing technologies into production processes where applicable, including design and process considerations specific to additively manufactured assemblies. * **Problem\-Solving and Root Cause Analysis**: Lead or support root cause analysis and correctiv iency in 3D CAD required, with Siemens NX strongly preferred — NX is our design platform, and native fluency accelerates contribution meaningfully. Candidates with strong proficiency in another major platform (SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, Inventor, or equivalent) will receive full consideration and are expected to develop working NX proficiency within the first several months; demonstrated willingness and aptitude to learn NX is required. + Fluency in tolerance stack\-up analysis and GD\&T, and the ability to read, interpret, and challenge engineering drawings, BOMs, ECOs, and specifications. + Demonstrated skill in material handling and flow design — point\-of\-use presentation, kitting, kanban and pull systems, line\-side stocking, and travel distance and motion reduction. + Practical experience with waste identification and elimination in assembly operations, including time study and work measurement, standard work development, changeover reduction, and labor content analysis. + Working knowledge of DOE, gage R\&R, capability studies, and formal process qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ or equivalent). + Exposure to implementing automation and semi\-automated assembly aids into production processes. + Experience with one or more of the following: custom fabrication, engine and generator assembly, and electric motor or electric machine assembly processes. + Proficiency with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and ERP routing and BOM structures; PLM experience (Teamcenter or equivalent) beneficial. + Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies applied in practice rather than in theory. + Familiarity with automotive or aerospace industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., QS9000, ISO 9001, AS9100, NADCAP). + Experience with additive manufacturing (3D printing) beneficial. + Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, technicians, and cross\-functional partners, contribute to design reviews, and influence without direct authority. + Comfort operating in a pre\-commercial environment where product configuration is still changing and the process must be built rather than inherited. **Role Classification and Working Conditions** This is a salaried, exempt\-level position. This position typically works in an office environment; and given the nature of our business is also exposed to operations/warehouses/production environments. **Physical/Other Requirements** * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, access equipment in confined or elevated positions, and occasionally lift and move materials up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation. * Compliance with all site PPE and safety requirements is mandatory. * Temporary extended on\-site oversight for new process development preferred. * Ongoing travel to company engineering and production sites up to 30%. **We are not accepting candidates who require sponsorship for this role at this time.** **Benefits:** * Medical Plans, with PPO or HDHP options * Dental Plans, with buy\-up option * Vision Plan * Life Insurance and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment Plans, with buy\-up options * Short Term Disability, paid for by the company * Long Term Disability, paid for by the company * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * 401k/Roth 401k * Voluntary Accident Plans * Voluntary Critical Illness Plans * Hospital Indemnity Plan *Hyliion is proud to be an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, disability, veteran status. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to otherwise participate in the employment selection process, please direct your inquires to Hyliion's human resources department at* *HR@hyliion.com**.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (COBOL)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Ingram Content Group** (ICG) is currently seeking a **Senior Software Developer \- COBOL**, to join our team in **LaVergne, TN** (Greater Nashville area). This person delivers enterprise\-grade software solutions with high customer impact. You will work with a team of sr. engineers specializing in an enterprise order processing application running on MVS using mainly relational database technology (DB2\). As the Senior Software Engineer, you will perform all aspects of the development life cycle. You’ll have the option to code using the traditional TSO/ISPF approach or you’ll have tools like Visual Studio Code available as a GUI approach with AI built in. This position will be hybrid and will be expected to work from the Ingram headquarters 4 days per week with the 5th day remote. *Want to help explore and build new ways to deliver content to the world?* At Ingram, our Technology team is blazing a trail by providing content distribution services to thousands of publishers with key initiatives around business intelligence, machine learning, continuous integration and omnichannel. We support diverse people and technology that highlights innovation through SaaS platforms, metadata, cloud, and containerization. Our teams are agile, and emphasize authenticity, creativity, and transparency upon a fact\-based foundation. The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you are an IT professional who strives to deliver results through collaborative partnerships, understanding what drives business, and enjoys working in a connected culture, we can’t wait to meet you! **The ideal candidate will have the following minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or directly related experience * 6\+ years development experience as application engineer/sr. programmer analyst * 5\+ years mainframe COBOL and/or Mainframe/iSeries development experience * 5\+ years relational database experience **We have a preference for:** * Strong COBOL development experience on mainframe platforms, with expertise in TSO/ISPF and enterprise batch/online processing * Strong database skills including DB2, Oracle, and SQL * Understanding of logistics order\-to\-delivery process, distribution functions or transportation processes * Experience developing design patterns, standards, and best practices; provides technical leadership and oversight, including third‑party and database integrations * Ability to use modern COBOL development environments and AI‑enabled tools to analyze legacy code, accelerate development, and support modernization efforts. * Leads and executes full application development lifecycle activities, including requirements, design, development, testing, quality assurance, and deployment * Reviews and evaluates application workflow, usability, and performance; ensures solutions meet defined specifications and standards. * Demonstrated ability to mentor others, guide technical work, and collaborate across teams and technical domains **The Senior Cobol Developer’s key responsibilities are:** * Develops, tests, and implements changes to existing mainframe COBOL programs/applications including integration with MQ and API middleware. * Works closely with client resources to assist in solution design and implementation * Supports user/customer community to capture system requirements. * Works with multiple systems (i.e. Order Processing, Warehouse Processing, Billing, Sales, Credit Processing) * Manages projects that require work from others. * Communicates project status and issues. * Enforces good development practices. * Investigates new technologies and new techniques. * Develops and modifies internal facing software applications. * Provides application development life cycle support including specifications, prototypes, development, quality assurance, deployment and support. * Reviews and evaluates application workflow and user experience. * Provides adequate tests to ensure program meets specified requirements. * Coordinates with users and product owners to gather requirements. *Hiring Salary Range: $110,981 \- $141,123k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to: the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.* **Additional Information** **Perks/Benefits:** * A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA. + 15 vacation days \& 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days + 401K match, Life and AD\&D, Employee Assistance programs, Group Legal, \& more + Wellness program with access to onsite gym and basketball court for associates * Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program * Financial and in\-kind opportunities to engage with non\-profits in your community + Company match program for United Way donations + Volunteer opportunities and in\-kind drives for non\-profits throughout the year * Take breaks or brainstorm in our game room with ping pong \& foosball * Casual Dress Code \& Flexible Schedules (per team) The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. Providing comprehensive services for publishers, retailers, libraries and educators, Ingram makes these services seamless and accessible through technology, innovation and creativity. With an expansive global network of offices and facilities, Ingram’s services include digital and physical book distribution, print\-on\-demand, and digital learning. Ingram Content Group is a part of Ingram Industries Inc. and includes Ingram Book Group LLC, Ingram Publisher Services LLC, Lightning Source LLC, Ingram Library Services LLC, Tennessee Book Company LLC, Ingram Content Group UK Ltd. and Ingram Content Group Australia Pty Ltd. *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, work related mental or physical disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetic information.* * *EOE\-Race/Gender/Veterans/Disabled* * *We participate in EVerify.* * *EEO Poster in English* * *EEO Poster in Spanish*

If you’re passionate about innovation, driven by impact, and ready to grow with a company that puts **People First**, you’ll find your place here. **Job Summary:** The Solutions Engineer II is responsible for the successful implementation of project work in the Integris Professional Services department. They are also responsible for owning solution implementations for internal and external customers, meeting project deadlines, creating Integris documentation, and working in a team environment to provide the highest level of service. This position acts as the lead engineer on customer projects, participating in standard creation, automation, product, and technology evaluation. **Job Responsibilities:** * Assist in or communicate project milestones with project management, client, and internal service teams. * Support and execute tasks related to: + Exchange and SharePoint migrations – lead planning and execution, troubleshoot issues, and optimize configurations. + Tenant\-to\-Tenant and Azure infrastructure migrations – design migration strategies, implement secure configurations, and validate performance. + Networking fundamentals – configure VLANs, firewalls, and switches; May require business travel locally or nationally up to 20% of time to facilitate project implementation. * **Job Qualifications** *Education/Certification Requirements:* * Associate’s degree in business or computer\-related field or equivalent education/experience. * Certification Requirements: Must have, or complete, AZ\-305, CCNP, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, VCP, Azure Solution Architect, M365 Enterprise Expert Admin, FCSS in Network Security or Network Security Essential for Cloud\-Managed Fireboxes, or equivalent demonstrated experience. *Experience Requirements:* * 4\+ years working in Information Technology, experience with an MSP is preferred. * 1\-2 years of project implementation experience. * 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience with Server Administration, Implementation and Migrations * Moderate to Extensive knowledge of mainstream virtualization technologies and 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience migrating between them * Moderate to Extensive knowledge of Server Operating systems and best practice configurations as well as 1\-3 years hands experience of deep troubleshooting in those environments. * Moderate knowledge of networking infrastructure best practices. ex. VLAN, Firewall, switching, layer 3 routing and managed networking appliances. * Able to deploy, upgrade, and troubleshoot firewalls, manage switches, wireless controllers and WAPs. * Moderate knowledge of and 1\-2 years’ hands on experience with Enterprise Backup solutions Ex. SAN’s and on\-premises and off premises backup solutions * ITIL concept familiarity At **Integris**, we value our team members and **offer comprehensive benefits**, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401K Retirement Plan * Minimum 4 Weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) * Birthday PTO * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteering * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Life Insurance * Supplemental Insurance Employee Assistance Program * Join us in transforming IT services for small and midsize businesses across regulated industries. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, familial status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable federal, state, and local laws.* *\#LI\-Remote*
