jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Improving healthcare through innovative technology is at the core of Intelerad’s work. Our scalable medical imaging platform connects clinicians to a powerful imaging ecosystem that is fast, smart, and tapped into the data they need, no matter their location. We’re focused on delivering a best\-in\-class medical image management solution that improves provider efficiency, decreases the cost of healthcare, and improves the overall health of populations. Intelerad offers one of healthcare’s most comprehensive imaging and analytics platforms. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 700 employees located in offices across six countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Asia/Oceania in the 2021 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report. To learn more, visit intelerad.com and follow Intelerad on LinkedIn and Twitter. **Job Description** **Role Overview** When radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster. As a Senior Software Developer on our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll build the intelligent, cloud\-native solutions that make this possible, streamlining radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll own full\-stack features from design through production on AWS, help shape the team’s technical direction, and raise the bar for quality and security in a regulated healthcare environment. Success in this role means reliable, scalable software that reduces clinical burden and gives time back to the clinicians who depend on it. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and own scalable, high\-performance cloud\-native services and web frontends on AWS using microservices patterns, taking features from design through production support. * Shape technical direction by contributing to system architecture decisions, evaluating new technologies, and helping define the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap. * Raise the bar for quality and reliability by building automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and security best practices into every release. * Partner with Product, UX, and Clinical teams to translate clinical and business needs into practical solutions that meet healthcare data standards (HL7, DICOM) and regulatory requirements. * Mentor and develop fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, fostering a culture of continuous learning across the team. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years of professional software development experience, including 3\+ years building and deploying full\-stack web applications in production. * 3\+ years of hands\-on development experience with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, and ECS/EKS. * Proficiency in Kotlin and Go, or equivalent languages, with a strong grasp of object\-oriented and functional programming. * Expertise designing microservices with Spring Boot, or an equivalent framework, backed by solid knowledge of PostgreSQL or SQL Server. * Experience building web frontends with Angular or React. * Experience delivering in agile teams using Gradle, Git, and modern DevOps practices across Windows and Linux environments. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Experience working with healthcare data standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA\- or FAA\-regulated environments). * Experience with C\# or .NET Core. * Familiarity with jOOQ or similar database abstraction layers. * Hands\-on experience with observability platforms such as Datadog or New Relic. *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Databases
jobs.description: **Company Description** Improving healthcare through innovative technology is at the core of Intelerad’s work. Our scalable medical imaging platform connects clinicians to a powerful imaging ecosystem that is fast, smart, and tapped into the data they need, no matter their location. We’re focused on delivering a best\-in\-class medical image management solution that improves provider efficiency, decreases the cost of healthcare, and improves the overall health of populations. Intelerad offers one of healthcare’s most comprehensive imaging and analytics platforms. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 700 employees located in offices across six countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Asia/Oceania in the 2021 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report. To learn more, visit intelerad.com and follow Intelerad on LinkedIn and Twitter. **Job Description** **Role Overview** When radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster, and behind every worklist, search, and assignment is a database that has to respond quickly and correctly. As a Senior Software Developer focused on the data layer of our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll modernize the SQL Server\-backed platform that streamlines radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll write the code that changes the database: refactoring schemas and queries, untangling legacy data\-access code, and moving it to type\-safe, well\-tested patterns while the system stays live for clinicians. This is a hands\-on software development role, not a database administration role; your time will be spent in code, query plans, and pull requests rather than in backups, patching, or server operations. Success in this role means faster, safer, and more maintainable data access that reduces clinical burden and gives time back to the clinicians who depend on it. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead complex database refactoring across a large, mature SQL Server schema, including restructuring tables, keys, and indexes, retiring legacy structures, and backfilling and normalizing data, delivered as safe, incremental, version\-controlled migrations (e.g., Liquibase) with no disruption to clinical users. * Diagnose and resolve performance problems at the source by reading execution plans, rewriting queries to be sargable and set\-based, replacing row\-by\-row processing with batched writes and properly indexed temp tables, and designing covering and filtered indexes based on real workload evidence. * Modernize the data\-access layer by migrating legacy and inline SQL in PHP and C\# code into type\-safe Kotlin and jOOQ repositories, preserving behavior through characterization, regression, and scale testing. * Harden data access for security and reliability by eliminating SQL injection through parameterization and automated checks, establishing consistent locking, isolation, and query\-timeout conventions, and building query attribution and diagnostics that trace database load back to the code responsible for it. * Build the tooling that makes database change routine, including migration and upgrade pipelines in Gradle and CI/CD, containerized SQL Server test environments, and automated checks that catch regressions before release. * Shape technical direction by defining SQL and data\-access standards, documenting conventions, and contributing to architecture decisions and the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap. * Partner with and mentor fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, helping application teams write efficient, safe database code and fostering a culture of continuous learning. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years of professional software development experience, including 4\+ years in which writing and refactoring database code (SQL, schemas, and data\-access layers) for production systems was a core part of the role. * Expert\-level T\-SQL on Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, temp tables, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and set\-based design; PostgreSQL experience is also valued. * Proven track record of incrementally refactoring a large, legacy relational schema and the application code that depends on it while in production, not only greenfield database design. * Proficiency in Kotlin or Java, or an equivalent language, building backend services with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework. * Hands\-on experience with database migration and version\-control tools such as Liquibase or Flyway, treating schema as code within Git\-based CI/CD pipelines. * Strong understanding of concurrency, locking, isolation levels, and transactional integrity, and how they affect application behavior under load. * Solid grounding in secure data\-access practices, including SQL injection prevention and safe handling of sensitive patient data. * Experience delivering in agile teams using Gradle, Git, and modern DevOps practices across Windows and Linux environments. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Experience with jOOQ or similar type\-safe SQL libraries and code generation from database schemas. * Experience reading, maintaining, and porting legacy application code in PHP and/or C\# (.NET). * Experience with database testing approaches such as Testcontainers or Docker\-based SQL Server environments, golden\-master or characterization tests, and load or scale testing of queries. * Familiarity with SQL Server diagnostic tooling (Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events) and observability platforms such as Datadog or New Relic. * Experience with AWS data services such as Amazon RDS for SQL Server. * Experience working with healthcare data standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA\- or FAA\-regulated environments). * Location: This role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada. *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Applicants may be required to complete an online technical and/or personality assessment as part of your application. \#LI\-REMOTE The base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 to $140,000/yr USD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Salesforce
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The Senior level Software Engineer works effectively across the entire software development life cycle. This includes requirements definition, prototyping, detailed design, coding, testing, deployment, and support of the day\-to\-day operation of production systems. The Senior level Software Engineer is expected to collaborate with technical staff, management, and business operations staff throughout all phases of the software development life cycle to deliver working solutions to complex business problems according to agreed upon timelines and budgets to support the mission, vision, and values of Intermountain Health. The Senior role is a high\-level contributor and has excellent software development skills and develops a good understanding of the business domain. Responsible for implementing and/or integrating new products, processes, methodologies, frameworks, and technologies. Works independently with minimal oversight and direction. Provides guidance, input, and instruction to lower\-level technical professionals. Provides mentoring and training to staff level software engineers. **Candidates who live in, or are willing to relocate to Utah and are within a reasonable commuting distance to Select Health's offices are preferred. Please note that a video interview through Microsoft Teams will be required as well as potential onsite interviews and meetings. This role will work Monday\-Friday during regular business hours.** **Essential Functions** * **Develop** : Develop "best\-in\-class" engineering solutions by ensuring that the components are well\-defined, modularized, secure, reliable, actively monitored and reusable. Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Python, Java or C\# with demonstrable practices in software design principles, data structures, and algorithms. Experience with full\-stack development, including front\-end and back\-end technologies, to develop end\-to\-end solutions. * **Document** : Maintain clear documentation for code, designs, and processes. * **Security** : Follow secure coding practices, implement appropriate security measures, and stay informed about potential security vulnerabilities and threats. * **Deployment and Maintenance** : Strong proficiency with deployment processes, version control systems (e.g., Git), continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and monitoring tools to ensure that software deployments are smooth, and any issues are addressed promptly. * **Methodology** : Work within an agile team including understanding how to participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming and sprint retrospectives. Strong knowledge of software development methodologies, such as Agile or Scrum, and experience working in an Agile environment. * **Passion for learning** : Ability to thrive in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment, with a passion for learning and continuous improvement. Stay updated on new technologies and best practices and create opportunities for team members to better understand what you have learned. Ability to thrive in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment, with a passion for learning and continuous improvement. * **Test and Debug** : Rigorously test code and fix any issues or bugs by writing automated tests, conducting manual testing, and debugging issues to ensure the reliability and stability of the software. * **Problem Solve** : Ability to analyze complex technical problems, break them down into manageable components, and devise solutions using programming languages, algorithms, and data structures. * **Communication and Collaboration** : Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate architecture and design decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Mentor and Coach:** Ability to engage engineering teams on best practices for software architecture, design, and development. **Skills** This Senior Software Engineer role is focused on designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust software solutions using Salesforce technologies. The successful candidate will have an architectural mindset, enabling them to make strategic decisions around system design and optimization. They will work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality features, optimize Salesforce implementations, and drive best practices in code quality, architecture, and performance. jobs.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Jabil is a product solutions company providing comprehensive design, manufacturing, supply chain and product management services. Operating from over 100 facilities in 29 countries, Jabil delivers innovative, integrated and tailored solutions to customers across a broad range of industries and end\-markets, such as automotive, consumer lifestyle and wearable tech, defense and aerospace, connected home and building, industrial and energy, enterprise and infrastructure, healthcare, mobility, packaging and printing. **What Will You Do?** **Cybersecurity \& Network Security Leadership** * Serve as the principal technical expert for cybersecurity, firewall technologies, network architecture, and security operations. * Lead, Design, implement, and maintain secure network infrastructures supporting factory test environments, server validation systems, and rack\-level test operations. * Architect, implement and enforce cybersecurity standards, firewall policies, network segmentation strategies, and access control frameworks. * Lead vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation activities to minimize operational risk. * Drive compliance initiatives and ensure adherence to corporate, customer, regulatory, and industry security requirements. Implement infrastructure hardening and Zero Trust security principles across manufacturing and engineering environments. * **Infrastructure \& Site Reliability Engineering** * Provide sustaining engineering support for manufacturing server (L10\) and rack (L11\) test software and infrastructure, including configuration management and deployment of new product introductions. * Architect, Administer, support, and optimize Fortinet security solutions, including firewall policy management, intrusion prevention, and advanced threat protection. * Manage Arista/Fortinet network environments, including switching, routing, segmentation, and high\-availability network designs. * Create highly available and secure network architecture to support VMware virtualization platforms. * Support enterprise server infrastructure, preferably HPE ProLiant platforms and associated network management technologies. * Support Manage SAN storage environments, preferably NetApp, including provisioning, performance optimization, monitoring, and capacity planning. * Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to create backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions to ensure business continuity and data protection objectives are achieved. Monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, and availability using enterprise monitoring and alerting platforms. * **Operational Excellence** * Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across network, security, storage, virtualization, and server technologies. * Develop and maintain network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, security standards, operating procedures, and knowledge articles. * Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvements that enhance security, reliability, and operational efficiency. * Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, customer, and global IT teams to support production schedules and infrastructure requirements. * Provide escalation support for business\-critical production incidents. Ensure security compliance with company security policies, procedures, and departmental operational requirements. * **Leadership \& Mentorship** * Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to engineers and technical team members. * Promote engineering best practices and support skill development across the Site Reliability Engineering organization. Act as a trusted advisor for infrastructure security architecture, reliability, and operational strategy. * **Education** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered. * **Experience:** * 10\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related enterprise technology environments. * 7\+ years of hands\-on experience managing Fortinet security platforms and Arista networking technologies in enterprise environments. * Proven experience securing manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, test\-development, or industrial environments. ment skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Fortinet certifications (NSE, FCSS, FCX) or equivalent cybersecurity certifications. * Experience with Zero Trust architecture and industrial/manufacturing cybersecurity practices. * Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or similar standards. * Experience with SIEM platforms, vulnerability assessment tools, and security auditing solutions. * Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI infrastructure, or high\-volume manufacturing operations. Experience working in global, multi\-site, and multicultural environments. * **Travel** Domestic and international travel up to 25% may be required. * **What Can Jabil Offer You?** Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes: * Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options * 401K Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Paid Time Off * Tuition Reimbursement * Life, AD\&D, and Disability Insurance * Commuter Benefits * Employee Assistance Program * Pet Insurance * Adoption Assistance * Annual Merit Increases The pay range for this role is $126,100 \- $227,000\. jobs.title: Alltrista - Engineer, Tooling
jobs.description: Alltrista Plastics LLC, is a subsidiary of Jadex Inc., and is a leading manufacturer in high\-volume, precision injection molded parts. The company designs and manufactures with proprietary engineering processes and extensive manufacturing capabilities, from five (5\) locations worldwide. From the first spark of an idea, through the design of the mold to the actual manufactured product, Alltrista Plastics focuses all efforts on delivering innovative plastic solutions. The company’s core markets include Consumer Products, Medical/Healthcare, Personal Care, Health \& Beauty, Caps \& Closures, and Packaging. **EMPLOYER’S NAME:** Alltrista Plastics LLC **POSITION TITLE:** Tooling Engineer **POSITION DUTIES:** Work closely with Sales and Engineering to understand part design requirements and identify the best technological solutions for molding — including mold design, machine specifications, cavitation, and cycle time. Contribute to part design decisions and specify general tool designs, components, and controls for new molds. Approve mold designs prior to the start of mold builds and lead design reviews with selected suppliers for awarded programs. Source and select qualified suppliers capable of building required molds and machinery, maintaining strong working relationships to solicit and organize a high volume of quotes. Provide supplier quote information to the quoting team to support accurate part and project pricing. Apply learnings from quoting and build activities to continuously improve the quoting process and maintain an up\-to\-date Approved Supplier List. Monitor new mold and machine builds, conduct vendor mold run\-offs to verify quality, function, and performance to specification, and participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Validation (IQ, OQ, PQ). Support Account Managers and Program Managers in technical subject matter execution. 20% domestic and international travel required. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent or any combination of education and/or experience in Engineering Management or Mechanical Engineering * Five (5\) years of experience in the job offered or in a managerial position in the plastics industry * Requires responsibility for determining overall project requirements, conducting first article testing of injection molds and systems, interpreting blueprints, determining system solutions and overseeing technical feasibility for components, supporting technology transfer, and planning and scheduling tool building, managing capital spending and capacity tooling. Requires injection molding experience including establishing process capability studies and validating manufacturing processes, installing and testing processes, coordinating mold trials, providing technical expertise for injection molding systems, performing manufacturing audits, investigating equipment failures and technical complaints, and delivering technical training on manufacturing processes. Requires experience implementing cost reduction initiatives in tooling, die cast, and injection molding areas. Requires experience in cost estimation including preparing estimates and quotations for parts, molds, systems, and supporting activities to reduce manufacturing and operational costs. Experience with tooling and manufacturing engineering is also required. * 20% domestic and international travel required. Jadex Inc and its Businesses do not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non\-merit factor.

jobs.title: Data Scientist III
jobs.description: **Title:** **Data Scientist III** ================================= Location: Newport News, Virginia, US, 23606 Category: Computer Science Technology and IT Work Arrangement Type: Hybrid \- About 60% on\-site Classification: Staff Computer Scientist III Description: **At Jefferson Lab, you’ll champion cutting\-edge science and operational excellence while shaping the future of discovery. Join us and make your mark – where excellence meets purpose, and great minds truly** ***matter.*** ***The good\-faith pay range for this role is $118,400 \- $ 186,850 per year. Actual compensation may vary and may be above the posted range based on factors such as a candidate's skills, experience, education, certifications, and work location.*** ***Company\-provided relocation assistance will be offered for this position.*** **What your job will be like:** ------------------------------- You will lead high impact, data driven research that supports mission critical programs across environmental science, climate modeling, nuclear physics, and energy systems. You will design advanced statistical and machine learning solutions for complex scientific challenges, build scalable data workflows, and collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to push forward innovation in computational science. Your work will directly support national research priorities, scientific discovery, and resilience\-focused modeling efforts. **In this job you will:** ------------------------- * Develop advanced data science models including spatiotemporal statistical frameworks, deep learning architectures, generative models, and probabilistic simulations. * Build surrogate models, reduced order models, advanced surrogate and probabilistic machine\-learning models, and streaming data inference tools for large\-scale scientific datasets. * Design workflows for uncertainty quantification, extreme value analysis, statistical validation, and multi model data fusion. * Conduct research leveraging high\-performance computing, scientific data compression, and scalable analytics in support of exascale computational environments. * Collaborate with scientists and engineers to translate complex scientific questions into robust computational or statistical solutions. * Publish research findings in peer\-reviewed journals; present work at national and international scientific meetings. * Lead and contribute to federally funded research programs (e.g., DOE ASCR, SciDAC, BER, NP), serving as PI, Co PI, or institutional lead as required. **Additional Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Support proposal development for data\-driven scientific initiatives. * Contribute to scientific community service, including reviewing journal submissions, proposal evaluations, special issue editing, and participation in professional societies. * Assist in organizing workshops, symposia, and technical sessions related to data science, machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and environmental modeling. * Engage in outreach activities such as invited talks, lectures, and panel discussions. **Lead \- Supervisory \- Management** ------------------------------------- * Mentor postdocs, graduate students, and interns on advanced machine learning, statistical modeling, and computational research topics. **Experience** -------------- * Required: 6 or more years in data science, applied statistics, or scientific machine learning. * Required: Demonstrated research contributions in one or more of the following areas:o Spatiotemporal modelingo Deep learning and generative modelso Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling. * Required: Environmental or geophysical data analysis Surrogate modeling and dimensionality reduction Extreme\-event modeling and uncertainty quantification * Required: Experience working with large heterogeneous datasets and scientific computing environments. * Required: Experience mentoring junior researchers. * Preferred: 10 or more years in data science, applied statistics, or scientific machine learning. * Preferred: Experience in national laboratory environments or large\-scale federal scientific programs. * Preferred: Publications in climate science, environmental modeling, applied mathematics, machine learning, or nuclear physics. * Preferred: Familiarity with DOE research programs and federal funding mechanisms. **Education** ------------- * Required: Bachelor's Degree Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Science, or a related field. * Preferred: Ph.D. Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Science, or a related field. **Experience and Education Exchange** ------------------------------------- Education above the minimum may be substituted for experience. Relevant experience may not be substituted for education. **Licenses and Certifications** ------------------------------- **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ * Advanced knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, generative modeling, and probabilistic simulation. * Strong mathematical foundations in multivariate analysis, dimension reduction, clustering, and extreme value theory. * Ability to develop scalable ML/AI workflows for scientific applications. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplinary teams. * Ability to design, validate, and interpret complex scientific models. * Familiarity with scientific Python, HPC environments, and data compression frameworks. * Ability to support mission\-driven research and tight federal deliverables. **Additional Licenses and Certifications** ------------------------------------------ **About Jefferson Lab** Join a community with a common purpose of solving the most challenging scientific and engineering problems of our time. The Jefferson Lab campus is located in southeastern Virginia amidst a vibrant and growing technology community. A career at Jefferson Lab is more than a job. You will be part of “big science” and work alongside top scientists and engineers from around the world unlocking the secrets of our visible universe. Managed by SURATech, LLC, Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility is entering an exciting period of mission growth and is seeking new team members ready to apply their skills and passion to have an impact. You could call it work, or you could call it a mission. We call it a challenge. We do things that will change the world. **Total Rewards at Jefferson Lab** At Jefferson Lab, we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e\-mail to recruiting@jlab.org or contact Human Resources by calling (757\) 269\-7100 and selecting option 1 between 8 am – 5 pm EST to provide the nature of your request. This includes positions or appointments, both domestic and foreign, titled academic, professional, or institutional appointments whether or not remuneration is received and whether full\-time, part\-time or voluntary. **Nearest Major Market:** Hampton Roads

jobs.title: Sr. Global Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** KLA's Global Workplace Services (GWS) team is passionate about advancing our business goals and company culture by building workplace environments that foster teamwork, innovation and productivity. GWS is responsible for site improvements to support business needs, promoting a secure work environment, regulation compliance, safety protocol implementation, emergency preparedness and risk mitigation. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. KLA's Global Engineering \& Operational Standards (GEOS) team is seeking a Senior Global Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer to own and advance KLA's instrumentation, controls, and Building Management System (BMS) strategy across its global portfolio of facilities and Super Sites. This is a highly autonomous, senior\-level role for a self\-directed engineer with deep technical expertise in BMS/SCADA architecture, controls integration, and facility automation, operating independently with minimal oversight across a complex, matrixed global organization. The successful candidate will serve as KLA's global subject matter expert (SME) for instrumentation and controls within the built environment. This role will be setting standards, driving consistency, and leading technical strategy from concept through execution. This role requires the ability to take full ownership of global BMS strategy, implementation, and standardization without day\-to\-day direction, and to influence stakeholders across regions, functions, and seniority levels. **Key Responsibilities:** **I\&C Standards \& Design Governance** * Develop, own, and maintain KLA's global instrumentation and controls engineering standards, specifications, and technical guidelines across all facility types and Super Sites * Lead controls and instrumentation design reviews for capital projects and critical infrastructure upgrades; ensure compliance with GEOS standards at each project gate * Establish and enforce I\&C engineering requirements within KLA's PLC (phase\-gated project lifecycle) process, coordinating with the Capital Project Delivery organization * Serve as the authoritative technical voice on controls architecture decisions, including points lists, sequences of operation, sensor selection, and system integration strategy * Author and maintain global instrumentation and controls specifications within KLA's ecosystem **Global BMS Strategy \& Implementation** * Own global BMS strategy, implementation, and standardization across KLA's Super Site portfolio, consolidating disparate platforms onto a single global standard * Lead the technical strategy and execution for flagship BMS programs, from readiness through successful rollout * Conduct and lead Super Site BMS/BAS/SCADA maturity assessments to define current\-state architecture, identify gaps, and inform a phased global rollout roadmap * Define BMS system topology, integration architecture, and OT/IT boundary requirements in partnership with IT/Cybersecurity * Evaluate and recommend BMS/SCADA platforms, vendors, and architectures to meet enterprise reliability, scalability, and cybersecurity needs **Global BMS Strategy \& Implementation** * Serve as controls and BMS subject matter expert on capital projects, reviewing I\&C and BMS scope for commissioning readiness * Review control architecture, points lists, instrumentation requirements, and integration strategies for proposed facility modifications * Partner with cross\-functional engineering disciplines (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Process) to ensure integrated, reliable facility design * Support data center and critical environment monitoring design, including environmental and alarm monitoring systems **Program Ownership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Operate as a fully autonomous contributor; own your workstreams from scoping through delivery; proactively identify gaps and drive resolution * Collaborate with regional GWS leads, IFM partners, and capital project managers to embed controls standards into facility operations and project execution globally * Partner with the global systems leads to ensure BMS and controls asset data integrity within KLA's IWMS platforms * Represent GEOS in cross\-functional technical forums, vendor negotiations, and IT/cybersecurity coordination; prepare technical briefs and executive\-ready summaries as needed * Support GEOS knowledge\-sharing through documented standards, technical playbooks, and training materials **Preferred Skills** * Experience leading a BMS platfor osely related engineering field * Eight (8\) years of experience in instrumentation, controls, or BMS/BAS engineering with direct responsibility for facility\-scale automation systems in complex environments (semiconductor, life sciences, data centers, or similar high\-reliability industries preferred) * Demonstrated expertise in BMS/BAS/SCADA architecture, including platforms such as Siemens, Trane, or equivalent building automation systems * Hands\-on experience with controls integration protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, OPC UA) and OT/IT network segmentation * Experience with facility\-scale instrumentation, sensor selection, and monitoring system design in a global, multi\-site portfolio context * Proven ability to work autonomously across time zones, cultures, and functional teams; this role requires self\-direction and proactive ownership * Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce standards documents, design specifications, and executive\-level briefings **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $121,500\.00 \- $178,233\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. **Equal Opportunity Statement** KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.title: SVP, Head of Identity & Access Management
jobs.description: ***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion*** At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees. If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today. **Position Summary** The Senior Vice President, Identity \& Access Management (IAM) is responsible for leading LPL Financial's enterprise IAM organization and advancing the firm's identity security strategy, governance, engineering, operations, and resiliency capabilities. This executive leader oversees all aspects of workforce, advisor, partner, and privileged identity management, ensuring secure and compliant access to firm resources while enabling business growth and digital transformation. The SVP will lead a large\-scale IAM organization responsible for Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Authentication Services, Directory Services, Identity Engineering, Production Support, and Identity Platform Operations. The role will also drive modernization efforts focused on Zero Trust principles, operational resilience, automation, cloud identity services, and regulatory compliance. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this position will partner closely with Technology, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit, Human Capital, and business leaders across the organization. **What You'll Do** **Enterprise IAM Leadership** * Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of LPL's Identity \& Access Management program. * Establish a multi\-year IAM roadmap aligned to Cybersecurity and Technology priorities. * Serve as the senior leader accountable for IAM operations, platform stability, service delivery, and risk management. * Drive continuous improvement of identity controls, governance processes, and operational effectiveness. * Develop and maintain executive\-level reporting on IAM risks, priorities, performance, and organizational health. **Identity Security \& Governance** * Lead Identity Governance and Administration programs, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access certification, role management, and segregation\-of\-duties controls. * Ensure adherence to least\-privilege and Zero Trust security principles across the enterprise. * Establish IAM policies, standards, and governance frameworks. * Partner with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure alignment with regulatory and audit requirements. **Platform Engineering \& Operations** * Oversee IAM engineering, production support, and operational teams responsible for enterprise identity platforms. * Lead modernization efforts across Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication services, federation, and Single Sign\-On capabilities. * Ensure scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence across critical identity infrastructure. * Drive automation and reduction of manual operational processes to improve reliability and risk management. **Privileged Access Management** * Lead strategy and governance for privileged access across users, systems, applications, and service accounts. * Strengthen access controls through centralized governance, monitoring, and least\-privileged access models. * Ensure effective controls over administrative and elevated access activities. **Operational Resilience \& Stability** * Own resilience and availability strategies for critical IAM platforms and services. * Lead initiatives related to disaster recovery, high availability, identity provider resiliency, and business continuity planning. * Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to improve platform reliability and reduce operational risk. * Establish metrics and accountability frameworks supporting production stability and change governance. **Organizational Leadership** * Lead and develop a high\-performing organization consisting of leaders, architects, engineers, analysts, and support professionals. * Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. * Develop succession plans and organizational capabilities to support future growth. * Manage budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, and strategic investments. **Executive Comportment** * Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where scale, priorities, and organizational structure evolve quickly. * Balances pace and pragmatism with disciplined risk management, favoring practical progress over process for its own sake. * Builds trust and credibility quickly across a highly matrixed organization, earning confidence from business partners, technology peers, auditors, and regulators alike. * Leads confidently through ambiguity, translating strategic intent into action even where processes or org structures are still maturing. * Is a v t, adapting readily as business priorities, regulatory expectations, and the threat landscape shift. * Communicates with transparency and executive presence, building confidence with senior leadership, the Board, and regulators. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline. * 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in cybersecurity, identity management, or enterprise technology. * 8\+ years leading large\-scale IAM, cybersecurity, or security engineering organizations. * Deep expertise in: + Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA) + Privileged Access Management (PAM) + Single Sign\-On (SSO) + Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) + Federation and authentication platforms + Directory Services and cloud identity technologies * Experience leading enterprise transformation and modernization programs. * Demonstrated success managing large, geographically dispersed technical organizations. * Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. **Preferred** * Experience within financial services, wealth management, banking, brokerage, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience with Ping Identity, ForgeRock, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, or related identity technologies. * Master's degree in a related field. * CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or equivalent certifications **Pay Range:** $212,695\.00 \- $354,423\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. jobs.description: **ABOUT LVT** LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI\-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar\-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands\-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest\-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting\-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it. * **A Top\-Tier Growth Company:** Named one of the *Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025* and *\#10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional* list for 2025\. * **Innovative Leadership:** Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an *EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025*, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the *Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame* in 2024\. * **Product \& Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025\. ### **ABOUT THIS ROLE** As a Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead at LVT, you will set the technical direction for a team of backend engineers building the Node.js and TypeScript services that power our platform. You will pair hands\-on delivery with technical leadership: shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring engineers as the team ships. Working alongside Product, QA, and DevOps, you will turn ambiguous requirements into reliable, high\-quality software and remove the bottlenecks that slow the team down. LVT is a flexible\-first company. This role is hybrid and based out of our American Fork, UT office. ### **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead the technical direction of a team of software engineers, defining architecture, methodologies, and best practices that shape the team's engineering culture. * Build and maintain production\-grade Node.js/TypeScript backend services and APIs, staying a high\-velocity contributor alongside the team. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day\-to\-day coaching to raise the team's technical bar. * Drive continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tools and workflows that increase productivity and efficiency. * Partner with Product Management, QA, and DevOps to define project requirements, provide development estimates, and ensure seamless integration. * Plan, execute, and deliver software projects on schedule, managing timelines and shifting priorities. * Foster open communication and knowledge sharing within the team and across partner functions. * Track industry trends and emerging technologies, and identify opportunities to apply them to improve product development. ### **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. * **Backend Depth:** 7\+ years of professional development experience with a focus on backend/API development. * **Node.js/TypeScript Expertise:** 3\+ years of professional experience in Node.js/TypeScript, with a track record of building and maintaining Node.js production services. * **Root\-Cause Problem Solver:** Excellent problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis skills, with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges amid ambiguous requirements. * **Quality Obsessed:** An obsession with completeness and quality in everything you ship. * **Clear Communicator:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to align engineers and cross\-functional partners. * **Adaptable:** Thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and switches between priorities quickly. * **Agile Practitioner:** Experience with agile software development methodologies and familiarity with related tools and processes. * **API \& Data Skills (Desired):** GraphQL query and mutation implementation and optimization; OpenAPI/REST API design and development; SQL and Java experience preferred. * **Platform \& Infrastructure (Desired):** NestJS; Docker, Kubernetes, and related CI/CD tools; MQTT and Protocol Buffers. **BENEFITS** We believe you do your best jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI** ========================================= **REMOTE \- US** ---------------- **JOB OVERVIEW** Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands\-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES** **Agent definition.** Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre\-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. **Problem selection.** The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. **The human\-in\-the\-loop contract.** Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first\-class design problem. **Build quality.** You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well\-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way. **Evaluation.** Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not. **Specifications.** Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground\-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends. **Commercialization.** Partner with go\-to\-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them. **Design\-partner delivery.** Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke. **TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS** Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves: * Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior * Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything * Using agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) daily: prototyping, data analysis, specification work, and reading the codebase behind your specifications * Reviewing an execution trace and diagnosing whether a failure originates in a tool description, a retrieval gap, a context\-window constraint, an under\-specified output schema, or a genuine model limitation * Building and running evaluation sets, and interpreting the results without a data scientist to translate them * Holding an informed position on retrieval design, tool\-use patterns, structured output, model routing, latency and w Legion Technologies, Inc. Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer\-first software with cost\-efficient, large\-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in. We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute. **The Way We Work** ------------------- The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice: * **Move with Urgency:** We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high\-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable. This is a software\-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware\-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale. *This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management * Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management * Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure ### **Provisioning \& Lifecycle Management** * Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management * Automate infrastructure bring\-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems * Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems * Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle ### **Reliability \& Observability** * Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure * Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues * Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation * Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows ### **Architecture \& Collaboration** * Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities * Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI's infrastructure software * Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution * Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object\-oriented programming languages * Strong experience with Linux in production environments * Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts * Understanding of HPC and bare\-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out\-of\-band management * Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long\-term reliability and scale * Experience working in a startup or other fast\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy ### **Ideal Experience** * Experience with bare\-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware * Experience with GPU servers, either in bare\-metal environments or under virtualization * Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks * Experience with high\-performance storage systems, particularly VAST * Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale **Compensation** ---------------- **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well\-being, and long\-term success: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents. * **Meaningful Equity:** RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long\-term success. * **Retirement Savings:** 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.). * **Flexible Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work\-life balance. * **Company\-Wide Winter Break:** Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge. * **Paid Parental \& Family Leave:** Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments. * **Professional Development:** Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth. * **Wellness Benefits:** Wellness and work\-from\-home stipends to support your physical and mental well\-being. * **Sabbatical Program:** Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service. * **Flexible Work:** Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office\-based teams. * **In\-Office Meals:** Complimentary meals at our office hubs. jobs.description: Responsible AI Senior Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time Job No. R00363318 \| Multiple Locations **We Are:** Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world's leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. Our Responsible AI capability, within our broader AI \& Data practice, sits at the intersection of deep industry knowledge, applied AI engineering, and trusted AI governance. We help the world's leading organizations build and run production\-grade AI and agentic systems that are safe, fair, transparent, and compliant by design, not by afterthought. We are not looking for generalists who advise on AI risk in the abstract. We need a practitioner who has built, shipped, and run AI systems at scale, who understands exactly where the technical, ethical, and operational risks live, and who can engineer the guardrails directly into the architecture and the delivery model, across both onshore and offshore teams. **You Are:** You are a Responsible AI Senior Manager who makes trustworthy AI real by building it, not just reviewing it. You bring that credibility because you are, at your core, a deeply technical AI and Data delivery leader: you have designed and shipped production AI, agentic AI, and data science solutions yourself, and you have led large, distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations to do the same at scale. You are equally comfortable in a model architecture review, an agentic workflow design session, and a governance committee, and you use that technical fluency to embed fairness, transparency, safety, and compliance directly into how systems are designed, built, tested, and operated. You set the technical and ethical standard for how generative and agentic AI gets built, secured, and run, and you lead the engineering, data science, and delivery teams who build it. **The Work:** * jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Manufacturing Engineer, Systems \& Automation **Company:** Lowell Corporation **Location:** West Boylston, Massachusetts **Position Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM **Compensation:** Salary paid weekly, exempt status About the Role Lowell Corporation is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer, Systems \& Automation to strengthen our shop\-floor engineering capability and help modernize how we manufacture and support our products. This is not an entry\-level or purely software\-focused position. We are looking for an engineer who already understands how a manufacturing shop operates, is comfortable working directly with machinists and production equipment, and can apply sound engineering judgment to real production problems. The role is highly project\-focused. You will work closely with ownership, engineering, and production on CNC process improvement, tooling and workholding, new product setup, troubleshooting, automation, lights\-out manufacturing, and the development of more structured engineering systems. Technology and software are important tools in the role, but practical manufacturing knowledge comes first. Key Responsibilities · Own manufacturing engineering support for new and existing products, including process planning, BOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling requirements, and first\-run support. · Work directly with machinists and production personnel to solve shop\-floor problems involving machining, setups, tooling, fixtures, workholding, quality, cycle time, and repeatability. · Improve CNC machining processes and support CAM/programming optimization in coordination with shop programmers and operators. · Evaluate manufacturability of new parts and jobs, determine practical production methods, and support transition from quote or design into repeatable production. · Lead root\-cause analysis and continuous\-improvement projects involving scrap, rework, downtime, process capability, and production bottlenecks. · Support and expand lights\-out and unattended machining through better processes, probing, inspection, monitoring, tooling, and machine reliability. · Evaluate and implement practical shop\-floor automation and equipment improvements where they can improve capacity, quality, safety, or labor efficiency. · Lead manufacturing and engineering special projects from problem definition through design, implementation, follow\-up, and measurable results. · Document and standardize successful processes so improvements are repeatable and scalable across the organization. · Use modern engineering tools, including AI\-assisted CAM, automation, data analysis, and software, where they provide a practical advantage to manufacturing. Required Experience and Capabilities We are looking for someone with proven engineering judgment developed through real shop\-floor experience. Strong academic credentials are valuable, but they are not a substitute for having worked in a manufacturing environment and solved production problems firsthand. · At least 3 years of hands\-on manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or comparable shop\-floor engineering experience in a machine shop, precision manufacturing, or similar production environment. · Direct familiarity with CNC machining and production equipment, with the ability to work credibly and effectively alongside machinists and operators. · Strong mechanical and manufacturing engineering fundamentals, including tolerances, materials, GD\&T, inspection, and process capability. · Practical experience with tooling, fixtures, workholding, setups, process planning, and manufacturing problem solving. · Experience developing or maintaining BOMs, routings, process plans, work instructions, or other manufacturing engineering documentation. · Demonstrated ability to take a manufacturing problem or improvement opportunity from analysis through implementation rather than stopping at recommendation. · Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred; equivalent hands\-on engineering experience will be considered. Preferred Experience · CAM programming or process optimization using SolidWorks, Autodesk Fusion, or similar CAD/CAM software. · Fanuc controller programming with G and M coding for CNC milling and lathe operations · Lights\-out or unattended machining, probing, in\-process inspection, or machine monitoring. · Manufacturing automation, robotics, controls, sensors, or machine integration. · ERP/MRP engineering data, including BOMs, routings, item setup, or engineering changes. · Python, SQL, data analysis, AI\-assisted engineering tools, or other software skills that can be applied to manufacturing problems. · New product introduction, first\-article support, fixture design, or production launch experience. Why Lowell This is an opportunity to play a visible, hands\-on role in how an established precision manufacturing company improves its engineering and production capabilities. You will not be limited to maintaining existing processes. We want someone who can identify better ways to manufacture, solve problems, and implement improvements that have a measurable effect on the shop. Lowell is investing in advanced CNC manufacturing, automation, lights\-out production, improved engineering systems, and new technology. The right engineer will have the opportunity to combine strong manufacturing fundamentals with these tools to help shape how the company operates going forward. Position Details · Full\-time, salaried, exempt position. · On site in West Boylston, Massachusetts, with regular shop\-floor presence. · Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. · No regular travel required. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Do you have a Bachelors degree in Engineering, and what kind? * What other important qualifications do you have for this position that should be considered * How much shop floor experience do you have with various CNC and other shop equipment? Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Work Location: In person

equipment, lifting solutions, and restricted/safety\-critical tooling. * Partner with Engineering and Field Service Engineering to translate vehicle service requirements into scalable tooling influence across organizations without direct authority. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience jobs.description: ### **Job Overview** Mainspring is seeking a Manager, CAD \& Design Systems to build and scale the Mechanical Engineering organization responsible for CAD operations, product definition, product integration, design release, and configuration management. prioritize improvements based on engineering productivity and product risk * Establish metrics and continuous\-improvement mechanisms for CAD throughput, release cycle time, product\-definition quality, configuration integrity, and team capacity ### **Qualifications** * BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience * 10\+ years of experience in mechanical product development, CAD, product definition, or related engineering disciplines, including 3\+ years leading technical teams * Deep experience with production CAD environments and strong working knowledge of SolidWorks or comparable parametric CAD systems * Experience with CATIA or another enterprise large\-assembly CAD platform strongly preferred * Demonstrated experience improving CAD standards, engineering workflows, product\-data quality, or design\-release processes in a growing hardware organization * Strong understanding of drawings, GD\&T, BOMs, engineering changes, configuration control, and manufacturing handoffs * Ability to think beyond day\-to\-day execution and build systems, processes, and teams that scale * Strong cross\-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Configuration Management, and software/tooling teams ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ENOVIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, or another enterprise PLM/PDM environment * Experience building or maintaining full\-product reference assemblies and product configuration strategies * Experience scaling a CAD/design organization from a small transactional team into a broader product\-definition and integration function This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
