jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You own the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer. This is a senior, hands\-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements. **What makes this role different** * Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal * Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human * Per\-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti\-leakage discipline * Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in\-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment **Requirements** * **Staff\-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes. * **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands\-on depth in time\-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient\-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit\-learn and pandas or Polars. * **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool\-using agents, and structured (schema\-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework. * **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users. * **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use. * **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non\-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials. * **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production\-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software. * **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements. Nice\-to\-haves* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP\&A data and the audit expectations around it. * **Feature\-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models. * **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment. * **Sparse and zero\-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros. * **Multi\-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi\-tenant SaaS, single\-tenant SaaS and on\-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Meeru AI Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — **SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises** — across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. The Role We are looking for a **Staff Data Engineer** to build and own the major subsystems of the data foundation — the pipelines, connectors, and curated models that feed the platform's analytics and AI layers. You take the data architecture and standards set by the data lead and turn them into robust, production\-grade systems that don't break and don't lie about the numbers. You own significant pieces of the platform end to end complex transformations over the warehouse, source integrations for new customer systems, and the reconciliation and lineage that prove the curated model ties back to source. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership engineering role with a clear path toward Senior Staff. **Requirements** * **7\+ years in data engineering.** You've owned complex, production pipelines end to end, including how they perform, how reliable they are and what they cost to run. * **Expert SQL and data modeling.** You write complex, set\-based transformations over a cloud warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL or similar) and design models other teams build on. * **dbt in production.** You've built and maintained real dbt projects, including incremental models that refresh efficiently instead of rebuilding everything. * **Production orchestration with Airflow or Dagster.** You design DAGs that are safe to rerun and backfill. * **Warehouse internals and performance tuning.** You know why a query is slow or expensive on large datasets and how to fix it. * **A bias toward correctness.** You treat data tests, reconciliation against source and lineage as core to the job, and you build pipelines that are idempotent and reproducible. * **Solid Python.** Enough to write pipeline code, tests and tooling that others can maintain. * **Comfort with messy source systems.** You've integrated real\-world sources with inconsistent data and changing schemas, and kept downstream models stable. * **Collaboration and mentorship.** You agree data contracts with backend and AI teams, review peers' work and mentor senior and mid\-level engineers. **Nice to have** * **ERP and financial data.** Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or Workday, or with finance data such as general ledger, accounts payable, payroll and HRIS. * **CDC and managed ingestion.** Change\-data\-capture pipelines or tools like Fivetran. * **Multi\-cloud and customer\-hosted deployments.** Work across AWS, Azure and GCP, ideally where pipelines run inside customer environments with strict tenant isolation and no data leaving. * **A wider warehouse range.** Oracle ADW, Apache Pinot or MySQL alongside the main warehouses. * **FinTech or financial\-services exposure.** You understand why finance teams need numbers that tie out to the cent. * **Reusable integration frameworks.** You've built connectors or mappings as configuration on a shared framework, so the next source is faster to onboard. * **Test and synthetic data.** You've built golden or synthetic datasets for regression testing. * **Interest in architectural ownership.** This role has a clear path toward Senior Staff.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Developer Introduction: Join our growing team as an AI Solutions Developer, where you will harness your technical expertise and knowledge of AI technologies to drive operational efficiency across our organization. This role is tailored for a professional who is passionate about applying AI agent development, low\-code/no\-code solutions, and helping users leverage AI in common applications to streamline processes and enhance productivity. The focus is on key business workflows and targeted automation needs. You will collaborate closely with the Business Systems Analyst, the Senior Software Architect, and various teams to augment operational workflows, building solutions that are fast to deploy, well\-documented, and aligned with the firm's architectural standards. The position will report to the Software Development Team supervisor and be based out of the Westwood office. Job Requirements: * 2\-4 years of relevant experience in software development, with proficiency in AI coding and automation. * Working proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building scripts and workflows for AI agent development. * Demonstrated experience with low\-code/no\-code platforms and AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, Pega, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). * Ability to assess business needs and recommend the right\-sized solution, whether that's leveraging built\-in AI features, configuring a low\-code workflow, or developing a custom script. * Experience with API integrations and connecting tools to existing business systems. * Working knowledge of data management practices, including data extraction, validation, and transformation. * Familiarity with software development lifecycle principles, including basic architectural patterns, code review, and change management. * Ability to articulate how automation solutions fit within a broader systems architecture. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve complex problems and develop practical solutions. * Ability to translate business needs into practical automation solutions. * Ability to evaluate AI output quality and reliability * Excellent collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional teams. * A proactive mindset with a passion for experimenting with new technologies and approaches. jobs.title: Project Lead Engineer - High Voltage Industrial and Data Centers
jobs.description: **About Methode Electronics** We are a leading global provider of innovative automotive and industrial electronic products, including center stacks, switch banks, sensors, high\-voltage busbars, Battery Disconnect Units (BDU), Integrated Circuit Boards (ICB), park brake actuators, ambient lights, and Center High\-Mount Stop Lights (CHMSL). Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability positions us at the forefront of the industry, delivering high\-performance power distribution solutions to customers worldwide. **Role Purpose** We are seeking a highly qualified **Mechanical Engineer** to play a crucial role in the Product Development lifecycle of innovative high\-voltage power distribution components. This role owns the design, analysis, and validation of critical systems, with a core focus on **data center busbars**, industrial power pathways, and wire harnesses. Leading projects from concept to production launch, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry experts to ensure designs meet rigorous electrical, thermal, structural, and manufacturing specifications. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design \& New Product Development (NPD):** Specify, design, and develop high\-voltage components, focusing on **data center busbars** and high\-power wire harnesses. Utilize advanced 3D CAD software to generate detailed models, architectural layouts, and production\-ready manufacturing drawings. * **Vertical Busbar Engineering \& Attributes:** Optimize vertical busbar architectures for critical data center infrastructure, ensuring precise execution of core attributes: + *Electrical \& Thermal:* Manage high current density, skin effect, voltage drop constraints and short\-circuit current ratings. + *Mechanical \& Structural:* Design for seismic bracing requirements, structural loading, expansion joints (to handle thermal expansion/contraction across multi\-story risers), and joint integrity. + *Ingress \& Insulation:* Incorporate proper phase isolation, epoxy coating, heat\-shrink insulation, and appropriate Ingress Protection (IP) ratings. * **Analysis \& Simulation:** Collaborate with FEA analysts to define model setups, boundary conditions, and assumptions. Interpret and act upon results from **thermal (CFD)**, fluid flow (**Moldflow** for over molding), and **structural mechanical** **(stress/strain/vibration)** simulations to validate busbar integrity under maximum electrical load and fault conditions. * **Technical Documentation \& Standards:** Apply a comprehensive understanding of **Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing (GD\&T)** to detailed component designs. Ensure all technical documentation, tolerance stacks, and engineering drawings strictly comply with industry standards (e.g., ASME Y14\.5, ANSI, UL 857 / IEC 61439\-6 for busbar trunking systems). * **Materials Expertise:** Apply functional knowledge of material properties—including copper/aluminum conductivity, plating (tin, silver, nickel), insulation chemistry, and polymer selection—to component design, environmental testing, and qualification processes. * **Project Leadership:** Lead cross\-functional product development gates from concept through production release. Act as the primary technical point of contact, ensuring alignment between cost, timeline, tooling feasibility, and customer specifications. **Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of mechanical design experience in New Product Development, specifically focusing on high\-voltage power distribution, industrial busbars, or data center infrastructure. * **CAD/Tools:** Proficiency in advanced 3D CAD platforms (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA) and PLM software. * **Industry Knowledge:** Strong familiarity with copper fabrication, extrusion, over molding, and manufacturing assembly processes. **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will occasionally do immediate reaching and overhead reaching to perform various duties, frequent standing for varied amounts of time to perform various duties, frequent walking for varied amounts of time to perform various duties. Squat or bend to perform various duties. Occasionally climb stairs. **Benefits and Perks:** Methode offers U.S. employees comprehensive benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Hearing, Life and Disability insurance, educational assistance, and paid time off benefits. Voluntary benefit plans include Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Pet Insurance coverage. Employees also have access to valuable discount programs that can contribute to lowering costs off certain technology, automotive, and home appliance products. In addition, Methode provides an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and participation in the Company's 401(k) plan, which includes a company contribution. jobs.title: Process Mining Technical Analyst/Consultant

For over 50 years, we have helped clients design, optimize, and implement end\-to\-end supply chain solutions across industries including consumer goods, food, pharma, retail, and high\-tech. Our global expertise spans Supply Chain Transformation, Engineering \& Operational Excellence, and Digitalization. We are proud to be recognized among SupplyChainBrain’s Top 100 Supply Chain Partners, with many of Gartner’s Top 25 Supply Chains relying on Miebach to support their strategic initiatives. **About the role** We are seeking a Process Mining Technical Analyst to provide technical support throughout process mining projects. The role focuses on data preparation, event\-log development, process mining configuration, data validation, troubleshooting, and analytical support. The successful candidate must understand process and material flows, particularly within warehouse, transportation, manufacturing, or supply chain environments. They will work closely with process mining consultants, data engineers, project managers, and client teams to ensure that the required data, process logic, KPIs, and dashboards are correctly developed and validated. The role may contribute to identifying process issues and improvement opportunities, but developing business recommendations is not the primary responsibility. **Key Responsibilities** **Project Collaboration and Delivery** * Work collaboratively as an active member of multidisciplinary project teams. * Support process mining projects from data discovery through delivery and handover. * Participate in project meetings, workshops, working sessions, and client reviews. * Provide regular updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and open technical topics. ### **Process Understanding and Requirements** * Understand and document operational processes and material flows. * Translate business and process requirements into technical data requirements. * Identify process objects, activities, timestamps, attributes, and relationships. * Support data mapping between source systems and the process mining platform. ### **Data Preparation and Process Models** * Extract, clean, transform, and prepare data from WMS, TMS, ERP, MES, YMS, and other systems. * Build and maintain event logs and process mining data models. * Validate data, process logic, calculations, and analytical outputs. * Investigate data\-quality issues, missing events, inconsistent master data, and unexpected results. ### **Process Mining Analysis and Insights** * Configure process mining analyses, KPIs, dashboards, filters, and process views. * Contribute to the identification of process deviations, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities when required. * Support the preparation of project deliverables, demonstrations, and client presentations. ### **Testing and Technical Troubleshooting** * Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate resolution with the project team, IT teams, and platform specialists. * Prepare test cases and support system testing and user acceptance testing. * Assist with validating system functionality, data connections, and analytical outputs. ### **Documentation and Knowledge Management** * Maintain technical documentation, data dictionaries, assumptions logs, and configuration records. * Document data sources, transformations, process logic, testing results, and relevant project decisions. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field * 2–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, process mining, systems analysis, or technical consulting * Strong understanding of process flows and material flows * Experience working with transactional or operational data * Practical experience with SQL and data preparation * Strong attention to detail and ability to validate complex data relationships * Ability to understand system transactions and connect them to real operational activities * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Good written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders **Technical Skills** * Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and data\-quality checks * Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and ETL/ELT concepts * Strong Excel skills for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation * Experience working with transactional and operational data * Ability to understand data structures and connect system transactions to operational and material flows * Experience with PQL, particularly when working with Celonis, is preferred * Familiarity with process\-mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, UiPath Process Mining, IBM Process Mining, or Apromore is preferred; experience with one or more platforms is sufficient * Experience with Power BI or Tableau is preferred * Familiarity with AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics in process\-mining work—such as anomaly detection, root\-cause analysis, or predictive insights—is a plus * Exposure to APIs, cloud platforms, or data lakes is an asset **Core Competencies** * Understanding of operational and material flows * Technical data analysis * Data quality and validation * Structured troubleshooting * Attention to detail * Documentation and organization * Collaboration and communication * Ability to learn new systems and technologies * Reliability and ownership **Typical Deliverables** * Data requirements and source\-to\-target mappings * Data dictionaries and process\-flow documentation * Event logs and process mining data models * KPI calculations and technical definitions * Dashboards and analytical views * Data\-quality assessments * Test scripts and validation results * Technical documentation and configuration records * Support materials for workshops and client presentations **Why Join Miebach?** * Flexible work hours \& hybrid/remote options * Competitive compensation \+ performance\-based bonuses * Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) * Career development programs \& international training * Flexible PTO, generous parental leave, and paid holidays * 401(k) contributions \& financial wellness Our Manufacturing Quality Engineering Team is responsible for bringing life to Made in USA Hand Tools, with every manufacturing phase of our Made in USA Hand Tool products happening in\-house under the watch of this team. Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. The **Quality Engineer** will support the manufacturing environment through the development, implementation and improvement of quality procedures, instructions and other processes, as well as enforce product dimensional and performance specifications through testing. The Quality Engineer II will also be involved in root cause analysis and process improvement activities. **You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Develop and revise procedures, system instructions, standards and work instructions for new and existing products in a startup factory. * Perform process analysis on machines, equipment and systems to facilitate process improvement and cost reduction. Track process performance and provide feedback to engineering, manufacturing and management. * Perform performance testing on production products to ensure specifications are met. * Maintain product conformance through performing metrology and/or metallurgy inspections. * Work with manufacturing and suppliers in process improvement to reduce process variation and increase process control. * Work with the plant Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure quality product is being supplied/processed is of the highest quality. * Work with cross functional teams on continuous improvement activities through statistical analysis and data analysis, such as process capability study, Gauge R\&R, process flowcharting, design of experiments. * Help manage and create corrective action plans to ensure timely root cause/8D analysis and effective corrective/preventive action. * Participate in reviewing designs of new products and engineering changes with respect to product quality control planning and gauge requirements. * Perform process and quality system audits to ensure compliance to specifications and documented procedures. * Determine acceptance quality levels by means of random sampling techniques, where feasible. * Track project schedules to ensure adherence to timelines * Works on projects and continuous improvement initiatives in a self\-directed manner **What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or related technical field. * 1\-3 years of related work experience in a manufacturing setting. * Experience in metal manufacturing and plastic injection molding preferred. (i.e. Machining, stamping, forging, or assembly) * Strong statistical data analysis ability (Minitab, etc.) * Excellent problem\-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. * Self\-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic. * Project management and mentoring experience a plus. * Ability to travel \<10%. **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * ASQ or similar Quality Certification * Working knowledge of Solidworks/Data Analytics/ML/AI. **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance. * On\-site grab\-n\-go food and coffee service. * And many more, check out our benefits site HERE . *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Manager 2, Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** **About the Role** We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a high\-performing engineering team driving our enterprise Identity \& Access Management (IAM) platform. In this role, you will balance technical leadership, team management, and operational execution—ensuring our central authentication, single sign\-on (SSO), and infrastructure automation deliver high performance, strict SLA adherence, and bulletproof security. While a background in IAM or security infrastructure is a major advantage, we value strong technical fundamentals, deep architectural acumen, exceptional organization, and a fast\-learning mindset above all. You will work closely with our Technical Product Owner and Staff Engineer, diving deep into our platform functionality, actively participating in acceptance testing, and ensuring high\-quality software delivery. **What You’ll Do** * People \& Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, accountability, and psychological safety. * Deep Product \& Quality Ownership: Dive deep into our identity services and Keycloak extensions to thoroughly understand feature workflows and business logic. Actively assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality validation before releases. * Architectural Oversight \& Challenge: Participate in design reviews and technical discussions—evaluating system trade\-offs, keeping up with senior engineers, and challenging architectural assumptions to ensure scalable, resilient design. * Testing \& CI/CD Standards: Drive a strong culture of automated testing (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end) and robust CI/CD practices to ensure reliable, zero\-downtime deployment pipelines. * Engineering Execution \& Delivery: Partner with the Technical Product Owner to drive delivery schedules, manage engineering velocity, unblock team members, and navigate technical dependencies. * SLA \& Performance Focus: Establish and track operational metrics to ensure our platform consistently meets or exceeds strict uptime and latency SLAs. * AI\-Accelerated Leadership: Encourage and guide the team in adopting AI\-driven software development tools (e.g., Claude Code, LLM\-based testing automation) to boost engineering efficiency and quality. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Security, Compliance, and Product leadership to ensure alignment on security standards and platform delivery goals. **What We’re Looking For** * Experience: 3\+ years of engineering management experience leading backend or platform software development teams, backed by 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience. * Strong Technical \& Architectural Foundation: Solid background in object\-oriented language design and backend systems (experience in Java or C\# is a strong plus). Must possess strong software architectural knowledge to guide design decisions and challenge technical approaches. * Testing \& CI/CD Literacy: Deep understanding of modern software testing methodologies, automated test frameworks, and modern CI/CD deployment workflows. * Product Depth \& Hands\-On QA Mindset: Willingness to roll up your sleeves, learn the intricacies of our products, and actively engage in acceptance testing to maintain a high bar for release quality. * Organizational Excellence: Exceptional track record of managing competing priorities, planning capacity, and keeping complex technical initiatives organized and on schedule. * Fast Learner: Proven ability to rapidly ramp up on complex technical subdomains (such as identity protocols, authorization models, or security infrastructure). * Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating engineering updates to leadership and advocating for your team's needs. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Strong Pluses** * Prior background as a Software Architect or Lead Engineer. * Experience with continuous process improvement informed by data, particularly using Kanban or Agile metrics. * Proven track record of driving engineering teams to meet and exceed operational SLAs. * Prior exposure to Identity \& Access Management (IAM), OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, or Keycloak environments. * Experience with cloud\-native deployment practices, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, ArgoCD). * Experience promoting AI developer tool adoption within an engineering organization. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, * Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, * Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, * Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, * Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles, * Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. **PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

In this role, you will own the evolution of our core identity services, driving deep customizations in Keycloak, automating zero\-downtime infrastructure deployments, and scaling our authentication and authorization footprint. As a Staff Engineer, you will bridge the gap between core Java backend engineering, modern IAM protocols, cloud\-native GitOps workflows, and modern AI\-driven software engineering practices to accelerate development and boost team productivity. In this role, you will lead the technical direction for identity systems that secure millions of users, handle high\-throughput authentication, and enforce fine\-grained access control across our entire ecosystem. As a technical leader on the team, you will balance deep hands\-on architectural design with cross\-functional mentorship, working closely with Security, Infrastructure, and Product teams. **What You’ll Do** * Core IAM Architecture: Drive the roadmap and architecture for our centralized authentication and authorization platforms, leveraging Keycloak as a core engine. * Custom Development: streamline audit logging and security monitoring integrations with SIEM systems. * GitOps \& Infrastructure as Code: Lead the automation of our identity infrastructure using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and ArgoCD to maintain secure, reproducible, and self\-healing environments. * Security \& Protocol Leadership: Implement and harden OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and fine\-grained access control across service\-to\-service and user\-facing architectures. * AI\-Assisted Engineering: Leverage AI developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM\-driven coding assistants) to accelerate development workflows, automate unit test generation, optimize Keycloak extension code, and establish AI best practices across the team. * Hands\-On Development: Work on critical initiatives leading them to completion. * Technical Ownership \& Mentorship: Lead RFCs, conduct architecture reviews, and mentor senior engineers across the engineering organization. **What We’re Looking For** * Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership at a Staff or Principal level in IAM, Security, or Core Infrastructure. * Keycloak \& Java Expertise: Deep hands\-on experience extending, scaling, and operating Keycloak in production, alongside mastery of Java and JVM internals. * AI\-Driven Software Development: Proven experience incorporating AI tools and LLM workflows into daily software engineering (e.g., automated code generation, AI\-assisted refactoring, test suite generation, and prompt engineering for development tasks). * IAM Standards: Deep expertise in OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM for identity lifecycle management. * Cloud\-Native IaC \& CI/CD: Strong experience building automated deployment pipelines and managing infrastructure via code. * Security Operations: Hands\-on experience integrating application logs, telemetry, and security events into SIEM solutions. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Strong Pluses** * Container \& GitOps Tooling: Hands\-on experience with ArgoCD, Helm, Ansible, and Terraform for automated Kubernetes and infrastructure management. * Experience integrating AI capabilities or anomaly detection models into identity workflows and threat detection. * Experience with zero\-downtime Keycloak cluster upgrades and multi\-region deployments. * Familiarity with service\-to\-service authentication (mTLS) and fine\-grained authorization frameworks. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. jobs.title: Aftersales & Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description: **About Mohab** Mohab is a Denver\-area overlanding and adventure gear startup building premium hardwall rooftop cabins and a modular adventure gear ecosystem. We're a fast\-growing, hands\-on team looking for someone who thrives on keeping the day\-to\-day running smoothly. **About the Role** Mohab is seeking an **Aftersales \& Customer Experience Manager** to build and lead the systems, processes and programs that support our owners and dealers after the sale. The role owns the post\-sale customer journey, including **warranty, service, replacement parts, dealer support, customer care and customer experience programs**. **\*\*Full\-time onsite position Monday\-Friday 8am – 5:00pm. Competitive compensation and generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, paid time off \+ paid holidays, and 401k (coming soon)\*\*** Our first focus is getting the fundamentals right: fair and fast warranty, parts available when they are needed, and dealers equipped to service what they sell. As the operation matures, the role will extend into proactive customer experience programs that create value for both owners and dealers. The objective is simple: **make owning a Mohab product as compelling as buying one.** **What You'll Do** *Warranty \& Service Operations* * Own Mohab's end\-to\-end warranty program across all products and markets: policy, claim intake, assessment, approval, repair coordination, reimbursement and closure. * Set and manage labor\-time standards and dealer labor reimbursement, and audit claims and dealers. * Establish service standards, escalation procedures, response\-time expectations and warranty approval guidelines. * Develop processes for dealer\-performed repairs, replacement products and customer\-direct warranty claims. * Make goodwill decisions within an agreed budget and manage returns and exchanges. * Coordinate service campaigns and safety recalls with Technical Product and Engineering. * Track claims, failure modes, repair costs and repeat issues; report warranty cost per unit and trends, support warranty reserve forecasting, and feed structured field\-quality findings to Product and Engineering. *Parts Operations* * Build and manage Mohab's service parts program: catalog, pricing, availability, stocking requirements and fulfillment. * Set launch stocking for every new product and identify critical service components that need local inventory. * Forecast demand, place / track orders, and manage backorders and obsolescence, working with Inventory Management. * Establish parts ordering processes for dealers, service partners and customers. * Help define future parts distribution requirements as the dealer network and installed base grow. *Dealer \& Service Network Support* * Serve as the primary aftersales contact for Mohab dealers and authorized service partners. * Write and maintain the dealer Service Policies \& Procedures manual, covering warranty, service, diagnostic and parts processes. * Make sure every dealer has the tools, parts, trained technicians and authorization to service Mohab products. * Support dealer technicians on product concerns, escalating complex diagnosis to Technical Product. * Set performance standards for the service network, introduce aftersales scorecards, and help dealers grow parts, accessory and service revenue. *Customer Experience* * Own the post\-purchase customer journey, from installation through onboarding, ownership, support and advocacy. * Build onboarding programs covering product education, setup guidance, owner resources and follow\-up communications. * Create proactive touchpoints at key stages of ownership, rather than relying only on reactive customer service. * Manage owner and dealer cases from first contact to resolution, including complaints and escalations, with speed, empathy and accountability. * Build owner loyalty, community engagement, referrals, repeat purchases and advocacy. * Ensure customers receive a consistent Mohab experience whether they buy directly or through a dealer. **What We're Looking For** Required * 5\+ years in aftersales, warranty or service operations for automotive, RV, powersports, commercial vehicles or vehicle accessories or in fixed\-operations leadership at a dealer group. * Hands\-on responsibility for at least two of: warranty administration, service parts operations, customer experience programs. * Solid understanding of customer service operations and customer journey design. * Ability to interpret technical product issues and coordinate solutions without being the engineer performing the diagnosis. * Experience using CRM, ticketing, warranty or service\-management platforms. * Clear written and verbal communication, including policies, procedures and dealer communications. * Highly organized, with strong follow\-through and attention to detail. Preferred * Experience building, rebuilding or scaling aftersales processes, for example at a brand launch, new market entry or startup. * Background in RV, truck campers, 4x4, overlanding or vehicle accessories. * Ability to speak Mandarin is an asset. * A degree in business, engineering or automotive management, or equivalent experience. * A personal interest in overlanding and the outdoors. **Why Mohab** Join a small, driven team building products for people who love the outdoors. You'll have real ownership over this position and the opportunity to be part of the company’s exciting growth. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $96,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * The following experience is a strong plus \-\- aftersales processes related to new market entry or start up; background in RV, truck campers, 4X4, overlanding or vehicle accessories. Please share in a few sentences why you are a good fit for this position. Thank you for your interest in Mohab. Experience: * aftersales, warranty, or service operations: 5 years (Preferred) * warranty administration, service parts, or customer : 3 years (Preferred) * CRM, ticketing, service management platforms: 2 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Centennial, CO 80111 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi\-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP). InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction. This role can be based out of our New York City office or remotely in the eastern or central timezone. ### **What You'll Do** * Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF\-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon) * Secure containerized infrastructure across multi\-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection. * Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP * Write production\-quality code and leverage Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code * Build real\-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale * Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long\-term production reliability ### **What We're Looking For** **Minimum Qualifications:** * 5\+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering * Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C\+\+, or Rust. * Proven track record of building and operating large\-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning. * Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Practical experience with eBPF\-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon) * Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms * Multi\-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP * Production exposure to low\-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups) ### **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. jobs.description: We are now looking for a Deep Learning Software Engineer, TensorRT Performance! gold standard for Gen AI performance. * Work with cross\-collaborative teams inside and outside of NVIDIA across generative AI, automotive, robotics, image understanding, and speech understanding to jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is seeking a Data Scientist to join a team dedicated to collecting and transforming data from the Naval Nuclear fleet for analytics throughout the Laboratory. The successful candidate will be responsible for building predictive models to characterize various systems, presenting in\-depth analysis in a clear and concise manner with a data\-oriented approach to problem solving and decision making. The Data Scientist will display great collaboration and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal through leading improvement projects and providing regular updates to the organization. **Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill** ----------------------------------------------- Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Good scripting and programming skills, experience in Python. * Experience with data visualization packages, such as Tableau. * Understanding of machine\-learning and its applications. * Understanding of RAG or embedding\-based search. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Health, Dental, Vision \& Voluntary Benefits * Disability, Life \& Accident Insurance * 401(k) Savings program \& Capital Accumulation Plan * Personal \& Medical Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Work Schedules * Tuition Assistance for Eligible Employees * Student Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness Program * Visit us online to view all NNL benefits! **Pay Range** ------------- $106,200\.00 \- $166,000\.00 annually Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Naval Nuclear Laboratory personnel are FMP employees who work at four DOE facilities: Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory, Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory, Kenneth A. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense\-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit\-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards, satellite, and vendor locations. For more than 75 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world\-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. We rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel. All candidates must be U.S. citizens. Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter. FMP is a government contractor and maintains a drug free workplace and workforce. All candidates must be able to pass a drug test in compliance with FMP company policy and 10 CFR 707\. Marijuana is a Federal Schedule I controlled substance and illegal under Federal Law. Therefore, FMP is required to test for marijuana. Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Nestmed is building the AI\-native operating system for post\-acute care. Millions of Americans get care at home every year. The agencies delivering it run on decades\-old software, disconnected tools, phone calls, and faxes, with nothing that ties the work together. We started with the hardest piece: understanding what actually happens in the visit. Now we're building everything on top of it, so an entire agency runs on one intelligent system. 7 of the 10 largest home health companies in the US already run on Nestmed, across hundreds of thousands of visits a day. We closed our Series A, backed by investors including Max Levchin, co\-founder of PayPal, and veterans of the home care industry. **What you'll do** * Build the operating system itself: the core data model and workflows that every part of an agency runs on, including patients, visits, orders, coding, QA, and billing. * Build AI agents that do real clinical and operational work end to end, with clinicians kept in control. * Build AI\-powered product that clinicians rely on in the middle of patient care, where accuracy and speed both matter. For example, turning visit audio into structured clinical data that drives everything downstream. * Own features from start to finish. You'll talk to clinicians and agency leaders, decide what to build, ship it, and watch it run across hundreds of thousands of visits a day. * Connect to the medical record systems our customers depend on, and build the enterprise basics large health systems require: single sign\-on, account provisioning, and audit trails. * Work wherever the problem is: the Django and Postgres backend, the web app, or the native iOS and Android apps. **What we're looking for** * 3\+ years building and shipping product, with solid full\-stack fundamentals. * You use AI heavily in how you write software. * You've worked at a startup and can decide what to do without a spec. * Product sense: you listen closely to users, go deep on their problems, and translate what they need into the right technical decisions. * You've built something people depended on, where getting it wrong had real consequences. **Bonus** * Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HL7/FHIR). * LLM products in production: evaluations, multi\-step model workflows, agents. * Our stack: Python/Django, Postgres, TypeScript/React, Swift or Kotlin, AWS. * Audio, real\-time systems, or mobile apps that work offline. If you want to build the system an entire healthcare industry runs on, we'd love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $150K \- $280K

jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer, Security
jobs.description: Sr AI Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3148 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Realtor.com is growing how it uses AI, from internal tools and coding assistants to fleets of autonomous agents. We need a security engineer whose core skill is cybersecurity and whose focus is AI. Recent incidents, like an AI model under test breaking into another company's infrastructure, show the new kinds of risk: agents acting outside their intended scope, models and tools pulled from public hubs, and normal automation becoming an attack path. You'll make sure our systems are built to contain all of that, and that the secure option is also the easy one. You'll work closely with News Corp's global cybersecurity team, bringing AI security depth to Realtor.com while aligning with group\-wide standards. We are looking for a rigorous practitioner who advocates for software engineering excellence across the full Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). You will leverage AI through spec\-driven design, automation\-driven provisioning, and robust platform maintenance, eliminating ad hoc ownership and freeing solution builders to focus on workflow design and delivery. What You'll Do: Secure the AI platform (AWS and GCP) * Design and enforce guardrails for AI workloads on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, IAM, KMS, SCPs, GuardDuty, Security Hub) and GCP (Vertex AI, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Org Policies, Security Command Center, Cloud KMS). * Define how agents and other non\-human accounts are identified and authorized: short\-lived, narrowly scoped credentials, delegated user permissions, and a per\-agent audit trail, so a misbehaving agent can only do limited damage. * Build containment for agents: separate read and write permissions, network egress controls, sandboxed execution, approval gates for high\-risk actions, and kill switches. * Design an agent gateway or control plane that keeps agents and their tool calls within approved limits. * Secure the AI supply chain: where models come from and how they're scanned (including unsafe formats like pickle), vetting of models and datasets from public hubs such as Hugging Face, an approval process for new MCP servers and agent tools, and an inventory of the models, data, and tools each system uses (an AI\-BOM). * Defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, poisoned retrieval data (RAG poisoning), and sensitive data leakage. * Put detection and logging in place for agent and model activity, and own the incident response playbooks for AI\-specific events. Review and guide what gets built * Lead threat modeling for new products, features, and internal solutions, from consumer\-facing experiences to internal tools and agent workflows. Use frameworks like STRIDE, the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP ASVS. Turn the findings into clear design requirements and release criteria. * Review pull requests, architecture designs, and release\-readiness for everything from apps to agent fleets, and make concrete suggestions that move work forward instead of blocking it. Build paved\-road frameworks, reference architectures, and secure\-by\-default templates that rule out whole categories of risk, instead of catching them one PR at a time. * Build security into CI/CD: secrets scanning, SAST/SCA, GitHub Actions hardening, and policy\-as\-code in Terraform. * Build an ongoing red\-team and evaluation program for our models, agents, and LLM apps, and test new AI features before launch. Partner with News Corp cybersecurity * Work with News Corp's global cybersecurity team to align Realtor.com's AI and cloud security with group\-wide standards, policies, and risk frameworks. * Coordinate on incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability disclosure across News Corp businesses. * Share AI security patterns, threat models, and lessons learned with other News Corp businesses, and bring their insights back to Realtor.com. Use AI to do security work * Build agents that help do the security work: triage findings, investigate alerts, audit IAM for least privilege, and open tested, secure\-by\-default fix PRs. * Use Claude Code, Devin, and MCP to make the security team faster, and share those patterns with other engineering t ty, AppSec/product security, or security platform engineering. * Hands\-on depth in AWS security, plus real experience in GCP (or a strong multi\-cloud background). * You know that telling an AI not to do something isn't security. You think in permissions, scopes, logs, approval gates, data boundaries, and rollback. * Experience securing LLM or agentic systems, including prompt injection defenses, retrieval and data\-boundary risks, agent identity, and model or tool supply\-chain integrity. * Experience doing threat modeling for products and platforms, not just infrastructure. You can lead a session with engineers and product managers and turn it into requirements they'll actually follow. * Hands\-on experience building with agents, tool calling, or MCP, and with AI coding tools. Strong code\-review skills in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, and comfort with Terraform/IaC. * Experience with zero trust, least privilege, SSO/OIDC/OAuth, secrets management, and vulnerability management. * Experience working within a larger security organization, such as a parent company, central security team, or federated model. You can balance local speed with alignment to enterprise standards. * Follow AI security research, incident write\-ups, and the security community, and you can point to something recent you learned and acted on. * A builder's mindset. You'd rather prototype a new control than wait for a vendor to ship one, and you're comfortable working where the playbook doesn't exist yet. * Explain risk clearly to any audience, from a PR comment to an executive briefing to a training session for the whole company. Nice to have: * AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CCSP, CISSP, OSCP, or GIAC (GCSA/GWEB). * Experience red\-teaming or evaluating AI models or agents. * Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, Google SAIF, CoSAI, NIST SSDF, or the EU AI Act. * Experience securing Snowflake (RBAC, masking, network policy). * Conference talks, published research, or open\-source security contributions. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. Apply Now

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Software Engineer is a hands\-on, full\-stack engineer who owns the delivery of product features from acceptance criteria to production. Working primarily on Traverse and Grove, this role takes a feature or epic, designs it, builds it, tests it, ships it, and stays accountable for how it behaves in production, without needing task\-level direction. This role is the team's dependable owner of scoped, multi\-card work and a day\-to\-day technical resource for less experienced engineers. The Senior Software Engineer makes and documents local architectural tradeoffs within established patterns, uses AI\-assisted development as a fluent daily practice, and helps engineers on the team grow through pairing and code review. Team\-wide technical direction and code quality standards are owned by the Principal Engineer role, and the Senior Software Engineer co\-builds the agentic engineering framework alongside the Principal Engineer. **Experience** **Required:** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience in a SaaS or web product environment, including production ownership of features you designed and delivered. * Professional experience with Ruby on Rails and a modern JavaScript/TypeScript front end (React preferred), and with relational database design and query performance in PostgreSQL. * Working knowledge of AWS at the application layer (for example S3, queues, and managed database or serverless services), sufficient to deploy, debug, and operate your own features. * Experience reviewing others' code and mentoring less experienced engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have:** * Experience in Health and Human Services, government technology, or another regulated vertical SaaS domain. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture or Domain\-Driven Design. * Experience contributing to agentic SDLC practices such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation, or prompt and runbook standards. * Experience with serverless architectures or mobile application development. * Familiarity with SOC 2 or HIPAA\-aligned engineering practices. **What you’ll be doing** Feature Ownership, Design, and Quality * Own features and epics end to end, from refinement and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and production follow\-up, with minimal direction and a clear record of delivering on commitments. * Design the feature before building it: data model and PostgreSQL schema changes, Rails models and services, API contracts, and React/TypeScript component structure. Make local architectural tradeoffs and document the reasoning in the merge request or design notes. * Participate actively in Amigos and refinement: challenge unclear acceptance criteria, surface risks and dependencies early, and split oversized work into small, end\-to\-end slices. * Write and own automated tests across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels for the work you ship, and treat passing tests and a clean pipeline as part of the definition of done. * Follow the team's established architecture patterns, code quality standards, and security\-by\-default practices, and raise proposed changes to them for team decision rather than diverging on your own. * Handle sensitive case, family, and agency data with care, applying least\-privilege access, input validation, and data protection practices expected of software used by HHS agencies. Production Operations and AI\-Assisted Delivery * Deploy your own changes through the GitLab pipeline, verify them in production, and follow through on regressions using logs, error tracking, and metrics. * Participate in the on\-call rotation: triage and resolve production issues, communicate status clearly, escalate early when needed, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems and their follow\-up actions. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code as the primary tool, with GitHub Copilot or Codex as secondary) as a daily working practice: frame prompts with context and constraints, decompose work into verifiable steps, review and correct AI output, and never ship code you cannot explain. * Co\-build the team's agentic engineering framework with the Principal Engineer: contribute improvements to runbooks, prompts, and workflows, and bring what you learn in daily AI\-assisted work back into how the team builds software. Mentoring and Team Collaboration * Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, thorough code review, and direct, actionable feedback, and serve as an escalation point for engineers working through technical problems. * Keep growing too: pair with the Principal Engineer on hard problems, welcome direct feedback on your own code and designs, and take on work that stretches you. * Review merge requests for correctness, test coverage, security, and maintainability, explaining the reasoning behind your feedback. * Collaborate with Product Managers, QA, DevOps, and Solution Ar lps you earn lower premiums * Robust EAP program that includes free therapy sessions, lifestyle coaching, legal/ID theft services, and more * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave * Up to $5,000 adoption fee reimbursement * $500 wellness reimbursement after 60 days of employment * Generous PTO policy and 10 company paid holidays * Company paid cell phone plan Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Northwoods, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Northwoods is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are excited to work with talented people, period. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or ethnic origin, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital or civil status, political affiliation, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate. **Who is Northwoods?** Northwoods makes software solutions that improve the quality of the life of case managers and social workers in the Health and Human Services (HHS) field. Recognized as one of Columbus’ top places to work, working at Northwoods means being part of a team that’s passionate about making an impact on the lives of HHS professionals and the families they serve. We believe in creating a culture of inclusivity and accountability seeking to hire professional, passionate and driven individuals that believe in the values that we believe in: * Curiosity – Willing to test assumptions, courage to ask questions, and active listening. * Community – Helping and mentoring each other, celebrating diversity and acknowledging our team members’ contributions. * Resourcefulness – Willing to try and fail. Asking for help and trusting the expertise of our team. * Stewardship – Safeguarding Northwoods’ values, culture, mission, and resources. We believe that our team members are all accountable adults, not only to themselves but to each other, and we treat them that way. Our team works incredibly hard and is proven through dedication to their craft and our mission. **Our Solutions** Our products are designed for state and county social care program areas, including child welfare, childcare, child support, economic assistance and adult \& aging agencies. These solutions leverage technology to allow case workers and social workers to easily collect, store, manage, and share case content and data more efficiently. By simplifying processes, our customers can spend more time engaging with the families they serve, make better informed decisions and achieve better outcomes. **Traverse** – A SaaS solution that allows for easy, on\-the\-go access to case files, case work and interview forms and intelligent insights on case content and materials, which lead to better engagement and better outcomes. **Compass** – Compass solution is some of our longer standing software that supports multiple markets for both state and county customers. Our focus on reducing time wasted on paperwork and administrative burdens allows case workers to better serve families in need. **Grove \-** Our trusted team of experienced child welfare professionals becomes an extension of agency staff supporting them with administrative tasks such as referral and records requests, compiling documents for court, and document organization. Workers can focus on fostering healthier families without sacrificing their own well\-being.
