jobs.title: AI Engineer – Founding Member, NJ Office
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Andreas. Come build the new Nu Image® with us. I'm the CEO of Nu Image®, and we're opening a new office in New Jersey. I'm looking for an AI engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open. Here's the setup. We're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our CTO, with AI agents as the force multiplier. You'll own the AI engineering and the hands\-on code development. AI agents do most of the typing here. But make no mistake: you'll own the code, not just prompt it. You'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. When something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. You are the builder, and the result is yours. And here's the line I care about most: I don't want someone who waits to be told what to do. See a problem? Fix it. See a better way? Build it and show us. Initiative is the job. If you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading. Who we are \- Nu Image® is a US telehealth company. Founded in 2004, online since 2008\. \- LegitScript certified, serving all 50 states. \- We're opening a new office in the Mahwah / Wyckoff area of New Jersey. This role is based there, in person. \- Home page: https://nuimage.com What you'll build (with our CTO) \- A modern web platform and internal tools that people actually enjoy using. \- Integrations and automation that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates. \- AI\-powered workflows, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one. \- Secure, reliable, well\-tested systems with healthcare\-grade privacy and security baked in from day one. What a week roughly looks like No two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of: \- Agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself. \- Working through architecture and priorities with our CTO, then turning them into shipped code. \- Whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes. \- Digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness. \- Spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it. \- Showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next. Perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits) \- Founding member of the NJ office. You'll help shape how it works. \- First dibs on the whiteboard. \- You pick the office coffee machine. Choose wisely. \- You get to name the agents. \- The CEO is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no. \- Your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months. Must\-haves AI (front and center) \- You ship with AI coding agents daily: Cursor, the Grok ecosystem (including Grok Bot), and similar tools. You have a setup, opinions, and receipts. \- You're current with today's AI tools and how they're changing month to month. \- You've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships. \- You verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right." \- You keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it. Fundamentals (you own the result) \- You can build and debug it yourself, without AI, when needed. Reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you. \- Solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later. \- Strong PHP and Laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and Eloquent without the N\+1 drama. \- Real SQL skills (MySQL): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself. \- Debugging: logs, stack traces, Xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms. \- Security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, OWASP top risks, secrets handling. The rest of the stack \- Vue and Tailwind on the front end. \- REST APIs: designing them and integrating with third\-party ones. \- Redis for queues, caching, and locks. \- Cloud experience (AWS a plus). \- Testing with Pest or PHPUnit. \- CI/CD with GitHub Actions or similar. \- Admin panel tools like Laravel Nova or Filament. How you work \- Initiative. You find the work instead of waiting for it. \- Ownership. If you shipped it (or your agents did), it's yours to understand, fix, and improve. \- You work well in a small core: direct with our CTO, clear about your reasoning, and happy to explain it to an agent or to a person. \- You can show real, shipped work. We care about what you can do, not a years\-of\-experience number. \- You can commute to the Mahwah / Wyckoff area and want to be in the office. Nice\-to\-haves \- Infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, Pulumi, or similar). \- Observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts. \- You've built your own MCP servers, agent tools, or custom agent integrations. \- Evals for prompts and agents. \- Laravel Horizon, Octane, Pulse, or Reverb. \- Threat modeling and secrets management beyond the basics. \- Open\-source work, side projects, or talks at meetups. How to apply Email jobs@nuimagemedical.com with the subject line "AI Engineer – NJ" and include: 1\. Your GitHub, portfolio, or anything you've shipped that we can look at. 2\. A short note (a few paragraphs is perfect) on the coolest thing you've built with AI agents. What it did, how you set up the agents, what went wrong, and how you fixed it. This is the part I'll read first. 3\. Where you're based. No cover\-letter templates, please. Write it the way you'd explain it to a friend. Nu Image Medical, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Description** The Construction Project Manager is responsible for the profitable execution of energy retrofit, new construction and building projects. Details include planning, scheduling, monitoring, evaluating, and directing projects to ensure a complete business solution is implemented. Work includes managing various construction projects contract structures such as Design build, Turnkey, EaaS, DBOOM projects. Develop and manage project plans based on the Optimum Energy Project Management methodology for executing and implementing projects. Responsible for ensuring projects meet established time, cost, and technical objectives including company revenue, executed gross margin and cash targets. Manage the project’s change control and effectively utilize all available methodologies and tools culminating in customer acceptance of results. Conduct project progress reviews with customers and project team personnel, providing contingency and problem\-resolution plans as required. **Primary Responsibilities** * **Construction \& Project Management:** Oversee the execution of construction projects + Identify resource requirements, coordinate the work of Optimum Energy resources and assigned customer tasks + Perform project status reviews and communicate project status + Manage project submittals and documentation + Facilitate the procurement of IT connection between OE and the customer site + Manage all project mechanical completion, construction startup and commissioning (on time, within budget, within expectations) + Conducts final project team review/lessons learned * **Financial Accountability:** Manage project costs, change orders, and billing to ensure “executed gross margin” goals and cash goals are met + Manage and monitor cost/schedule/resource variances through Optimum’s project lifecycle + Proactively manage foreseen project risk, identify any potential risk scenarios, and facilitate issue resolution + Provide regular cost forecast updates to the Finance team including project cashflows, Initial schedule of values (contractual) * **Safety Leadership:** Implement site safety and security procedures; heavy emphasis on OE safety program implementation for all employees and subcontractors. + Manage safety for the project reporting in accordance with OSHA guidelines * **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Act as the primary point of contract for customers, ensuring high satisfaction, and foster relationships with subcontractors and internal partners + Conduct project planning and project kick\-off meetings Internally and with the Owner + Assist in establishing and maintaining positive customer relationships and work closely with Optimum Engineers to ensure customer expectations are met/exceeded * **Project Scheduling:** Perform cost estimating and detailed scheduling using OE tools to meet defined milestones + Work extensively with scheduling programs such as Primavera Project Planner and MS projects, report generation from Procore and NetSuite, and other administrative functions + Develop a strong understanding and knowledge of OE’s products and services + Participate in continuous improvement of the PMO and identifying and implementing best practices **Key Competencies and Skills Expectations** * Anticipate, plan, and coordinate all Project activities; Maintain overall project schedule using Primavera Project Planner or Microsoft Project * Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills * Efficient team management skills and strong leadership skills * Detail\-oriented with effective problem\-solving skills * Focus on results and success, conveying a sense of urgency and driving issues to closure * Understanding of network diagrams and network devices * Knowledge of IT terminology, such as VPNs, IPs, firewalls, ports; Building Automation System brands and communication protocols * Proficient in ProCore and Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) **Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering; technical college certification with 10 years of project management experience acceptable * **Experience:** 5\+ years of direct project management experience in the non\-residential building construction industry, experience at manufacturing or higher education facilities is required * **Technical Knowledge:** Experience with HVAC, chilled water systems and controls expertise preferred. Tridium/Niagra and IT/connectivity experience a plus * **Certifications:** PMP (Project Management Professional) certification a plus * **Travel:** Ability to travel up to 75% of the time, depending on location and geography Optimum Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. **About the Company** Optimum Energy, a Bernhard Capital Partners port y\-as\-a\-Service model converts aging central utility plants into upfront unrestricted cash, cuts utility operating expenses 25 to 35%, and keeps the transaction entirely off the balance sheet. The structure has been confirmed by Big Four auditors and cited by rating agencies as a driver of improved credit outlooks. We work with clients from master planning and design through implementation, commissioning, and into long\-term operations and maintenance. How we show up depends on what the client needs. That could mean fully managed plants with Optimum carrying total accountability for performance and uptime. It could mean supplementing an existing facilities team with engineering support, analytics, training, and escalation resources. Or it could mean a tailored combination of both. In every engagement, we stay for the life of the agreement. Proprietary technology, including OptiCx and OptimumLOOP, powers everything we do. It is not what we sell. It is what enables us to deliver the most continuous, precise system\-level optimization across chilled water, hot water, and steam plants available in the market today. Machine learning algorithms trained on two decades of operational data adapt to load, weather, and occupancy in real time. AI\-driven predictive maintenance and fault detection catch equipment degradation before it becomes a problem. We guarantee the performance. We carry the risk. Behind the technology is a team built on a simple set of principles: be sharp, be relentless, and be accountable for outcomes. Our people are engineers, operators, and financial structurers who would rather solve the hard problem than talk around it. Every engagement gets that same intensity, whether the scope is a single plant or a 26\-site enterprise portfolio. For more information, visit www.optimumenergyco.com. **About the Industry** Commercial and institutional HVAC infrastructure is aging faster than organizations can replace it. Hospitals are running central plants built in the 1960s and 70s. Universities carry over $112 billion in collective deferred maintenance nationally. Advanced manufacturing operations face intensifying energy demand from reshoring and facility expansion. Rising energy costs, tightening regulations, sustainability mandates, and a skilled trades labor gap that shows no sign of closing all compound the pressure. Connected systems are generating more data than most organizations can act on. The capacity to analyze it and translate it into operational decisions requires platforms and people most facilities teams do not have. The industry is not short on ambition or technology. It is short on the capital structures, operational models, and workforce capacity to turn intent into sustained results. **Why Optimum Energy?** With 300\+ sites and over 300M square feet of operational data, our machine learning algorithms continuously optimize in real time. No competitor replicates this at scale. We do not sell software, and we do not sell equipment. We deliver guaranteed outcomes through the convergence of deep engineering expertise, proprietary optimization technology, and financial structures that align our interests directly with those of our clients. That means tailoring solutions to unique financial and operational realities, not forcing a one\-size\-fits\-all model. It means verifiable success across facility design, ongoing operations, and complex deal structuring. And it means protecting client investments by optimizing the 70% of total costs that occur after day one. Our EaaS contracts transfer construction, performance, and lifecycle risk entirely. No upfront capital. No balance sheet impact. Capital that would have gone to back\-of\-house infrastructure stays available for the priorities that matter most, whether that is clinical growth, enrollment expansion, or production capacity. No other firm brings this combination of engineering, technology, operations, and financial structuring under a single partnership.

jobs.title: Ontology Architect
jobs.description: **Full\-Time \| Contract\-to\-Hire \| Remote (U.S.)** OtterSoft is building an AI\-ready workforce management platform powered by a sophisticated semantic data architecture. We are hiring our first **Ontology Architect** to design and own the semantic model at the core of our platform: how people, credentials, organizations, facilities, units, shifts, assignments, and contracts relate, and the business rules that govern how they interact. Your ontology will provide the foundation for intelligent matching, compliance automation, demand forecasting, and AI\-agent workflows used by our customers and internal teams. This is a foundational architecture role for someone who can transform complex business processes and disconnected data sources into a scalable, governed semantic model. You will define how data is structured, connected, interpreted, and used by applications and AI agents to support reliable decisions and automated workflows. You will work closely with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to establish the architecture, technical standards, and governance practices that support the platform as it grows. **What You'll Do** * Design and own the enterprise ontology, including object types, properties, relationships, derived logic, and actions across the full operational lifecycle. * Translate complex business processes and operational rules into structured, executable ontology logic. * Model entities, relationships, constraints, and business rules that support intelligent matching, eligibility decisions, compliance automation, forecasting, and workflow orchestration. * Map data from disparate operational systems, including applicant tracking systems (ATS), vendor management systems (VMS/MSP), credentialing platforms, scheduling systems, timekeeping, payroll, and other business applications. * Establish master identities and consistent relationships across people, organizations, facilities, business units, assignments, and contracts. * Evaluate and define the ontology and knowledge graph architecture, considering solutions such as Palantir Foundry Ontology, RDF/OWL knowledge graphs, and property graph platforms such as Neo4j or Amazon Neptune. * Document architectural decisions, technology trade\-offs, integration patterns, and implementation standards. * Define the actions, permissions, and guardrails that applications and AI agents can use to ensure business rules are enforced and sensitive information remains protected. * Establish ontology governance standards, including naming conventions, versioning, change review, data\-quality checks, and technical documentation. * Partner with engineering teams to integrate ontology models with APIs, data pipelines, applications, and downstream services. * Lead and guide the Knowledge Graph Engineer while collaborating with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. * Identify opportunities to improve data consistency, automate complex processes, and enable more reliable AI\-driven decision\-making. * Ensure the ontology remains scalable, maintainable, secure, and adaptable as platform capabilities and business requirements evolve. **What an AI\-Ready Ontology Means Here** The ontology is more than a data dictionary or a collection of database relationships. It is the semantic foundation that connects enterprise data, business logic, and application behavior. You will design a model that enables the platform to understand: * **Entities and relationships:** How people, organizations, facilities, resources, assignments, and other business objects relate to one another. * **Business rules and constraints:** How eligibility, permissions, requirements, exceptions, and operational policies affect decisions. * **Connected data:** How information from multiple source systems maps to consistent, trusted identities and relationships. * **Operational workflows:** How business objects and rules support end\-to\-end processes, from initial requests through execution and completion. * **AI\-powered applications:** How applications and AI agents retrieve trusted information, apply business rules, and execute permitted actions. * **Governance and security:** How semantic models remain consistent, auditable, version\-controlled, and appropriately protected as the platform evolves. Your work will help ensure that AI\-driven decisions are grounded in reliable data, explicit business logic, and well\-defined permissions. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain the enterprise ontology and semantic architecture. * Define entities, attributes, relationships, constraints, derived properties, and actions that represent the business domain. * Implement and maintain ontology logic that supports automated decisions, eligibility validation, compliance monitoring, matching, and workflow execution. * Integrate operational data through APIs, data pipelines, and other integration patterns. * Establish consistent master identities and resolve data inconsistencies acros offs, and implementation approaches. * Ability to balance scalability, maintainability, security, and business requirements. * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex models to engineers, business stakeholders, and executives. * Technical leadership, collaboration, and mentoring abilities. * Ownership mentality with a focus on building reliable, production\-ready foundations for AI\-powered applications. * Ability to navigate ambiguity and establish architecture and standards for a new platform capability. **Culture Fit** You will thrive here if you: * Enjoy building foundational architecture for a new platform. * Are comfortable taking ownership of a complex business domain and defining its underlying semantic model. * Can work through ambiguous requirements and turn them into structured, implementable solutions. * Value data quality, consistency, governance, and clear documentation. * Understand that ontology design must support real operational workflows, not just theoretical data relationships. * Enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, and business teams. * Think critically about how data relationships, business rules, and permissions affect downstream applications. * Are interested in enabling reliable AI\-driven workflows through trusted data and explicit business logic. * Can balance long\-term architectural strategy with practical implementation milestones. * Take ownership of technical decisions and continuously improve the platform's semantic architecture. jobs.title: Principal Software Architect - SaaS Platform Consolidation & Integration
jobs.description: **Full\-Time \| Contract\-to\-Hire \| Remote (U.S.)** OtterSoft is seeking an accomplished **Principal Software Architect** to lead the architectural strategy and technical execution of consolidating multiple existing software platforms into a unified, next\-generation SaaS product. Our objective is to bring Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and Vendor Management System (VMS) capabilities together into a cohesive, extensible platform that supports the complete workforce lifecycle—from recruiting and candidate management through workforce fulfillment, scheduling, timekeeping, invoicing, and billing. The unified platform will also provide robust integration capabilities with external enterprise systems, including Workday, workforce scheduling platforms, HRIS, payroll, ERP, and other third\-party applications. This role is specifically for an architect who has successfully consolidated multiple existing software products or platforms into a unified production system. We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to designing new applications, connecting systems through APIs, or producing high\-level architecture diagrams. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience resolving overlapping functionality, reconciling disparate data models, defining shared platform capabilities, establishing clear system boundaries, and executing phased migrations while preserving existing business operations. This is a senior individual\-contributor and technical leadership position with ownership of the target\-state architecture, architectural decisions, and technical direction of the consolidation initiative. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. SaaS Platform Consolidation \& Modernization * Lead the architectural consolidation of multiple existing applications into a unified, scalable, enterprise\-grade SaaS platform. * Assess existing platforms to identify duplicated functionality, inconsistent data models, architectural dependencies, technical debt, and opportunities for simplification. * Define the target\-state architecture, including shared platform services, domain boundaries, module responsibilities, service interfaces, and data ownership. * Determine which capabilities should be shared across the platform, which should remain domain\-specific, and which warrant independent deployment. * Develop a phased consolidation roadmap that supports incremental delivery, minimizes operational disruption, and preserves existing customer capabilities. * Establish architectural standards that support extensibility, maintainability, performance, security, reliability, and long\-term product evolution. * Lead architecture decisions that balance strategic modernization with practical delivery timelines and business priorities. 2\. Unified ATS, VMS \& Workforce Architecture * Define a cohesive domain architecture spanning recruiting, applicant tracking, candidate management, job requisitions, submissions, placements, vendor management, workforce orders, onboarding, credentialing, scheduling, timekeeping, invoicing, and billing. * Establish consistent domain models and lifecycle relationships across formerly independent applications. * Define authoritative data ownership for shared entities, including candidates, workers, clients, suppliers, jobs, assignments, and workforce schedules. * Design end\-to\-end workflows that span multiple platform modules without creating unnecessary dependencies or duplicating business logic. * Establish reusable capabilities for workflow configuration, business rules, identity, authorization, notifications, audit logging, reporting, and administration. * Preserve the ability to support customer\-specific processes and configurations without creating separate codebases or product forks. 3\. Enterprise SaaS Architecture * Design a modular, multi\-tenant SaaS architecture capable of supporting multiple customers, organizations, suppliers, staffing programs, and operating models. * Define tenant isolation, security boundaries, access controls, configuration management, and customer\-level customization strategies. * Establish architectural patterns for service communication, API contracts, event\-driven processing, background jobs, and distributed workflows. * Evaluate modular monolith, service\-oriented, microservices, and hybrid architectures based on actual business and technical requirements rather than technology trends. * Define standards for observability, resilience, availability, performance, scalability, and operational support. * Ensure the architecture can accommodate future modules, external partners, new business capabilities, and AI\-enabled features. 4\. Enterprise Integration Architecture * Establish an API\-first integration strategy for connecting the platform to Workday and other HRIS, ERP, payroll, scheduling, timekeeping, identity, and workforce management systems. * Define standardized integration contracts, canonical data models, API versioning, authentication, authori cumentation, interface specifications, system context diagrams, data models, and architecture decision records. * Mentor senior engineers and technical leads while establishing consistent engineering standards and design practices. * Collaborate with product management, security, infrastructure, DevOps, and implementation teams to address architectural dependencies and delivery risks. * Evaluate new technologies and engineering approaches based on measurable business value, maintainability, implementation effort, and total cost of ownership. **Required Qualifications** * 12\+ years of software engineering and architecture experience, including substantial responsibility for enterprise application and SaaS platform design. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience architecting and delivering the consolidation of two or more existing software products or platforms into a unified production system. * Significant experience designing and evolving enterprise SaaS products, preferably multi\-tenant platforms. * Deep understanding of domain\-driven design, modular architecture, distributed systems, data modeling, API design, and enterprise integration patterns. * Proven experience defining shared domain models and resolving overlapping functionality, conflicting data structures, and system\-of\-record ownership. * Experience leading application modernization, phased migrations, backward compatibility, and legacy\-system coexistence. * Strong knowledge of secure enterprise integrations, API lifecycle management, asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, and integration resiliency. * Experience designing platform security, identity and access management, tenant isolation, auditability, and operational resiliency. * Ability to translate business objectives into a target\-state architecture and a practical, prioritized implementation roadmap. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence architectural decisions across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ATS, VMS, staffing technology, contingent workforce management, healthcare staffing, or workforce management platforms. * Experience integrating with Workday and other enterprise HRIS, ERP, payroll, scheduling, or timekeeping systems. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, .NET/C\#, SQL Server, API gateways, message brokers, event streaming, and cloud\-native infrastructure. * Experience establishing canonical data models, master data management practices, and enterprise data synchronization strategies. * Experience modernizing mature commercial software products while maintaining active customer implementations. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled software development and incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise SaaS platforms. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate combines the strategic perspective of an enterprise architect with the practical judgment of an experienced software engineering leader. They have personally navigated the complexity of bringing independently developed products together: reconciling data models, defining shared business capabilities, managing system dependencies, establishing integration contracts, and guiding engineering teams through production implementation. They know when to consolidate, when to preserve modular boundaries, and when independent services are justified. They favor pragmatic architecture that supports rapid delivery without creating unnecessary complexity or long\-term technical debt. The mission is straightforward: transform multiple existing software platforms into one cohesive, extensible SaaS product with a unified architecture, consistent data, reusable integrations, and a sustainable path for future growth. Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $230,000\.00 per year Experience: * Proven SaaS Platform Consolidation: 10 years (Required) * Enterprise Software Architecture: 10 years (Required) * API Design and Enterprise Integration: 10 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** This role owns the software Credit Production Engineering runs on. It delivers complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC for CPE's internal platforms — the knowledge base, the services behind it, and the automation the team depends on during live triage — and is accountable for those codebases as products: design, code review, tests, deployment and ongoing upkeep. It operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, guides engineers writing automation alongside their operational work, and applies technical best practices to build\-versus\-configure decisions within its own area. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. * Advises immediate management on project\-level issues * Guides junior engineers * Operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices * Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** **Responsibilities:** * Deliver complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC for CPE's internal platforms, based on priorities set with the CPE manager. * Own CPE's tooling codebases as products — apply and uphold code review, testing and release practices for them, and be the named owner accountable for their state. * Carry the knowledge base platform from pre\-production to production: monitoring, backup and restore, documented ownership, and the operational layer a service needs once a team depends on it daily. * Design, build and operate new services that reduce the team's toil on repetitive and manual work, including correlating operational signals that today are handled individually. * Own the PostgreSQL schema and data layer behind CPE's retrieval platform — schema design, migrations, roles and grants, indexing and query performance. * Advise CPE management on project\-level technical issues, including build\-versus\-configure and sequencing decisions. * Review code from, and provide technical guidance to, engineers who write automation alongside their operational work. * Partner with engineering teams outside CPE to obtain the service topology and dependency For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. jobs.description: **At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to THINK OUTSIDE.** **Position Overview** --------------------- As a Project Leader supporting recreational vehicle development, you will provide technical leadership across engineering programs and projects, guiding design decisions that influence the performance, quality, and market success of off\-road vehicle products. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop innovative solutions, integrate customer insights, and deliver products that meet cost, schedule, and performance objectives. This role offers the opportunity to influence high\-visibility product outcomes while helping shape future vehicle capabilities across the Polaris Off Road Vehicle portfolio. Success in this position requires strong engineering judgment, project leadership skills, and the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders while balancing customer expectations, technical requirements, quality, timing, and cost. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Manage cost, schedule, and performance deliverables through integrated product team meetings, leading cross\-functional teams ranging from approximately 5 to 20 members. * Influence the design and development of off\-road vehicle components and systems to support product competitiveness, profitability, and market share objectives. * Develop innovative concepts and solutions that improve customer satisfaction and identify new market opportunities. * Benchmark competitive products, technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes to inform engineering decisions. * Apply the Polaris product development process to ensure consistent execution and successful program delivery. * Plan, coordinate, and oversee technical assignments while evaluating project progress and results. * Develop cost estimates for components, tooling, and development activities while monitoring project financial performance. * Coordinate engineering development, testing, drafting, layout, prototyping, and fabrication activities to achieve project objectives and schedules. * Lead and participate in jobs.title: Director, Operations Engineering
jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15\-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership. **About the role** The Director of Operations Engineering is responsible for the technical strategy, continuous improvement, and engineering support of Prime's operating data centers. This team is separate from Design and Construction; its focus is the facilities already in service and the people who run them. Reporting to the SVP of Critical Operations, the Director is the engineering partner to Critical Facility Managers (CFMs) and Chief Engineers (CEs) across the portfolio. The Director provides senior technical support and troubleshooting, owns the root cause analysis program, and drives measurable improvement in equipment reliability. The Director also brings rigor and visibility to the engineering requirements that govern how Prime's sites are operated, maintained, and changed, including studies, single\-lines, settings, procedures, and change control. This is a platform role. It requires strong planning abilities, leadership through influence, and a proactive partnership approach, underpinned by a robust engineering background. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineering leader with real time on the operations side of mission\-critical facilities, with experience in electrical and mechanical systems and an understanding of large\-scale data centers or comparable environments. They should be equally comfortable working through a UPS failure on a bridge call at 2 a.m. and building the program that keeps it from happening again. They earn credibility with site teams by showing up and solving problems, and they turn what they learn into standards, data, and feedback for the teams designing and building Prime's next facilities. This role supports a 24x7x365 operating environment and includes participation in an escalation on\-call rotation for critical events. **What you'll do** Site Engineering Support \& Troubleshooting * Build and lead a team of operations/reliability engineers (electrical, mechanical, and controls) dedicated to supporting operating sites. * Serve as the senior technical escalation path for CFMs and CEs on complex electrical, mechanical, controls, and fire/life safety issues. * Establish a clear intake, triage, and response model for site engineering requests, with defined response expectations and tracking. * Provide on\-site and remote troubleshooting support during critical events and recoveries, with the goal of achieving uptime and customer SLA commitments. **Root Cause Analysis Program** * Own Prime's RCA program: methodology, severity thresholds that trigger an RCA, report standards, training, corrective action tracking, and closure verification. * Provide technical support to CFMs and CEs, who own and lead site RCAs. This support includes failure analysis, data review, and coordination with OEMs, service vendors, and forensic labs. * Review RCAs for technical quality and consistency, and make sure corrective actions address true root causes. * Share findings and lessons learned across all sites so a failure at one site becomes a fix everywhere. **Equipment Reliability** * Develop and run a portfolio\-wide reliability program covering asset criticality ranking, failure trending, FMEA, and PM optimization (RCM\-based where appropriate). * Use CMMS, BMS/EPMS, and incident data to find bad actors, recurring failures, and fleet\-wide equipment issues, and drive resolution with OEMs. * Define critical spares strategy and condition\-based maintenance practices such as IR thermography, oil and vibration analysis, and battery monitoring. * Drive innovation in facilities programs and systems to improve quality and reliability and to reduce operating costs, with an environmentally conscious approach. * Report reliability KPIs to Critical Operations leadership. * Engineering Requirements, Visibility \& Rigor * Establish and maintain the engineering baseline for each operating site: current single\-lines, short\-circuit/coordination/arc flash studies, protective relay and breaker settings, sequences of operation, and as\-built documentation. * Implement and govern the engineering side of the formal change management process for operating sites so modifications receive appropriate technical review and documentation updates. * Provide technical review of higher\-risk Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and Emergency Operating/Response Procedures (EOPs/ERPs), in coordination with Prime's procedure policy. * Implement operating standards required for quality, safety, and ongoing operation, and assist site engineering and management with compliance with OSHA, national and local elect ctions, and turnover packages, and it gives sites a voice early in the project lifecycle so new facilities are built to be operated and maintained. * Hold regular touchpoints with CFMs and CEs to align on open issues, reliability concerns, and engineering needs. * Feed RCA findings, reliability data, and operability lessons back into design standards and equipment specifications. * Act as the bridge between site teams and Engineering/Design when operational issues trace back to design or construction decisions. * Interface with OEMs, service vendors, Prime Engineering, Development, and peer operations organizations. * Leadership * Hire, develop, and mentor a high\-performing engineering team; define roles, career paths, and regional coverage; ensure proper training and growth of staff. * Manage department staffing, expenditures, and budget in line with financial goals, along with outside engineering resources (study firms, OEM field engineering, forensic labs). * Maintain positive relationships and clear communication with site staff and executive leadership. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or a related discipline), or HVAC/critical power certifications, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree. * 8\+ years of professional experience managing teams, developing and implementing strategic initiatives, and overseeing departmental operations. * 8\+ years of direct engineering experience in a technical or critical environment (data center, hospital, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, nuclear, or industrial/commercial field engineering), including significant time supporting operating facilities rather than design/construction alone. * Demonstrated experience leading formal RCAs and implementing corrective actions. * Working knowledge of NFPA 70E, NFPA 70B, NEC, OSHA requirements, and relevant ASHRAE guidance. * Ability to travel an estimated 10\-30% and to respond to major incidents outside business hours. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Fluent in, and with an excellent working knowledge of, data center critical and construction environments. * Advanced understanding of mechanical and electrical equipment, systems, and design for data centers, including MV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, UPS, STS/ATS, PDUs, VFDs, generators, chillers (air\- and water\-cooled), pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, and liquid cooling. * Experience with emergency backup systems (generators, UPS, battery backup) and with BMS/EPMS and building controls. * Working knowledge of fire alarm/suppression and other life safety systems, and of building subsystems such as security and access control. * Ability to develop solutions and create technical, strategic, and tactical plans on complex projects, and to lead through influence across operations, development, and vendor organizations. * Ability to find creative solutions that improve quality and reliability while continuously driving down operating costs. * Familiarity with CMMS platforms, reliability analytics, and project/commissioning management software. **Benefits** * Competitive salary range and performance bonus program * 401k fully vested upon enrollment, up to a 4% employer match * 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability * Paid Time Off \+ Sick time *Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.* Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants are considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, protected veteran or military status, disability status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. \#LI\-Onsite **The pay range for this role is:** 185,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(Denver)

jobs.description: **Job title:** Staff Data Engineer **Reports to:** Director, Data Engineering **Department:** Central Services **Location:** Remote **About Priority:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** The Staff Data Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing and evolving scalable data architecture across Priority Holdings’ payments and commerce ecosystem. This role provides technical leadership across data ingestion, processing, Snowflake platform capabilities, data delivery, and data products, while helping establish engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams. The role also provides an opportunity to shape emerging capabilities in AI, automation, and MCP\-enabled data access as the organization expands its data platform strategy. **Responsibilities:*** Leads the technical design of large\-scale data systems, pipelines, and platform capabilities across multiple domains and engineering teams. * Defines reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards, and best practices for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, and data delivery. * Designs scalable solutions across Snowflake and supporting cloud technologies with a focus on reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost efficiency. * Partners with Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, QA, Software Engineering, and business teams to translate complex requirements into sustainable technical solutions. * Provides technical leadership for internal and external data ingestion patterns, including batch, CDC, streaming, APIs, and file\-based integrations. * Drives architecture for outbound data delivery through data sharing, APIs, SFTP, cross\-cloud integrations, and other distribution mechanisms. * Supports the evolution of data products such as Reporting Platform, DataBridge, AI\-enabled applications, and MCP\-based data services. * Establishes and improves engineering practices for observability, monitoring, automated testing, data quality, CI/CD, and operational readiness. * Identifies platform limitations, technical debt, and scalability risks, and drives long\-term solutions rather than tactical fixes. * Leads technical reviews for high\-impact initiatives and ensures architectural decisions are aligned with enterprise standards and long\-term platform direction. * Mentors senior and junior engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. * Partners with engineering and business leadership on roadmap planning, architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, and investment priorities. * Supports complex production incidents and drives root\-cause resolution, prevention, and improvements to platform reliability. * Evaluates emerging technologies and introduces new approaches when they provide measurable improvements in scalability, automation, developer productivity, or business capability. **What Success Looks Like:*** Complex data initiatives are delivered using scalable, reusable, and well\-governed architectural patterns. * Engineering teams benefit from clearer standards, stronger technical guidance, and reduced duplication across implementations. * Data pipelines and platform capabilities demonstrate improved reliability, observability, scalability, and operational readiness. * Technical decisions balance immediate delivery requirements with long\-term platform sustainability and cost efficiency. * Cross\-team architecture issues and ambiguous technical problems are resolved with clear direction and sound engineering judgment. * Senior and junior engineers become more effective through mentorship, design guidance, and reusable frameworks. * Data products and downstream consumers receive trusted, timely, and well\-supported data through standardized platform capabilities. * Platform improvements reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and technical debt. * The role is viewed as a trusted technical partner by engineering teams, leadersh nce establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or architecture patterns adopted by multiple teams. * Strong understanding of data quality, observability, monitoring, CI/CD, and operational reliability. * Demonstrated ability to operate independently on highly ambiguous and complex technical problems. * Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions without direct management authority. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred*** Experience with AWS data services, distributed processing technologies, and event\-driven architectures. * Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Debezium, Spark/PySpark, Airflow, or similar platforms. * Experience designing external data sharing and delivery solutions across Snowflake, APIs, SFTP, and cross\-cloud environments. * Experience with data platforms supporting fintech, payments, commerce, financial services, or other highly regulated environments. * Familiarity with AI/ML data architectures, AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, or MCP\-based integrations. * Experience designing platforms or frameworks that enable self\-service data engineering or workflow automation. * Experience with governance, lineage, metadata management, access controls, and secure data\-sharing patterns. * Experience leading major modernization, migration, or platform transformation initiatives. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie. Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:****Compensation range:** **$145k\-$190k** We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well\-being, growth, and success \- both inside and outside of work. **Financial Wellness** * Bonus programs * 401(k) match * Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) * HSA and FSA options * Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs **Health \& Well\-being** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health * Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot * Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga) **Time Off** * 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one **Growth \& Development** * Education expense reimbursement * Leadership development programs * Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support We believe great performance starts with feeling supported \- and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind. **Traditional Physical Requirements:*** Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching. * Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds. * Requires eye\-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction). Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **To apply:** **https://hr.cccs.edu/jobs/search/system\-office\-search\-page** **Description of Job** ---------------------- The Colorado Community College System is hiring a Senior Programmer Analyst to join our Career \& Technical Education (CTE) department at the CCCS System Office. All work for this role must be completed in the state of Colorado; relocation expenses are not available for this position.** **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Plan, design, develop, configure, test, deploy and support structure and content of the CTE web application (C \#, React, JavaScript, TypeScript), database, and reports (SQL), including both ad hoc and packaged reports. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Troubleshoot related issues as they arise and apply project management skills on development projects. * Conduct code reviews and other walkthroughs for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Develop and perform unit testing on programs/functions and work with others to contribute to test plans. * Participate in and complete work tickets related to review, troubleshooting, development, and testing of fixes to bugs or enhancements in the application or infrastructure. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, Common Table Expressions, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Conduct web accessibility mediation of CTE web applications and related duties, such as coaching/training staff, to support compliance with Section 508 and current WCAG standards. **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in technology, computer science, or related field. A combination of relevant education, training, and/or experience may substitute for the degree. * Minimum of two years of software or database development experience, at least some of which must be experience with Microsoft Azure, such as Webjobs, Cloud Architecture, Functions, Data Factory pipelines, storage, and B2C authentication. * Experience with programming languages, including C\# and React, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Competencies/KSAs** * Knowledgeable about CTE programs, especially in Colorado and with the Colorado CTE Gateway application preferred but not required. * Working knowledge of relational database applications such as MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, MySQL, Oracle, etc. * Practiced in running SQL queries. * Familiar with React\-Redux library. * Familiar with project management and application/software life cycle; methodologies like Agile scrum and Kanban; and tools like Team Foundation Server, Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. * Ability to identify user needs, conduct problem analysis, and provide technical solutions. * Awareness of Model View Controller pattern, Microsoft Entity framework, and design patterns usage. * Familiar with frontend and backend development of websites and applications. * Able to understand the importance of following established state and federal statutes and internal policies and business processes. * Ability to: work independently when given direction, work well in a team environment, and work well in a deadline driven environment, including adjusting to frequent changing work priorities. * Attention to detail while working timely under mandatory deadlines. * Strong Excel skills. * Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills with audiences of varying technical skills. * Familiar with, or ability to learn, Selenium. * Awareness of cloud\-based infrastructure design and implementation, specifically Azure and/or Dev Ops. * Moderate skills using IDE tools (i.e. Visual Studio). * Familiarity with continuous integration/delivery/deployment (CI/CD). * Practiced in multi\-tasking and with task prioritization when given various assignments. The Colorado Community College System is the state’s largest provider of higher education and workforce training, consisting of 13 colleges and over 35 locations across the state, educating approximately 130,000 postsecondary students annually. In addition, we train more than 4,000 Coloradans each year through customized employer training programs and coordinate delivery of career and technical education (CTE) programs to over 165,000 K\-12 learners annually. Our mission is to provide accessible, responsive learning environments where students can achieve their educational, professional and personal goals in an atmosphere that embraces academic excellence, diversity and innovation. We are an organization that encourages individuals to bring their whole selves to work. Work Location/Travel Expectations: * CCCS offices at 9101 E Lowry Blvd., Denver, CO 80230\. * Travel is rare for this position; on occasion there may be opportunities for in\-state or out\-of\-state meetings/conferences. * Alternative work arrangements, including flexible schedules and hybrid\-remote work may be available. All work must be completed in the state of Colorado. Note: per the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, an applicant may redact information from their resume, cover letter, and/or transcripts that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. If your position requires us to review an official transcript, without redacting, we will request one as part of our conditional offer process. In order to evaluate work experience against established requirements for positions, we are still requesting dates of service **(month and year)** for positions in the applicant’s work history.

jobs.title: Engineer / Senior Engineer – AI Model Enablement & Software Tools
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Engineering **General Summary:** As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next\-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all. As an Engineer / Senior Engineer in the Qualcomm AI Stack SDK Software team, you will contribute to bringing modern AI models to Snapdragon platforms using Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model\-enablement frameworks. You will work with senior engineers to analyze, adapt, optimize, quantize, compile, and validate AI models, including Large Language Models, vision models, Vision\-Language Models, and multimodal models. You will collaborate with AI Research and AI accelerator hardware and software teams to understand model architectures, identify operator\- and graph\-level backend gaps, and integrate reusable solutions into Qualcomm’s model\-enablement frameworks and SDK. This role combines AI/ML software development with graph processing, model optimization, systems software, and on\-device execution. You will gain hands\-on experience with model loading, graph adaptation, quantization, calibration, compilation, runtime integration, performance analysis, and debugging across software and hardware layers. The role emphasizes strong programming fundamentals, hands\-on implementation, problem\-solving, and collaboration. Engineers will work under the guidance of technical leads, while Senior Engineers will take greater ownership of feature design, implementation, debugging, and delivery. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2\+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 1\+ year of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Contribute to the bring\-up and enablement of new language, vision, vision\-language, and multimodal models on Snapdragon platforms. * Study model implementations and computational graphs to understand model inputs, outputs, operators, tensor shapes, data flow, and execution behavior. * Work with AI Research and backend teams to identify unsupported operators, graph patterns, precision constraints, and performance limitations. * Implement model re\-authoring, operator decomposition, graph transformations, layout changes, and backend\-specific adaptations. * Develop reusable model support that can be integrated into Qualcomm’s model\-enablement frameworks rather than creating isolated model\-specific solutions. * Implement and maintain pipeline stages, model mappings, quantization recipes, configuration models, artifact handling, and validation utilities. * Convert, optimize, and export models from PyTorch and ONNX for compilation and execution on Qualcomm AI accelerators. * Apply and validate quantization and calibration flows, including weight and activation quantization, mixed precision, PTQ, and accuracy\-recovery techniques. * Measure and improve model accuracy, latency, throughput, memory consumption, model size, and power efficiency. * Work with Generative AI inference concepts such as transformer attention, KV cache, prefill and decode execution, LoRA, MoE, and speculative decoding. * Support vision and multimodal processing flows, including image processors, vision encoders, language backbones, and cross\-component artifact integration. * Debug issues across model code, computational graphs, quantization, compiler, runtime, operating system, and hardware layers. * Develop unit, integration, accuracy, performance, and on\-device validation tests. * Write high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-documented Python and C/C\+\+ code. * Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and testing cycles. * Collaborate with globally distributed engineering, research, hardware, QA, product, and customer\-facing teams. * Senior Engineers will independently own larger features, contribute to design decisions, mentor junior engineers, and drive assigned model\-enablement work through completion. **Minimum Qualifications (Must Have)** -------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Engineer: Project or internship experience for entry\-level candidates, or 1\+ years of experience in software development. OR * Senior Engineer: 2\+ years of experience in software design, development, and delivery. * Good programming skills in Python and/or C/C\+\+. * Strong understanding of software en ion, including PTQ, QAT, weight and activation quantization, and mixed precision. * Experience or coursework involving transformer\-based models, LLMs, vision models, or multimodal models. * Understanding of common transformer components such as attention, normalization, feed\-forward layers, positional encoding, and KV cache. * Experience with Linux\-based software development. * Experience developing or optimizing embedded, mobile, edge, or system\-level software. * Exposure to Android or an RTOS environment such as QNX. * Familiarity with CMake\-based builds, Git\-based source control, code reviews, and agile software development practices. * Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and debugging software across multiple abstraction layers. * Exposure to model performance analysis, profiling, memory optimization, or hardware accelerator programming. * User\-level or development exposure to commercial AI software stacks and model\-enablement frameworks, including model conversion, optimization, compilation, deployment, and runtime tools. * Exposure to Snapdragon SoCs, NPUs, HTPs, or other AI accelerator architectures. jobs.title: Data Integration Senior Engineer
jobs.description: **Position summary** The Data Integration Senior Engineer serves as Strategic Intelligence's hands\-on technical lead for data platform engineering, DataOps, and enterprise data integration. The role turns governed data capabilities—including master data, entity resolution, semantic models and layers, knowledge graphs, and reusable data products— into secure, production\-grade pipelines, APIs, event flows, services, and controlled interfaces that support analytics, automation, AI, and agent\-enabled use cases. The role owns the runtime engineering lifecycle for these capabilities, including integration design, release engineering, deployment automation, environment promotion, observability, incident response, reliability, recoverability, performance, and cost efficiency. The Senior Engineer establishes reusable engineering patterns and replaces brittle point\-to\-point integrations, manual handoffs, duplicate data stores, and one\-off extracts with governed, scalable, and supportable services and delivery mechanisms. The role operates within established business, data governance, product, analytical, architecture, security, and platform ownership boundaries. Relevant capability and domain owners retain accountability for business meaning, taxonomy and ontology standards, stewardship, data\-quality policy, master\-data requirements, analytical methods, product priorities, and business outcomes. This role owns the technical integration, release engineering, and production operation of approved data capabilities. Finance\-domain analysis, measures, and products are outside this role's remit. **Job duties and responsibilities** * Serve as the hands\-on technical lead for data platform engineering, DataOps, and enterprise integration, contributing directly to architecture, coding, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support. * Co\-design end\-to\-end solutions with relevant capability owners across business, data, product, architecture, security, and technology, defining integration boundaries, non\-functional requirements, release plans, acceptance criteria, and support models from the outset. * Develop and operate production\-grade batch, near\-real\-time, and event\-driven pipelines, APIs, services, and controlled interfaces connecting approved internal systems, external data sources, enterprise platforms, and downstream consumers. * Create reusable connectors and integration patterns that support analytics, automation, AI, and agent\-enabled use cases while minimizing point\-to\-point dependencies and duplicated logic. * Establish and enforce engineering standards for source control, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, documentation, secrets management, environment promotion, release and rollback, recovery, and operational support. * Define and monitor service levels and non\-functional requirements for availability, freshness, latency, throughput, recoverability, security, and cost, with clear runbooks and ownership for production support. * Automate deployment, monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability for data services and integrations; make metadata, lineage, transformation logic, quality results, assumptions, and limitations transparent and discoverable. * Diagnose incidents and data\-delivery failures, perform root\-cause analysis, remediate defects, and improve reliability, performance, recoverability, and cost efficiency across pipelines, APIs, integrations, and platform services. * Productionize MDM, entity\-resolution, semantic\-layer, knowledge\-graph, and governed data\-product capabilities while preserving approved data contracts, versioning, access controls, quality rules, and traceability. * Manage schema, interface, and data\-contract evolution, including impact assessment, backward compatibility, consumer communication, and coordinated deprecation of legacy interfaces. * Refactor or retire brittle integrations, manual handoffs, duplicate data stores, and one\-off extracts in favor of reusable, governed, and supportable services that reduce operational risk and technical debt. * Partner with the functions responsible for enterprise architecture, platform engineering, information security, privacy, records management, and application ownership to align solutions with architecture, access\-control, platform, and compliance standards and to surface capability gaps. * Work with the capabilities responsible for master data, entity resolution, semantic modeling, knowledge graphs, and governed data products throughout design, testing, release, and support. This role owns deployment and runtime reliability; the appropriate functional owners remain accountable for the correctness and evolution of underlying rules, models, definitions, and data\-product logic. * Partner with product and portfolio stakeholders on feasibility, dependencies, effort, risk, sequencing, and build\-buy\-partner decisions; portfolio prioritization, product lifecycle, adoption, and value realization r an one\-off extracts or manual handoffs. * Strong understanding of DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, production operations, service reliability, and platform engineering, with sufficient familiarity with MDM, semantic, and data\-product concepts to deploy and operate those capabilities effectively. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices, constraints, support implications, and risks to business, data, analytics, product, and technology stakeholders. * High degree of professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, flexibility, and adaptability in complex, dynamic, or rapidly evolving situations. **Additional information** **Supervisory responsibilities:** Provides technical leadership across cross\-functional delivery teams and directs external implementation partners, contractors, and project resources as applicable. **Equipment used:** Personal computer and other office equipment such Ability to use computers, telecommunications, and digital collaboration tools to perform core job responsibilities. * Ability to engage in effective and professional communication. * Ability to analyze complex information while maintaining attention to detail, managing multiple priorities, and exercising sound judgment in decision\-making. * Ability to access, use, and safeguard confidential and sensitive information while performing job responsibilities in work environments that support confidentiality, privacy, and information security requirements. * Ability to work extended or needs. * Ability to travel for meetings, training and conferences as required. * Ability to work in\-office as required to meet business or project needs. **Working conditions:** Works remotely.
