jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large\-scale enterprise transformation. **About the role:** ------------------- We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production\-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real\-world data. You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re\-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low\-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions. * Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems. * Turn complex processes into multi\-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire\-to\-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs. * Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling. * Leverage full\-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high\-ownership, user\-facing agent systems. * Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human\-in\-the\-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time. * Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused. **Experience you’ll need:** --------------------------- * Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands\-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes. * Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces. * A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here. ### **Software engineering skills and best practices:** * System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures. * Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance. Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents. * Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve sy ext graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval. * Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms. * Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks. * Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks. * Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores. * UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $188,500—$282,700 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. and document repositories). * Feedback Loop and Scale: Serve as the critical feedback loop between construction site realities and the centralized AI team, turning field\-tested prototypes into scalable enterprise solutions. * Culture Building: Actively participate in fostering Ryan’s data and AI culture through promoting data\-driven decision\-making. **What we expect you to have:** * 3\+ IAM security models. * Demonstrated experience developing custom RAG pipelines, fine\-tuning LLMs, working with vector databases, and orchestrating multi\-agent systems * Strong coding proficiency in Python, SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript; solid grasp of RESTful APIs, data serialization, and Git workflows. * Ability and willingness to travel regularly to active construction sites, participate in job site meetings, and understand field operations. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Construction Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **To be impactful and valuable AI solutions. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with diverse skill sets and work styles. * Resourceful, entrepreneurial, and innovative mindset, with a drive to tackle ambiguous challenges effectively. * Commitment to staying updated on AI trends and leveraging them to deliver business value. * Understanding of ethical and responsible AI principles and practices **Preferred Experience** * Prior exposure to Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC), commercial real estate, or industrial operations. * Familiarity with construction tools and APIs (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360 / ACC, Bluebeam, DroneDeploy). * Experience designing conversational interfaces or automated field data capture workflows (voice\-to\-text, field forms) **Compensation:** The base pay range is $100,000 \- $130,000/Annually. The salary may vary within the anticipated range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include commission and/or an incentive program. **Eligibility:** Position requires verification of employment to work in the U.S. **Benefits:** * Competitive Salary * Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits * Retirement and Savings Benefits * Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts * Life Insurance * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Educational Assistance * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Employee Assistance and Wellness Programs * Family Planning \& Parenting Benefits * Employee Discount Programs * Pet insurance * Charitable Donation Matching * Volunteer Time Off (VTO) * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) *Disclaimer: Eligibility may vary based on factors such as role, hours worked, employment status, length of service, location, and other considerations. If you recieve communication from someone you believe is impersonating Ryan Companies, please report it to us at* humanresources@ryancompanies.com **Non\-Solicitation Notice to Recruitment Agencies:** Ryan Companies kindly requests that recruitment agencies and third\-party recruiters do not submit unsolicited resumes or candidate information to any Ryan Companies employee or office. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Commerce
jobs.description: **ABOUT STORD** --------------- Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission. By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale. With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order. Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures. We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead engineering teams in Commerce. You'll build and run strong teams, own delivery for products that shoppers at hundreds of brands use every day, and help decide what we build next. This is a leadership role first, but it isn't a hands\-off one. You'll stay close enough to the code to make good technical calls and review designs and pull requests credibly, and you'll jump in and build when the team needs it. If you've drifted away from the technical side of the job, this isn't the role for you. Much of Commerce is zero to one. We launch new products, learn what works with real merchants, and scale what does. That takes a startup mindset: move fast, make decisions with incomplete information, get something real in front of customers quickly, and then make it great. **Why Commerce** ================ Commerce is Stord's newest and most strategic group, and it's where we're building the next generation of Stord software. We own the shopper's experience from checkout through delivery: the delivery promise at checkout, order tracking, proactive notifications, returns, and shipment protection. It's the part of Stord that shoppers actually see, and it's how our merchants earn their customers' loyalty. What makes Commerce different is what sits underneath it. Most commerce software stops at the screen and guesses about everything after the order is placed. Ours runs on top of the network that actually picks, packs, and ships those orders. That gives us real operational data to build with, so a delivery date can be a promise instead of an estimate, and a tracking page can know what's really happening with an order. Much of what we're building is brand new, and we're building it with AI from the start. **Why This Role** ================= * You'll lead engineering on the part of Stord that shoppers actually see, built on real data from the fulfillment network underneath it. * You'll have a real voice in product direction. We expect engineering leaders to challenge the roadmap, push back on the wrong solution, and bring ideas of their own. * You'll help set how Stord builds with AI, not just adopt what someone else decided. You'll build new products from scratch, with the backing of a company that already runs over $10 billion of commerce a year. * **What You'll Do** ================== **People Leadership** * Own the full people lifecycle for your teams: hiring, 1:1s, performance management, and career development * Build teams of product\-minded engineers who own outcomes, not tickets * Give direct feedback, act early on performance, and grow engineers into bigger roles **Product and Customer** * Partner with Product and Design as an equal in deciding what to build, challenging assumptions and bringing your own point of view to the roadmap * Stay close to customers: talk with merchants, watch how shoppers use what we ship, and bring what you learn back to the team * Own outcomes after launch, measuring whether what we built actually changed things for merchants and their shoppers **Zero to One Delivery** * Take new products from idea to launch quickly, cutting scope to get something real in front of customers and iterating from there * Set delivery goals and keep a predictable cadence without burying the team in process * Make clear calls on trade\-offs between speed, scope, and quality, and explain the "why" **Hands\-On Technical Leadership** * Engage credibly in architecture, design reviews, and code reviews across TypeScript services and React front ends * Get hands\-on when it matters: prototype a new idea, unblock a critical path, or help during an incident * Own the reliability of what your teams run, from monitoring to incident response to root\-cause fixes **AI\-First Engineering** * Lead how your teams build with AI coding agents, from requirements through planning, coding, testing, and deployment * Push Stord's AI engineering practices forward: share what works across teams, set the quality bar for AI\-assisted work, and make sure engineers keep their own technical judgment Help shape how AI shows up in Commerce products, for shoppers and for the merchants who use them * **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years managing engineers directly: hiring, performance reviews, feedback, and career development * Strong engineering fundamentals. You can engage credibly in design discussions, code review, and architecture decisions, and you still build when it's needed * Experience with modern web development, ideally TypeScript, Node.js, and React * A track record of taking products from zero to one: launching something new, learning from customers, and iterating quickly * Hands\-on experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), and experience leading a team's adoption of them while holding a high quality bar A production mindset. Reliability, monitoring, and failure modes are part of how your teams build, not an afterthought * **Required Soft Skills** * **Customer Obsession:** You start with the merchant and the shopper, and you measure success by what changes for them. * **Product Ownership:** You care deeply about the product your team builds. You have opinions about what it should be, and you hold your team to them. * **Healthy Pushback:** You challenge plans, priorities, and specs when they're wrong, with evidence. Once a decision is made, you commit to it. * **Bias for Action:** You move fast with incomplete information and know when something is good enough to put in front of customers and learn from. * **Delegation \& Multiplication:** You scale through people, not heroics. You also aren't above doing the work yourself when the team needs it. * **Strong Communication:** You communicate clearly with engineers, PMs, and executives, and you translate technical complexity into business language and back. **Strongly Preferred** * Consumer commerce experience: checkout, payments, cart, order tracking, notifications, returns, or the Shopify app ecosystem * Startup or high\-growth experience, especially building new products from scratch Experience managing multiple engineering teams * **Nice to Have** * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features in production * Background in logistics, fulfillment, or e\-commerce operations * Experience with GCP, event\-driven architectures, or message streaming (Kafka, Redpanda, or similar) * Elixir/Phoenix familiarity

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * **Nice\-to\-have:** agentic systems depth beyond the gate above. Can speak concretely to how AI agents are actually built and operated — e.g., the MCP protocol and what a harne stem to enforce that. **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $147,600 USD \- $221,400 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $137,900 USD \- $206,900 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. jobs.description: **Job Title: Software Engineer II** **About Us:** We were founded in 1993 on the simple belief that we can save the world from our competition by solving the insurance industry’s most challenging problems with innovative solutions and extraordinary service. We have proven it. As one of the leading international travel insurance and specialty benefit management companies in the world, we service over 800,000 customers each year including international travelers, US government agencies, corporations, foreign governments, and insurance companies. With a diverse and growing global workforce of the best and brightest talent, Seven Corners is a fast\-paced, innovative company with no plans to slow down soon. Our values drive each decision we make and each action we take. They are our guide to how we treat each other and our customers. These beliefs are the heart of the company culture and define what it means to work at Seven Corners. **Our Culture** Our culture is what makes us “us” it is the unique vibe you feel when you walk through our doors, the passion we bring to creating innovative solutions and the extra mile we go to put our customers first. It is a way of feeling and behaving toward each other and our customers. It is the values we hold to be true. It is in every decision we make and every action we take. **Our Values:** Customers come first We innovate We do the right thing We own the solution We are precise **What you would do here:** A Software Engineer II job description involves contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle, from design and development to testing and deployment, with a focus on building scalable, reliable, and user\-friendly software solutions. Key responsibilities include collaborating with cross\-functional teams, improving existing systems, mentoring junior engineers, participating in code reviews, and solving complex technical problems to drive business outcomes and technical innovation. Typical Responsibilities * **Design and Development**: Design, develop, and implement new software features and applications, translating business requirements into functional code. * **Collaboration**: Work with product managers, designers, and other engineers in a team environment, participating in code reviews and adhering to best practices. * **Maintenance and Optimization**: Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing software systems to ensure performance, reliability, and security. * **Mentorship**: Provide guidance and technical leadership to junior engineers, helping them grow their skills. * **Process Improvement**: Contribute to and improve standard engineering processes, including testing, monitoring, and automated workflows. * **Innovation**: Stay updated on new technologies and apply them to solve complex problems and drive innovation in software products. **Typical Environment:** * A Level II engineer often works independently with general supervision. * Problems faced are difficult but typically not complex. * Takes ownership of project deliverables. * Trusted to make decisions that impact a project. * Seeks to understand the “why” of the work. * Accurately estimates complexity of tasks. **Ideally you have:** * **Technical Expertise**: Proficiency in relevant programming languages, frameworks, and databases, including experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and microservices architecture. * **Software Development Lifecycle**: Experience with all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering and design to testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * **Problem\-Solving**: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions. * **Collaboration \& Communication**: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams. * **Agile \& Scrum**: Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience participating in Scrum ceremonies. Experience: Typically requires a few years of professional software development experience, often with a bachelor's degree in a related field. Seven Corners hires culture fit over technical skills and experience. If you have the aptitude and attitude, we can help you grow your career through training, mentoring, increasing responsibility, and being around other rock star employees. jobs.title: Principal, Agentic Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **General Information** ----------------------- Locations * Atlanta, GA * Boston, MA * Chicago, IL * Dallas, TX * Denver, CO * Los Angeles, CA * Philadelphia, PA * Seattle, WA Business Function Cloud innovation \& modernization Date posted Monday, October 12, 2026 Ref \# JBR0001859 **Description and Requirements** -------------------------------- Job Description **Agentic Reliability Engineer (ARE)** Slalom · Agentic Managed Services · Remote (US) with possible client travel · Principal or Senior Principal level **ABOUT THE ROLE** AI agents are moving into production faster than most organizations can operate them reliably and closing that gap is exactly why Slalom built its Agentic Managed Services (AMS) practice. As an Agentic Reliability Engineer, you are the technical heart of that work: the engineer who makes AI agents dependable in the real world. Where a traditional Site Reliability Engineer keeps software services healthy, you own the reliability of AI agents. These are systems that reason, make decisions, and act on a client's behalf, but can fail in ways classical engineering never had to consider. You'll help design and stand up agentic solutions with clients, prove they hold up under real conditions, and then keep them performing in production: watching how they behave, diagnosing why they drift, tuning and evaluating them, and safely rolling out changes as they evolve. Your day to day will look like a small senior delivery pod working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the client and with Slalom's platform team. It's a collaborative, high\-ownership environment: you are the final technical authority on how the agents behave, and the person a client trusts to tell them their systems are reliable, well\-governed, and getting better over time. Because our agentic reliability engineering group is a new and fast\-growing practice, you'll also help shape *how* the work is done. We expect you to provide input in to the patterns, tooling, and standards that make running production agents repeatable. This is a role for engineers who want to be at the frontier of what AI systems actually do in production. You thrive on work with real stakeholders, measured outcomes, and sustained impacts. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Design \& deploy agentic solutions*** * Partner with clients to shape the opportunity and design the agent workflow — what the agents should do, how their performance will be judged, and what guardrails keep them safe. * Build the first working agents: stand up the initial workflow, evaluation harness, and guardrails, and demonstrate that the solution meets the client's acceptance criteria under real conditions. * Define the reliability baseline the solution must hold in production including the SLOs, evaluation criteria, and autonomy posture that govern it. ***Run \& continuously improve production agents*** * Own root\-cause analysis and ongoing performance of the agent workflow itself: why it behaves as it does, and how to make it measurably better over time. * Own the evaluation harness: configure, run, and interpret agent evaluations against workflow\-specific acceptance criteria. * Monitor drift signals (e.g. output\-quality degradation, latency trends, evaluation pass\-rate decline, cost anomalies) and remediate before they breach SLOs. * Run A/B and shadow evaluations when agent behavior changes are proposed * Capture operational findings, incident lessons, and evaluation\-calibration notes so the pod's knowledge compounds over time rather than resetting. ***Measure, analyze \& communicate performance*** * Define and track the KPIs that describe how well the agents are performing and investigate when they move in unexpected directions. * Translate telemetry into narratives the team and client can act on. * Develop and communicate clear plans to improve agent performance and reporting on their impact once shipped. * Serve as the final technical authority for AI agent incidents including owning root\-cause analysis of the agent workflow, remediation, and postmortem documentation. * Determine whether an incident reflects a transient error, agent drift, workflow\-logic failure, or an underlying model\-behavior change. ***Safe change \& controlled rollout*** * Manage change control for agent workflow updates: version the change, run the evaluation suite, document the expected behavioral delta, and propose the go\-live schedule. * Stage rollouts with shadow\-deployment patterns before promoting to full release; monitoring the stability window and rolling back per runbook if thresholds are breached. * Manage identity, access, and integrations: app registrations and credentials, access control and permissions, and the authentication, authorization, and contracts that govern how agents communicate with other tools and systems. * Manage cost and infrastructure: right\-sizing the compute agents run on, setting token and budget caps per agent, optimizing workflow steps for efficient resource use, and reportin tion \& partnership** — you make the people around you better: giving and acting on candid feedback, sharing what you learn, and partnering effectively with Slalom teammates across capabilities, platform, and client teams to move the work forward together. **WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW** AI agents are moving from novelty to critical infrastructure, and the engineers who build the discipline of running them reliably will define the field for the next decade. Being able to say “I have run agents in production, at SLA, and debugged them”, is one of the most exciting and evolving skillsets engineering today. This role puts you at the center of it: real clients, real outcomes, and a platform team investing in the tooling that makes the work tractable, at a firm building this practice as a long\-term strategic bet. **About Us** Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co\-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. **Compensation and Benefits** Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, \& vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long\-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well\-being\-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for Principal level is: * Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles; $171,000\-$210,000 * Atlanta, Dallas, Philadelphia; $157,000\-$195,000 The targeted base salary range for Senior Principal level is: * Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles; $216,000\-$254,000 * Atlanta, Dallas, Philadelphia; $198,000\-$235,000 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. We will accept applicants until November 12th, or until the position is filled. We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. **EEO and Accommodations** *Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact* *accomodationrequest@slalom.com* *if you require accommodations during the interview process.*

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Components & Device Actions
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! SmartThings is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join the Components and Device Actions (CODA) team. CODA owns the core device and location cloud services that the rest of the SmartThings platform builds on: how devices are described, organized, and managed, and how homes and their contents are represented and handed between owners. You'll join a tight\-knit team of experienced engineers running mission\-critical services at scale, with a roadmap that spans new platform capabilities, modernization of our stack, and growing demand from enterprise customers. It's a role with real influence over where these services go next. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy:** Chart the long\-term direction for one or more CODA domains so our device and location services keep pace with platform growth. * **Complex Initiatives:** Own large, ambiguous, multi\-team efforts from first sketch to well\-run production launch. * **Architecture for Reliability \& Scale:** Steer design for the services behind device capabilities, device groups, locations, and ownership transfer, including event\-driven state processing and the demands of enterprise customers. Reliability, performance, and security shape the design from day one. * **Platform Modernization:** Lead the evolution of our stack while balancing security, maintainability, and cost. * **AI Practices \& Vision:** Shape how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, deciding where it genuinely improves speed and quality. * **Partnership Across Teams:** Work alongside global platform, product, and partner teams that build on CODA, keeping priorities aligned with product needs and business goals. * **Mentorship \& Team Growth:** Coach engineers at every level and build habits that lift the bar across the organization. * **Service Ownership:** SmartThings teams run what they build. You'll share responsibility for production support, from planning through deployment. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** **What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field * 8\+ years of production software engineering with a record of Staff\-level leadership * Fluency in JVM languages (Java, Kotlin, etc.) and frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut, etc). * A hands\-on record designing and operating distributed microservices and RESTful APIs on AWS at scale, with Terraform and Docker in your toolkit * Sound judgment across data and messaging layers: DynamoDB versus relational stores, and event\-driven systems built on Kafka or similar * Working knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Proven ability to lead design reviews, steer direction across teams, and turn complex problems into simple solutions, with clear written and verbal communication for technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Zero\-downtime migrations and large\-scale data backfills on live systems * Observability, failure testing, and disciplined release practices * Kubernetes and container orchestration in production * Agentic coding tools, and a habit of sharing what works * Multi\-tenant platforms with permissions, usage limits, and rate limiting ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches once a week. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is $139,000 to $198,000\. Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- **To apply:** **https://hr.cccs.edu/jobs/search/system\-office\-search\-page** **Description of Job** ---------------------- The Colorado Community College System is hiring a Senior Programmer Analyst to join our Career \& Technical Education (CTE) department at the CCCS System Office. We are looking for a skilled problem solver who can research, propose, and implement solutions. If you’re looking for a full stack developer opportunity on a small, tightknit team where your work will impact students throughout Colorado, this position may be for you! In this position you’ll provide technical support and problem solving for a variety of Career \& Technical Education (CTE) Gateway application and technical issues, working closely with the Customer Support Team, other CCCS\-IT teams, and other developers. This is a highly collaborative role, and you will need to be able to translate complex technical information for end users. You’ll be responsible for analyzing, designing, developing, documenting, reviewing, and testing complex functions, modules, and programs in order to support the CTE in Colorado database, web application, and data reports. The Colorado CTE Gateway is the single site in which all Career and Technical Education (CTE) program and contact management and reporting, including for state and federal CTE funding, is housed. This custom\-built, cloud\-based web application software is owned, developed, and maintained by the CTE Accountability team. It is built on Azure services such as Azure SQL, and Web Services. The API is written in C\# and front end is in ReactJS. **Note: All interviews for this position will be hosted in person at our office in Denver, Colorado. Travel reimbursement to the interviews is not available. All work for this role must be completed in the state of Colorado; relocation expenses are not available for this position.** **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Plan, design, develop, configure, test, deploy and support structure and content of the CTE web application (C \#, React, JavaScript, TypeScript), database, and reports (SQL), including both ad hoc and packaged reports. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Troubleshoot related issues as they arise and apply project management skills on development projects. * Conduct code reviews and other walkthroughs for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Develop and perform unit testing on programs/functions and work with others to contribute to test plans. * Participate in and complete work tickets related to review, troubleshooting, development, and testing of fixes to bugs or enhancements in the application or infrastructure. * Construct complex SQL queries to access and manipulate data, as well as develop and maintain stored procedures, Common Table Expressions, web jobs and functions within the site infrastructure. * Conduct web accessibility mediation of CTE web applications and related duties, such as coaching/training staff, to support compliance with Section 508 and current WCAG standards. **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in technology, computer science, or related field. A combination of relevant education, training, and/or experience may substitute for the degree. * Minimum of two years of software or database development experience, at least some of which must be experience with Microsoft Azure, such as Webjobs, Cloud Architecture, Functions, Data Factory pipelines, storage, and B2C authentication. * Experience with programming languages, including C\# and React, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Competencies/KSAs** * Knowledgeable about CTE programs, especially in Colorado and with the Colorado CTE Gateway application preferred but not required. * Working knowledge of relational database applications such as MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, MySQL, Oracle, etc. * Practiced in running SQL queries. * Familiar with React\-Redux library. * Familiar with project management and application/software life cycle; methodologies like Agile scrum and Kanban; and tools like Team Foundation Server, Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. * Ability to identify user needs, conduct problem analysis, and provide technical solutions. * Awareness of Model View Controller pattern, Microsoft Entity framework, and design patterns usage. * Familiar with frontend and backend development of websites and applications. * Able to understand the importance of following established state and federal statutes and internal policies and business processes. * Ability to: work independently when given direction, work well in a team environment, and work well in a deadline driven environment, including adjusting to frequent changing work priorities. * Attention to detail while working timely under mandatory deadlines. * Strong Excel skills. * Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills with audiences of varying technical skills. * Familiar with, or ability to learn, Selenium. * Awareness of cloud\-based infrastructure design and implementation, specifically Azure and/or Dev Ops. * Moderate skills using IDE tools (i.e. Visual Studio). * Familiarity with continuous integration/delivery/deployment (CI/CD). * Practiced in multi\-tasking and with task prioritization when given various assignments. The Colorado Community College System is the state’s largest provider of higher education and workforce training, consisting of 13 colleges and over 35 locations across the state, educating approximately 130,000 postsecondary students annually. In addition, we train more than 4,000 Coloradans each year through customized employer training programs and coordinate delivery of career and technical education (CTE) programs to over 165,000 K\-12 learners annually. Our mission is to provide accessible, responsive learning environments where students can achieve their educational, professional and personal goals in an atmosphere that embraces academic excellence, diversity and innovation. We are an organization that encourages individuals to bring their whole selves to work. Work Location/Travel Expectations: * CCCS offices at 9101 E Lowry Blvd., Denver, CO 80230\. * Travel is rare for this position; on occasion there may be opportunities for in\-state or out\-of\-state meetings/conferences. * Alternative work arrangements, including flexible schedules and hybrid\-remote work may be available. All work must be completed in the state of Colorado. Note: per the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, an applicant may redact information from their resume, cover letter, and/or transcripts that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. If your position requires us to review an official transcript, without redacting, we will request one as part of our conditional offer process. In order to evaluate work experience against established requirements for positions, we are still requesting dates of service **(month and year)** for positions in the applicant’s work history.

jobs.title: Chief Information and Technology Officer - 48000901
jobs.description: Requisition No: 885450 Agency: Department of Education Working Title: Chief Information and Technology Officer \- 48000901 Pay Plan: SES Position Number: 48000901 Salary: agency to update Posting Closing Date: 10/26/2026 **Total Compensation Estimator** **Tool** **Florida Department of Education** **Office of The Commissioner** **Location: Tallahassee** **Position Title: Chief Information Officer (SES)** **Salary Range: $180,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00** **SALARY IS BASED ON CANDIDATE’S EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** **OFFICE CONTACT:** Jennifer Boswell, 850\-245\-9867 **JOB DESCRIPTION:** The Chief Information and Technology Officer is a cabinet\-level executive who sets the Department’s technology vision, architecture, and investment agenda; runs the Division of Technology and Innovation (DTI) (including the Education Data Center and related application, infrastructure, data, security, and service functions); and represents FDOE with the Florida Digital Service (or successor enterprise IT body), the Legislature, school districts, colleges, and vendors. While the CIO directly oversees DTI, technology leadership and modernization efforts extend across the Department. The CIO will work collaboratively with technology teams throughout the agency, including those within the Division of Vocational Rehabilitation (VR), Division of Blind Services (DBS), and Division of Early Learning (DEL), to advance shared technology priorities, strengthen operational support, and ensure alignment with the Department’s broader strategic goals. These teams play a critical role in maintaining essential systems, supporting division\-specific needs, and contributing to the Department’s long\-term technology modernization efforts. Success in this role is defined by four outcomes: (1\) a funded, governed, and executing plan to exit the mainframe and retire COBOL\-dependent applications on a public timeline; (2\) a production\-ready AI and advanced analytics program that improves operations and decision\-making under a clear risk and privacy framework; (3\) measurable improvement in reliability, security, and service to program offices and local education agencies; and (4\) a rebuilt technology organization that can attract and keep modern engineering, data, and product talent. The Florida Department of Education (FDOE) is seeking a transformation\-minded Chief Information Officer to serve as the agency’s senior technology executive and statutory agency CIO under section 282\.3055, Florida Statutes. This is not a caretaker role. The next CIO will retire a remaining mainframe and COBOL/DB2 estate that still underpins core statewide education operations, stand up a durable cloud and data platform, and scale artificial intelligence in a way that is useful to districts, colleges, and the Department—without compromising student privacy, cybersecurity, or public trust. A completed feasibility study frames enterprise mainframe modernization as a multi\-year program—three phases over six years, with an estimated total cost of approximately $151 million—covering student data collection, education finance calculations, financial reporting, transcript exchange, assessment reporting, school identification, and capital outlay. Year\-one work includes a program management office, COBOL and DB2 inventory and business\-rule extraction, knowledge transfer from a shrinking specialist workforce, and cloud foundation work consistent with Florida’s cloud\-first policy and Chapter 60GG cybersecurity rules. The CIO will own that program end to end and will be judged on whether the mainframe actually goes away. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** (Note: The omission of specific job duties does not preclude management from assigning specific duties not listed herein if such duties are a logical assignment to the position.) The Florida Department of Education (FDOE) has an open position that is responsible for executing the following functions: **1\.** **Enterprise modernization and mainframe exit** * Own the enterprise mainframe modernization program as a single accountable executive—scope, sequence, budget, vendors, risk, and legislative reporting. * Complete and maintain a full inventory of COBOL, CICS, DB2, batch, and interface assets; extract business rules; map data and process dependencies; and publish a system\-by\-system retire, rewrite, replace, or encapsulate decision. * Stand up a Program Management Office with independent verification and validation, stage\-gate funding, and monthly executive dashboards that a non\-technical cabinet and legislative staff can read. * Move remaining workloads off the mainframe to cloud\-native or commercially supported platforms consistent with s. 282\.206, F.S. (cloud\-first), Northwest Regional Data Center and enterprise hosting policy, and Chapter 60GG\-2, F.A.C. * Protect continuity of FEFP funding calculations, survey/data collections, transcripts, assessments, MSID, PECO, and related mission systems during cutover. N e schedule of 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Telework is not available for this role. **APPLICANT INFORMATION \& HIRING REQUIREMENTS** Application Information: * Your Candidate Profile (application) must be complete in its entirety. * Work History (in easy to review chronological order) Consists of: + Any position held by a State of Florida agency + Any position held by a Florida University + All periods of employment from high school graduation + All periods of current or prior unemployment + Gaps 3 months of more must be accounted for\* + Any Education + Any Volunteer Experience + Your resume and application must match * **Gaps 3 months of more must be addressed** – you will need to account for and explain any gaps in employment including unemployment. Applicants will be evaluated based on questionnaire responses; do not enter "See Resume" in response fields. * Cover letter describing how your experience and qualifications relate to the Summary of Work. * Current resume demonstrating that you meet the minimum qualifications. * A list of at least three professional references. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer , PrimeTime Signoff Solutions
jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18448 **Base Salary Range** $129000\-$193000 **Date posted** 10/11/2026 ### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years in the trenches of timing signoff, and you know the difference between a clean sign\-off and one that comes back to haunt you three weeks before tapeout. You understand that static timing analysis is not just about running PrimeTime, it is about understanding what the silicon will actually do when variation, IR drop, temperature, and aging all hit at once. You have debugged enough false paths and multi\-cycle exceptions to know when a constraint deck is solid and when it is held together with hope. You are equally comfortable sitting with an R\&D architect discussing distributed STA algorithms and walking a customer's design team through a HyperGrid deployment that just cut their runtime by 40%. When a strategic account hits a blocker two weeks before their signoff milestone, you are the person they call because you will find the path through, whether that means a creative workaround, a targeted fix, or a hard conversation about what is actually achievable. You do not just react to problems, you see them coming. You connect dots between what customers are struggling with today and what the product roadmap needs to solve tomorrow. At Synopsys, you will shape the future of timing signoff for the designs that power everything from data centers to mobile devices. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Drive production deployment of PrimeTime capabilities including HyperGrid distributed STA, native IR\-aware timing analysis, thermal\-aware signoff, aging analysis, and multi\-die timing closure at strategic semiconductor customers * Lead direct technical engagements with design teams at leading\-edge accounts, translating their advanced\-node challenges into concrete product requirements, deployment strategies, and success metrics * Partner with R\&D teams to evaluate new architectures like cloud\-native PrimeTime and AI\-assisted constraint generation, validating functionality, identifying performance bottlenecks, and driving resolution of complex product issues * Own beta programs and pre\-production evaluations from kickoff through production readiness, defining test plans, tracking results, and ensuring customer success criteria are met * Resolve critical customer escalations through structured root\-cause analysis, building effective workarounds when needed and driving long\-term fixes back into the product * Translate deployment experience, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into clear roadmap recommendations for Product Management and engineering leadership * Create technical content including deployment guides, best\-practice methodologies, executive briefings, and training materials that accelerate adoption across the field organization and customer base ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Enable customers to achieve timing signoff on designs that would otherwise miss their tapeout windows, directly affecting product launch schedules for chips powering AI, automotive, and mobile applications * Shape the PrimeTime roadmap by connecting real customer pain points with engineering priorities, ensuring development resources focus on capabilities that will drive the most adoption * Accelerate time\-to\-production for next\-generation capabilities like ML\-based corner optimization and automated SDC generation, turning research concepts into deployed solutions * Build reusable deployment methodologies that scale across the customer base, turning one successful engagement into a repeatable playbook * Strengthen Synopsys competitive position in timing signoff by ensuring customers see measurable value from advanced features before competitors can catch up * Mentor Application and Product Engineers across the organization, raising the technical bar and building institutional knowledge around complex signoff challenges * Influence the architecture of future PrimeTime releases by representing real\-world deployment constraints and customer workflows in early design discussions ### **What You'll Need** * BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline * Deep hands\-on experience with PrimeTime or comparable timing signoff tools across multiple production tapeouts, including multi\-corner multi\-mode analysis, variation modeling, and advanced\-node signoff challenges * Strong understanding of static timing analysis fundamentals including setup/hold analysis, clock domain crossing, false paths, multi\-cycle paths, and constraint methodology * Proficiency in Tcl and Python for automation, analysis, and debugging of complex timing scenarios * Track record of solving hard technical problems in EDA, ASIC/SoC design, or physical implementation environments where the answer was not obvious and the stakes were high * Experience with distributed computing, cloud infrastructure, or HyperGrid technologies is a strong plus * Background deploying new EDA technologies at semiconductor companies, including managing beta programs, customer training, or production readiness activities is highly valued ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a room where a customer's timing closure is stuck and within an hour identify whether the issue is in their constraints, their methodology, the tool, or their design, and you know how to have that conversation without pointing fingers * When R\&D proposes a new algorithm, you immediately think about how it will behave on a real customer design with 500 modes, 200 corners, and a constraint deck that has evolved over three years * You write Tcl and Python that other engineers can actually read and modify six months later, because you know that one\-off scripts become production infrastructure * You can explain a complex timing analysis tradeoff to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance, and you can turn around and debug a multi\-threaded race condition with an engineer the next hour * When you commit to a customer delivery date or an internal milestone, people know it will happen because you build in contingency and you escalate early when something is at risk * You push back when a product plan does not account for real deployment complexity, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward rather than shutting it down ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join the PrimeTime Product Engineering team, working at the intersection of R\&D, Product Management, and customer\-facing Application Engineering. This team drives the technical strategy and production readiness for Synopsys timing signoff solutions, which are used by every major semiconductor company to sign off chips ranging from mobile processors to data center accelerators. Your work will directly influence both the product roadmap and how customers deploy PrimeTime across their most critical design programs. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)** Location: New York City \| In\-office **The Mission** =============== *“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”* Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems. Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people. **The Opportunity: Build the Product End to End** ================================================= As our Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you’ll build the application layer around Taxo’s AI agents. You’ll work across interfaces, application services, and product data, turning complex healthcare workflows into software that people can use every day. You’ll independently own features from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and production operation, building on shared healthcare services and connectors owned by the platform and Healthcare Intelligence teams. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Ship End to End:** Independently design, build, and ship end\-to\-end features for healthcare teams, from clear interfaces to the services and data models behind them. * **Connect the Workflow:** Develop application APIs and product workflows that use shared healthcare services and connectors to support scheduling, intake, and other operational workflows. * **Practice Product Engineering:** Turn product requirements and customer feedback into practical technical designs and shipped software. * **Build for Reliability:** Improve performance, reliability, and observability across the application and its external dependencies. Build secure sensitive\-data handling, access controls, and auditability into the product. * **Set the Standard:** Write tests, strengthen CI/CD, and make releases easier to validate and operate. * **Shape the Architecture:** Collaborate with voice AI engineers and product colleagues, review code, and help the team make sound architectural decisions. **The Stack** ============= We move fast with a modern toolkit: * **Frontend:** React, Next.js * **Backend:** Node.js (TypeScript) * **Data \& Infrastructure:** PostgreSQL, AWS * **Intelligence:** LLMs and Voice AI integration **Who You Are** =============== * **The Builder:** A track record of independently owning production web applications across frontend and backend systems, from technical design through launch and ongoing operation. * **The Full Stack Engineer:** Strong TypeScript and JavaScript skills, with hands\-on experience in React or Next.js and Node.js. * **The Systems Thinker:** Practical knowledge of relational databases, API design, authentication, authorization, and external integrations, with experience handling sensitive data securely and building auditable systems. * **The Problem Solver:** The ability to investigate production issues and balance speed with maintainability and testing. * **The Product Partner:** Product\-minded judgment and a habit of following a feature through to its impact on users. * **The Owner:** Clear communication and comfort making progress when requirements are still evolving. * **Bonus:** Experience with LLM\-powered products, voice AI, EHR integrations, or building an early\-stage product into a reliable production system. **Why Taxo** ============ Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible. * **Practical AI Work:** Build the interfaces and systems that turn AI capabilities into useful healthcare products. * **Impact That Matters:** Make it easier for healthcare teams to complete the administrative work around patient care. * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Work across the stack and see your decisions reach users, from the first release onward. **Compensation** ================ Base salary: $170,000–$210,000 USD annually Equity: 0\.15%–0\.40% Benefits: Health coverage **How We Work** =============== Taxo is a small, fast, high\-conviction team. We care deeply about the problem, move with urgency, and take ownership of the work. We collaborate closely, make practical decisions, and keep improving through what we learn from customers. If you want to build a healthcare AI product from the interface down to the infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.
