jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Domain Knowledge
jobs.description: **Our company** At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. **What You’ll Do** We are seeking a Principal Engineer , Domian Knowledge, to define and build the next generation of enterprise\-scale data discovery, inventory, and metadata management capabilities across many verticals, such as Finance, Healthcare, etc. This is a highly strategic and hands\-on technical leadership role for an industry\-recognized expert who has successfully designed and deployed large\-scale data catalog platforms across complex enterprises. You will own the architecture, engineering, and evolution of systems that enable employees, analysts, data scientists, AI agents, and business users to discover, understand, trust, and govern data assets across the organization. Think of this role as building and operating the enterprise's "library index" or "parts catalog" for data, where every dataset, table, document, API, feature, metric, model, and knowledge asset can be found, understood, and evaluated for use. You will own the strategy and technical execution of Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine Domain Knowledge — developing enterprise\-leading capabilities to extract, curate, and continuously evolve structured metadata and business context supported by Teradata’s industry knowledge models to serve as a governed layer powering both human analyst acceleration and AI agent grounding. This role combines deep product thinking with ecosystem and platform leadership, spanning the full lifecycle from knowledge acquisition and curation to runtime delivery and continuous improvement. The Context Engine integrates robust database and catalog connectivity, intelligent query parsing, and Teradata's decades of industry knowledge — particularly in highly regulated enterprises — into a curated, continuously improving context layer. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent\-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non\-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in metadata management, distributed systems, data platforms, search and indexing technologies, governance, lineage, and data quality with a passion for creating exceptional discovery experiences at enterprise scale. Data Discovery \& Inventory Leadership * Design and build enterprise\-wide data catalog and metadata platforms that continuously discover, inventory, classify, and organize data assets. * Create systems that automatically scan and ingest metadata from databases, data lakes, warehouses, streaming platforms, APIs, BI tools, AI platforms, and SaaS applications. * Drive the vision for making organizational data as discoverable as products in an e\-commerce catalog or books in a modern library system. * Establish a unified metadata strategy spanning structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data assets. Search, Indexing \& Retrieval * Architect highly scalable metadata indexing and search systems supporting millions to billions of metadata entities. * Design semantic search, keyword search, metadata search, faceted navigation, and relevance\-ranking capabilities. * Leverage graph technologies, vector search, embeddings, and knowledge representations to improve discoverability. * Build intelligent recommendation systems that help users identify trusted and relevant data assets. Metadata \& Knowledge Engineering * Lead development of metadata models, business glossaries, taxonomies, ontologies, and enterprise information architectures. * Establish standards for technical, business, operational, and governance metadata. * Design lineage capture and metadata synchronization frameworks across heterogeneous ecosystems. * Build metadata knowledge graphs connecting datasets, pipelines, dashboards, reports, AI models, metrics, owners, and business domains. Trust, Governance \& Data Quality * Integrate data quality, stewardship, ownership, compliance, and governance indicators into catalog experiences. * Create mechanisms for trust scoring, certification, usage analytics, freshness monitoring, and policy enforcement. * Partner with governance, compliance, privacy, and security organizations to ensure catalog accuracy and regulatory alignment. * Drive enterprise\-wide adoptio anguage models * RAG architectures * Agentic workflows * Metadata enrichment using AI * Semantic retrieval systems * AI\-powered recommendations What Distinguished Candidates Demonstrate * Recognized leadership in the metadata, catalog, search, or knowledge management domains. * Experience building enterprise\-wide data discovery platforms adopted by tens of thousands of users. * Proven experience delivering knowledge management systems in on\-prem, regulated, sovereign and air\-gapped environments * Demonstrated ability to scale metadata systems across large, globally distributed organizations. * Strong product thinking around discoverability, trust, usability, and developer experience. * Ability to bridge data engineering, governance, AI, and business stakeholder communities. * History of driving transformational initiatives from concept through broad enterprise adoption. Success Metrics Within the first 12\-18 months, this leader will: * Deliver a unified enterprise inventory of critical data assets. * Improve discoverability and reuse of trusted datasets across business domains. * Increase metadata completeness, ownership coverage, and lineage visibility. * Enable AI\-assisted data discovery and self\-service analytics experiences. * Reduce time\-to\-find and time\-to\-trust for enterprise data assets. * Establish a scalable metadata foundation powering governance, analytics, and AI across the organization. **Why We Think You'll Love Teradata** We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. jobs.title: Business Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About** **Tia** ----------------- Tia is building a new model for women's healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in\-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike. **About the Role** ------------------ At Tia, our business teams support the people, processes, and systems that make women's healthcare possible. From credentialing providers to supporting clinic operations, too much of their time goes toward repetitive tasks, moving information between systems, tracking paperwork, and rebuilding reports. As our Business Automation Engineer, you'll help teams spend more time on the work that needs their expertise. You'll partner with People Operations, Credentialing, Clinical Operations, Data, Product, Business Analytics, and other teams to understand their workflows and build practical solutions using automation, AI, and code. You'll work with your manager to define problems and priorities, then own projects from discovery through launch and ongoing maintenance. Product partners will support architecture and data decisions. As your portfolio grows, you'll keep workflows reliable and adapt them as Tia's needs change. This role offers the opportunity to apply emerging technology to real business problems and make a measurable difference in how Tia operates. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Understand and improve business processes** * Work directly with teams to understand how work gets done, including exceptions, workarounds, and handoffs. * Map workflows and identify where human judgment is essential and where automation can reduce repetitive work. * Partner with your manager to define project scope, priorities, and measures of success. **Build practical, reliable solutions** * Design and build workflows using n8n or similar automation platforms, AI tools, and Python or JavaScript/Node.js. * Connect systems through APIs, webhooks, and other integrations. * Choose the simplest effective solution, whether that is a spreadsheet improvement, standard automation, or an AI\-assisted workflow. * Test normal operations and edge cases, and build in error handling, logging, alerts, and appropriate human review. **Own workflows after launch** * Monitor performance, troubleshoot failures, and update workflows as systems, policies, and business needs change. * Follow Tia's security, access, and AI governance controls when working with sensitive employee, business, or patient\-related information. * Maintain clear documentation so others can understand, review, and support your work. **Help teams adopt and sustain improvements** * Involve teams throughout discovery, design, and rollout. * Explain technical decisions in plain language and train teams to use their workflows. * Enable teams to make appropriate adjustments independently, with clear guidance on when technical support is needed. **Measure impact and share learning** * Establish baselines and measure time saved, accuracy, reliability, and adoption after launch. * Report results honestly, including limitations and approaches that did not work. * Partner with Product to transition solutions that could become part of Tia's products. * Evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and recommend where they can improve business operations. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** We value the quality of what you've built and how you approach problems. Candidates who demonstrate these capabilities through research or independent projects are encouraged to apply, even without traditional professional experience. * 1\+ year of relevant experience in workflow automation, software development, systems integration, or technical operations, or equivalent hands\-on experience through internships, research, or substantial independent projects. * Experience leading a substantial project from an unclear starting point to a working solution. * Hands\-on experience building and troubleshooting workflows in n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato, or a jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0\-to\-1 ideas to scaled deployments. **About You** ------------- * **Builder with an AI operator's instinct.** You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing. * **Domain\-immersed.** You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build. * **High\-agency in ambiguity.** Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half\-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec. * **Sweat both ends of the stack.** You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer\-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug. **You Will** ------------ * Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate. * Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub\-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and the orchestration that ties them together. * Own evaluation as a first\-class discipline—datasets from real traces, rubrics and graders, experiments, and improvements you can prove move the needle. * Architect the data, services, and APIs the agent layer depends on—integrating our internal systems with customers' WMS, TMS, and ERP environments. * Codify repeatable deployment patterns so each new customer rollout is faster than the last. **You Have** ------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering, with 1\+ year shipping LLM\- or agent\-based features into production. * Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable designing APIs, distributed systems, and data models in PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on with the modern agent stack: production\-scale prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs. * A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI\-agent, forward\-deployed, or data\-product company. * Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon. **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Security Ontology
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. In this role, you will lead a team of data engineers and software engineers responsible for building, scaling, and operating the foundational knowledge systems that enable AI agents to understand security context, reason across products, maintain persistent knowledge, and power intelligent security experiences. You will own the execution of the Ontology engineering roadmap, translating platform strategy and architectural direction into production\-grade capabilities. You will work closely with Product, Architecture, Data Platform, Security Research, and AI/ML teams to establish shared semantic models, integrate data across security products, and deliver scalable services that enable agentic security workflows. This is a **technical leadership and delivery role** requiring strong engineering skills, the ability to lead complex cross\-team initiatives, and a track record of building high\-performing engineering teams. You will guide architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, manage execution and dependencies, and ensure the platform delivers measurable business value at scale. **Key Responsibilities** **Engineering Leadership \& Delivery** * Lead, grow, and develop a team of data engineers and software engineers responsible for the Security Ontology platform. * Own the end\-to\-end delivery of the Ontology engineering roadmap, from technical planning and prioritization through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operations. * Translate product and platform strategy into clear engineering objectives, milestones, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. * Establish effective engineering processes, development standards, code quality practices, and delivery metrics. * Drive execution across multiple workstreams, proactively managing dependencies, technical risks, resource allocation, and delivery commitments. * Build a culture of ownership, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. * Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers, develop technical talent, and build a scalable organization capable of supporting the platform's long\-term growth. Balance near\-term product delivery with foundational investments in architecture, reliability, performance, and developer productivity. * **Security Ontology \& Semantic Modeling** * Lead the development of a shared security ontology spanning endpoint, identity, cloud, network, email, threat intelligence, and other security domains. * Establish canonical entities, relationships, attributes, semantic contracts, and domain modeling standards across security products. * Drive ontology versioning, evolution, governance, and interoperability practices that support independent product development without fragmenting the shared knowledge model. * Lead the definition and implementation of reusable patterns for mapping product\-specific schemas into the common semantic model. * Deliver capabilities for entity resolution, relationship discovery, provenance, confidence scoring, and cross\-product correlation. Partner with product engineering teams to onboard new security domains and evolve existing integrations as product schemas and capabilities change. * **Knowledge Graph \& Ontology Services** * Lead the design, implementation, and scaling of the Security Knowledge Graph and its supporting services. * Deliver a production\-grade **Ontology API and services layer** that provides consistent semantic access to security knowledge for applications and AI agents. * Drive the implementation of entity resolution, context retrieval, graph traversal, semantic search, knowledge enrichment, and reasoning capabilities. * Define service abstractions that decouple applications and agents from underlying storage technologies and implementation details. * Evaluate and guide the adoption of graph, vector, relational, and hybrid storage technologies based on scale, performance, reliability, and operational requirements. * Establish service\-level objectives and engineering practices for availability, latency, throughput, data consistency, and operational observability. Continuously improve platform scalability and cost efficiency as data volumes, product integrations, and agent workloads grow. * **AI Memory \& Agentic Knowledge Integration** * Lead the engineering work required to integrate the Security Ontology and Knowledge Graph with AI agent memory and orchestration systems. * Establish clear boundaries between shared ontolo oint security / EDR. * Identity security / IAM. * Cloud security. * Network security. * SIEM and security analytics. * Vulnerability management. * Threat intelligence. Incident detection and response. * Understanding how entities and events connect across security domains is particularly valuable, for example: **Identity Device Process Network Connection Threat Incident** Experience integrating data across multiple security products or building a shared security data model is a strong advantage. **What Success Looks Like** In the first 12–18 months, you will lead the team in delivering the following outcomes: * **A production\-ready Security Ontology:** A shared, governed semantic model connecting entities, relationships, and security context across multiple Vision One products. * **A scalable Knowledge Graph:** A reliable, high\-performance foundation for representing and querying security relationships across growing data volumes and domains. * **A production\-grade Ontology API and services layer:** Consistent, secure, and observable semantic access for applications, platform services, and AI agents. * **Repeatable product onboarding:** Standardized ingestion, schema mapping, entity resolution, and knowledge\-publishing workflows that reduce the time and effort required to integrate new products. * **Cross\-product entity resolution:** Reliable identification and correlation of security entities and relationships across siloed product data. * **Agent\-ready knowledge and memory integration:** Reusable services that allow AI agents to retrieve contextual knowledge, leverage investigation history, and safely enrich shared knowledge. * **Enterprise\-grade data integrity and governance:** Clear ownership, provenance, freshness, access controls, versioning, and quality standards across the knowledge lifecycle. * **Measurable scalability and operational maturity:** Defined service\-level objectives, performance and capacity benchmarks, production observability, and controlled infrastructure costs. * **A high\-performing engineering team:** Clear ownership, strong technical leadership, predictable execution, and the engineering capacity to scale platform capabilities and product integrations. * **Accelerated delivery of agentic security capabilities:** A reusable knowledge foundation that enables richer cross\-product investigations, contextual threat analysis, and autonomous security workflows. **What We Offer You:** You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family. * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance * Life insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Pre\-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave * Mental Health Wellness Program * Adoption Assistance * Wellness Incentive * Pet Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off * 14 Annual Holidays * Tuition Assistance Employee Resource Groups * We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. ***Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.*** \#LI\-JL At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.description: **\*\*\*\* W2 ONLY \- NO C2C \- NO VISA SPONSORSHIP AVAILABLE \*\*\*\*** ======================================================================== **Senior Java Developer \- Spring Boot, Microservices \& Multithreading (W2 ONLY)** =================================================================================== **Location:** Englewood Cliffs, NJ **Duration:** Long\-Term, Ongoing Contract **Experience:** 8\+ Years **Position Type:** Contract **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid \- 3 days a week onsite ### **About the Opportunity** We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Java Developer** to join the engineering team of a leading media and technology organization. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in **Core Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, multithreading, and high\-performance backend application development**. This role involves designing, developing, and optimizing scalable, reliable, and high\-throughput backend services supporting complex, data\-intensive enterprise applications. We are looking for a technically strong, hands\-on engineer who understands Java internals, concurrent programming, distributed systems, and production\-level performance optimization. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. * Build scalable, resilient microservices and RESTful APIs. * Develop and optimize multithreaded and concurrent Java applications. * Implement efficient asynchronous processing and parallel execution mechanisms. * Design backend services capable of processing large volumes of data with low latency and high throughput. * Apply distributed systems principles to ensure application scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance. * Optimize application performance, memory utilization, JVM behavior, and database interactions. * Troubleshoot complex production issues involving concurrency, thread contention, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks. * Collaborate with architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. * Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested production\-quality code. ### **Required Technical Skills** **Core Java \& Concurrency** * 8\+ years of professional Java development experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with Java 11/17/21 or newer. * Excellent understanding of Java collections, generics, streams, and functional programming. * Deep knowledge of multithreading, concurrency, synchronization, and thread safety. * Experience with ExecutorService, CompletableFuture, thread pools, concurrent collections, and asynchronous programming. * Strong understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, memory management, and performance tuning. **Spring Boot \& Microservices** * Extensive hands\-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem. * Proven experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications. * Strong knowledge of REST APIs, service\-to\-service communication, and API design. * Understanding of distributed transactions, resilience patterns, circuit breakers, retries, and fault tolerance. * Experience building scalable, highly available backend services. **Performance \& Distributed Systems** * Experience developing high\-throughput, low\-latency applications. * Strong understanding of concurrent processing, asynchronous workflows, and event\-driven architectures. * Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. * Experience with distributed caching, messaging, and data processing systems. * Strong debugging, profiling, and production troubleshooting skills. **Databases \& Development Tools** * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL. * Experience with database query optimization and performance tuning. * Proficiency with Git, Maven/Gradle, and automated testing frameworks. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software engineering practices. ### **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience with market data, financial data, real\-time data feeds, or other data\-intensive platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Kafka or similar event\-streaming technologies. * Experience with Redis or other distributed caching solutions. * Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms such as AWS. * Experience with reactive programming frameworks. * Understanding of messaging systems, event processing, and data ingestion pipelines. * Experience building systems requiring high availability, low latency, and continuous data processing. ### **What We//'re Looking For** This is a **hands\-on senior engineering position**, not primarily a team management or coordination role. The successful candidate should be comfortable: * Writing complex Java code independently. * Designing and troubleshooting multithreaded applications. * Explaining concurrency concepts and their practical implementation. * Building production\-grade Spring Boot microservices. * Solving complex performance and scalability challenges. * Understanding architectural trade\-offs in distributed systems. * Taking technical ownership of backend components from design through production. **Candidates with strong Core Java fundamentals, practical multithreading experience, and deep Spring Boot/microservices expertise will be prioritized.**

jobs.title: Data Engineer, JR
jobs.description: Location Chantilly, Virginia Category Engineering, Technology, \& Science Job Type Full time Job Id R2128783 Posted Date 08/24/2026 **Title:** Data Engineer, JR KBR is seeking a Data Engineer to support one of our government customers in Reston, Virginia. The Data Engineer utilizes a diverse range of data\-focused skills, experience, deep technical and analytical problem solving, and team\-centered solutioning for complex problems to satisfy priority information enabling operations. This position requires strong attributes for problem solving, data analysis, troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and experimentation, often under time sensitive decisions. **Data Engineer, Jr Key Requirements*** The Junior Data Engineer provides Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) support to our government customer. * Support the collection, integration, validation, maintenance, and analysis of mission\-relevant data used to inform space and counterspace intelligence operations. * Develop and maintains data workflows, automation solutions, and reporting products that enable efficient management of large and diverse datasets. * The data Engineer works with government personnel, mission partners, and technical teams to ensure data quality, accessibility, and operational effectiveness. * Contribute to mission planning, collection management, and data\-driven analysis in support of national security objectives. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Support the collection, processing, validation, and maintenance of large datasets used in space and counterspace mission activities. * Develop and maintain automated workflows, scripts, and processes to collect, transform, integrate, and manage data from multiple sources. * Analyze RF, signals, collection, and other technical data to identify patterns, trends, and mission\-relevant insights. * Assist in integrating disparate datasets and establishing data quality standards, governance practices, and data management procedures. * Testing and validation of dashboards, reports, visualizations, and other data products that support operational analysis and decision\-making. * Support collection management activities by tracking requirements, monitoring tasking, and aligning data efforts with mission priorities. * Maintain databases, data repositories, and associated documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with program requirements. * Provide technical support for mission planning, operational reporting, and readiness assessment activities. * Collaborate with government stakeholders and mission partners to support data\-driven initiatives and operational objectives. **Required Qualifications:** * Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 0 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, intelligence operations, collection management, RF analysis, or a related technical field. * Experience managing, validating, maintaining, or analyzing large datasets in operational, intelligence, or mission\-focused environments. * Experience with data analysis, scripting, and database technologies, including Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools. * Active Top\-Secret/SCI clearance with Poly **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other government operational missions. * Knowledge of RF collection systems, signals analysis methodologies, collection management processes, or mission planning activities. **Basic Compensation:** 95,200 \- $119,000 **This range KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value\-added services, and long\-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. above * Experience with astrodynamics propagation methods, including special and general perturbation models * Strong foundation in celestial/terrestrial frame transformations, measurement models, capture residuals and dentify/characterize anomalies and outliers. * Experience with scripting languages Matlab, Python, Bash **Desired:** * Experience with astrodynamics libraries like Orekit, DevSecOps methodologies * Experience with Log Management and Analytics tools * Experience with Test Driven Development * Experience or knowledge of Service\-Mesh, such as Istio **Basic Compensation: Must have 3 years of experience in each of the following: * Designing schemas, writing optimized queries, and supporting large\-scale transactional and analytical workloads using Relational Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL); * Managing deployments, automation scripting, and troubleshooting in Unix and Linux environments; and * Integrating software components and enabling secure communication between systems through Web Services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) as part of enterprise solutions. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Analytics Engineer Hybrid (USA Remote)
jobs.description: **Company Description** When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are. Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education. Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines. **Job Description** The purpose of this role is to bridge the gap between complex data infrastructure and actionable business strategy. You will provide day\-to\-day support to Revenue Operations (RevOps), including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience leaders. We are currently in an exciting transition, migrating our data workflows from Alteryx to dbt. As a BI Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of data engineering and business analysis. You aren't just a "dashboard builder"; you are an Analytics Engineer who builds robust data models in Redshift, orchestrates workflows via Dagster/Airflow, and works directly with stakeholders to translate technical outputs into business impact. Crucially, you will help us move beyond standard reporting. We are looking for someone genuinely excited about the frontier of AI and LLM capabilities, helping us integrate predictive analytics and machine learning (via Amazon SageMaker) into the RevOps ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities and Outputs** * Data Modeling \& Migration: Lead the migration of legacy workflows from Alteryx to dbt, ensuring high\-quality, documented, and tested data models that serve as a single source of truth. * Orchestration \& Pipelines: Manage and monitor data pipelines using Dagster or Airflow to ensure reliability and performance within our Redshift warehouse. * Stakeholder Collaboration \& Translation: Act as the primary liaison between technical data structures and non\-technical leaders. You will translate complex "data speak" into clear insights that highlight ROI and business impact. * AI \& Advanced Analytics: Actively explore and implement AI/LLM capabilities to enhance data discovery and predictive modeling. Collaborate with Product/Engineering to apply Machine Learning (SageMaker) to areas like churn prediction and lead scoring. * RevOps Strategy: Support high\-impact initiatives such as Account Based Marketing (ABM) and Customer Health scoring by providing visibility into globally symbols KPIs via Tableau. **Proven Characteristics for Success** * The "Technical Translator": You can explain a join or a latent variable to a Sales Director in a way that makes sense for their quota. * Impact\-Focused: You don't just deliver data; you deliver the "so what?" * AI Enthusiast: You stay up to date with the latest in LLMs and are constantly thinking about how to apply generative AI to analytics workflows. * Curiosity \& Ownership: You lead with questions and take pride in the "cleanliness" and architecture of your code. **Qualifications** **Essential** * Experience: 5\+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related data role. * dbt Expertise: Proven experience building and maintaining production\-grade data models using dbt. * Orchestration Tools: Hands\-on experience with Dagster or Airflow. * SQL \& Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills and experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake/BigQuery). * BI Visualization: Experience building stakeholder\-facing dashboards in Tableau. * CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce data structures. **Preferred** * Alteryx: Experience with Alteryx (highly beneficial for supporting our migration to dbt). * AI/ML: Experience with Python and a strong interest (or portfolio) in LLM applications and Machine Learning (Amazon SageMaker). * Advanced Tableau: Building advanced dashboards and experience with Tableau Online/Server. * Data Modeling: Salesforce\-specific data modeling experience. * Big Data: Experience dealing with large (\+1M rows) customer engagement datasets. **Additional Information** The **expected annual base salary range** for this position is: **$84,225/year** to **$140,375/year**. This position is bonus eligible / commission\-based. Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job\-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered. **Total Rewards @ Turnitin** At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work. Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates. In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. **Our Mission** is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes. **Our Values** underpin everything we do. * **Customer Centric:** Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do. * **Passion for Learning:** We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe. * **Integrity:** Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors. * **Action \& Ownership:** We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard. * **One Team:** We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes. * **Global Mindset:** We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world. **Global Benefits** * Remote First Culture * Health Care Coverage * Education Reimbursement\*Competitive Paid Time Off * Self\-Care Days * National Holidays * 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed * Paid Volunteer Time Off * Charitable Contribution Match * Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement * Access to Employee Assistance Program (mental health platform) * Parental Leave * Retirement Plan with match/contribution **Seeing Beyond the Job Ad** At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team! Turnitin, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer\- vets/disabled.

jobs.title: Product Analyst, AI Solutions
jobs.description: Product Analyst, AI Solutions The Product Analyst, AI Solutions is responsible for shaping, optimizing, and maintaining advanced AI\-driven features and user experiences within our product suite. This role sits at the intersection of business analysis, AI tuning, and user experience—combining expertise in software requirements gathering, prompt engineering, and AI model evaluation. The Analyst is heavily focused on refining how AI systems behave in real\-world scenarios, ensuring outputs are accurate, trustworthy, and closely aligned with client needs. You partner with AI Engineers, Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, QA, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to extract user requirements, translate those into actionable User Stories and evaluation metrics, and continuously tune AI systems for best\-in\-class performance and usability. This role is pivotal in ensuring our AI solutions provide maximum business value, aligning advanced technology with end\-user needs while driving continuous improvement and reliability. The Analyst produces high\-quality deliverables using systematic processes, with impact across multiple projects, deadlines, and teams. Principal Duties AI Tuning \& Output Quality * Design, evaluate, and refine prompts, templates, and conversation flows for reliability, cost effectiveness, and user alignment. * Maintain prompt libraries, track changes, and manage versioning. * Systematically test AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, compliance, and tone, applying rerankers, guardrails, and validation layers to ensure business rules are met. * Collaborate with engineering and QA to promptly integrate feedback and resolve model drift or new scenarios. Requirements Gathering \& Documentation * Proactively gather requirements of moderate scope and complexity from diverse sources (clients, market analysis, SMEs) to drive product development and AI enhancements. * Document software and system requirements, including user stories, program functions, test cases, and steps required for new features or modifications. * Ensure all documentation supports future maintainability and growth of AI\-enabled features. Evaluation, Metrics, \& Continuous Improvement * Establish systematic evaluation frameworks for AI model outputs, leveraging quantitative and qualitative benchmarks. * Run experiments, A/B tests, and structured evaluations to compare tuning strategies and track performance metrics (accuracy, coverage, hallucination rates, latency). * Translate business and user feedback into actionable improvements, owning continuous iteration for released solutions. Collaboration \& UX Alignment * Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring clear, effective communication and alignment. * Work closely with product, development, and UX/UI teams to ensure AI\-driven features fit seamlessly into business workflows, are intuitive and user\-friendly, and meet client needs. * Help shape the overall user experience for AI interactions, promoting explainability and transparency. Education, Experience and Special Skills * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Science, Business, or related field OR equivalent work experience. * 1\+ years’ experience in software, AI/ML, or related product analysis roles. * Experience with AI/ML applications (LLMs, NLP, machine learning pipelines). * Strong understanding of prompt engineering and generative AI interaction design. * Basic knowledge of data modeling, relational database concepts, and SQL. * Familiarity with model evaluation techniques and performance metrics. * Proficiency with Python or JavaScript for prototyping and evaluation. * Experience with Agile SCRUM development processes. * Excellent planning, organization, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functional groups. * Experience in ERP systems, enterprise software, or complex business domains. * Familiarity with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation), embeddings, MLOps, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with fine\-tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), running structured evaluation series, or human\-in\-the\-loop systems.

As a private, family\-owned company, we are committed to remaining independent and building for the long term while continuing our tradition of innovation, exceptional customer service, and lasting value. One of our core technologies is Minimum Quantity Lubrication (MQL). We don't expect you to know what that means today, but if you're curious, explore our website and see if it excites you. With more than 10,000 customers across metal cutting, metal forming, aerospace, and HVAC, we help OEMs and manufacturers solve production challenges through innovative solutions, application expertise, and long\-term customer partnerships. Most importantly, we don't compete on price; we compete by creating real value. **About the Position** Unist is growing, and we're creating a Marketing Manager role to help lead the next stage of growth. Reporting to the Sales and Marketing Director, you'll lead an established in\-house team with strong capabilities in content creation, copywriting, video production, and web design. Beyond driving marketing performance, you'll develop the team, strengthen marketing capabilities, and help position Unist for long\-term growth. We are a B2B manufacturer with a presence across digital, print, trade shows, and industry media. You get to start with a talented team, a strong customer base, and significant market opportunity. From there, you’ll align marketing with business goals, create programs that generate demand and support sales, and ensure the right message reaches the right audience. Marketing at Unist is expected to drive revenue. This role is built for someone who wants that level of ownership, accountability, and impact. **About You** You are a leader, builder, and experimenter. You are creative, and as comfortable with a funnel report as with a storyboard. You can sit with an engineer, understand why a technical product matters, and make that clear to a buyer. You take pride in your team's work, and you care just as much about whether it produces results. You lead by coaching: you give direct feedback, delegate ownership, and answer for the team's results. You stay curious about how things work and continually push to do better. **Key Responsibilities** * Build, lead, and develop a collaborative and high\-performing marketing team. * Work closely with the sales team and other internal groups to turn customer, product, market, and application insight into effective marketing initiatives and sales tools. * Develop programs, content, and campaigns that strengthen customer education, application expertise, and sales effectiveness. * Lead marketing projects from concept through launch and measurement, with clear ownership, priorities, timelines, and follow\-through. * Oversee the development, accuracy, maintenance, and release of product manuals, sales literature, webpages, videos, training resources, product launch materials, and other customer\-facing content, ensuring it is clear, current, useful, and consistent with Unist brand standards. * Manage Unist tradeshows, including scheduling, content creation, sales coordination, and set\-up/tear down (as needed). * Improve marketing processes, project intake, prioritization, documentation, asset management, and cross\-functional handoffs. * Use meaningful measures to evaluate marketing activity and business impact while developing and managing the marketing budget, outside vendors, platforms, and other resources. **What You’ll Need to Be Successful** *Leadership \& Communication* * Clear, direct, and constructive communicator. * Proven coach and delegator who builds trust, ownership, and accountability. * Able to align different perspectives around shared priorities. *Execution \& Judgment* * Strong project management, prioritization, and decision\-making skills. * Highly organized and accountable, with the ability to keep multiple projects moving. * Balances quality, practicality, and pace while taking ownership from start to finish. *Marketing \& Business Acumen* * Connects customer, product, market, and sales insight to practical marketing initiatives. * Ensures technical subjects are understandable and relevant to customers, distributors, and salespeople. * Uses data and business outcomes to evaluate priorities and results. *Mindset \& Values* * Aligned with Unist’s core values and culture. * Innovative, curious, and committed to continuous improvement. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Demonstrated experience leading a marketing team and developing people. * Proven ability to lead marketing projects or campaigns from concept through launch and measurement. * Strong B2B marketing experience; manufacturing or technical\-product experience highly preferred. * Experience with sales literature, product manuals, content strategy, websites, digital marketing, marketing analytics, and sales enablement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Comfortable identifying and implementing CRM, marketing automation, AI\-enabled tools, and other emerging technologies. * Craft CMS experience is a plus. This position includes a competitive wage with great benefits including a 401(k) plan with company match, medical and dental insurance, short/long term disability, life insurance, paid time off, summer flex schedule, Wally Day, Give\-Back Day, parental leave, education and training programs, company picnics and social activities, and a matching gift program. **\*\*NOTE: Indeed makes it too easy to apply. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc (UTFI) invites applications and nominations to fill the position of **Data Engineer.** Reporting to the Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics, the Data Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, monitoring, and optimizing enterprise ETL/data pipeline and data transformation solutions across cloud and on\-premise environments. This position focuses on ensuring reliable and timely movement of data between platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, SFTP environments, and enterprise data warehouse solutions to support operational reporting, analytics, dashboards, and business processes. This role will collaborate closely with BI analysts, CRM administrators, Data Platform teams, and Data Science initiatives to support evolving business requirements, semantic\-layer development, reporting transformations, and analytics\-ready datasets. Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to: **ETL \& Data Pipeline Support:** Implements, monitors, maintains, and troubleshoots enterprise ETL and data pipelines connecting Salesforce, cloud platforms, SFTP environments, Tableau, and enterprise data warehouse solutions. Reruns failed ETL jobs, reporting tables, and scheduled integration processes to keep reporting and operational data available on time. Supports daily data processing and time\-sensitive reporting requirements. Monitors pipeline execution and tunes existing integrations to catch issues early and improve reliability before they affect downstream analytics. **Data Engineering, Transformation \& Semantic Layer Support:** Develops and maintains reporting views, transformation logic, curated datasets, and semantic\-layer objects that power business intelligence and analytics initiatives. Translates business and reporting requirements into reporting\-ready datasets and reusable transformation processes. Creates and updates data warehouse objects, including tables, views, and stored procedures, while onboarding new Salesforce fields and data sources into enterprise reporting environments. Standardizes business logic, KPI calculations, and reporting definitions, and optimizes query and semantic\-layer performance across analytics platforms. **Analytics \& Reporting Support:** Collaborates with BI analysts, CRM administrators, and Data Platform teams to meet reporting, dashboarding, and operational data needs. Prepares and curates datasets that support Data Science, predictive modeling, and AI initiatives. Participates in discussions on business requirements, reporting structures, and analytics solutions. Communicates technical issues, integration impacts, and implementation updates clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and provides troubleshooting support for reporting and data integration issues. **Documentation \& Continuous Improvement:** Maintains technical documentation for ETL pipelines, workflows, transformation logic, semantic\-layer objects, configurations, and support procedures. Follows established standards and best practices for data governance, security, and change management. Researches emerging cloud, ETL, semantic modeling, and data engineering technologies to improve operational efficiency and reporting capabilities. Participates in training and professional development in data engineering, cloud data platforms, and analytics engineering practices. **Required Education and Experience** The candidate who fills the Data Engineer position is required to have:* Bachelor’s degree * 5\+ years of progressively responsible experience in business intelligence, enterprise data engineering, CRM technologies, analytics, business systems, or related technical disciplines. * Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data architecture. * Experience developing enterprise ETL/ELT initiatives. * Experience supporting enterprise CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce. * Experience developing enterprise reporting and analytics solutions. * Experience managing cloud\-based data environments, preferably Fabric and/or Azure A valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record is required due to travel responsibilities of the position. UTFI reserves the right to consider all appropriate circumstances. In general, any significant driving offense less than 12 months old will eliminate the application from consideration for the position. Note \- Candidates holding a graduate degree must have at least 3 years of experience.**Preferred Education and Experience** In addition to meeting the required qualifications, the preferred candidate will have:* Master's degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field . * Experience with enterprise UT systems, including DASH, Marketing Cloud, and Salesforce * Experience leading enterprise cloud modernization initiatives. * Experience with fundraising CRMs. **Application Process:** Priority will be given to applications received on or before October 26th vi a our DASH application system. Applications must include a completed candidate profile, cover letter, resume, and contact information for three professional references. References will not be contacted without explicit permission of the candidate. When determining minimum qualifications, only information entered into the candidate profile can be considered. Please ensure your candidate profile is completed in its entirety as it relates to qualifying education/work experience. Questions about the search may be directed to hr@utfi.org . **Target Start Date:** December 2026 **Benefits:** The Foundation’s greatest asset is our team. Foundation employees are eligible for a comprehensive suite of benefits that includes:* Generous paid leave , accruing up to 24 days of vacation and 12 days of sick leave annually, plus 14 paid holidays and administrative closing days * Flexible work arrangements, offering a hybrid schedule to most team members * Education benefits for employees and their dependents at UT System campuses * Retirement and deferred compensation plans, including 401(k), 403(b), etc. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * Employee discounts to attractions, services, and goods \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **The Foundation:** The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc. is a not\-for\-profit 501(c)3 organization that serves as the preferred channel for private contributions benefiting students and faculty within the UT System. With a vision of being one of the top\-performing advancement organizations in higher education, UTFI is committed to enhancing the educational landscape across the University of Tennessee campuses. **The UT System:** The University of Tennessee System is comprised of campuses at Knoxville, Chattanooga, Pulaski, Martin and the Health Science Center at Memphis; the Institute of Agriculture; and the Institute for Public Service. *The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc. is an EEO/AA/Title VI/Title IX/Section 504/ADA/ADEA employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, and parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law.*

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Ever imagined saying, "I helped launch the future of transportation"? We're rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives \- with no one inside \- powered by our world\-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets. We're live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door\-to\-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you'll feel right at home here. #### **What's happening at Vay** * First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside \& currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World. * We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote\-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy\-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US. * We've completed over 150,000 trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand! * **...And soon we'll be expanding across the US \& Europe** #### ***Why this role is exciting*** At Vay, backend engineering goes far beyond building APIs. We're developing the systems that coordinate vehicles, remote drivers and customers in real time, powering everything from intelligent dispatch and fleet operations to the customer experience. You'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges where reliability, scalability and real\-world impact aren't just engineering principles, they're fundamental to making our service work. As a **Senior Backend Engineer**, you'll have the opportunity to shape the architecture behind a growing mobility platform, take ownership of meaningful technical challenges and see the direct impact of your work on a service operating in the real world. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to push the boundaries of what's possible in mobility, we'd love to have you on board. #### ***What you'll be driving*** * **Design \& Develop:** Build and maintain scalable backend systems that support Vay's growing fleet, customer experience and operational infrastructure, using Go and modern cloud\-native technologies. * **Own End\-to\-End Solutions:** Take ownership of technical solutions from understanding the underlying problem and defining the approach through to implementation, deployment and continuous improvement. * **Shape Technical Architecture:** Influence architectural decisions, evaluate technical trade\-offs and help establish engineering practices that enable our platform to scale reliably. * **Solve Complex Engineering Challenges:** Work at the intersection of software, physical vehicles and operational systems, building reliable solutions to problems that go beyond conventional backend development. * **Drive Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with engineers across infrastructure, embedded software, mobile and product to design solutions that connect our technology and deliver a seamless customer experience. * **Own Quality \& Reliability:** Build maintainable, well\-tested systems, continuously improving performance, reliability and the way we develop and operate our software. #### ***This might be a great fit, if*** * **Strong Backend Engineering Experience:** You've designed, built and operated complex backend systems in production and can confidently explain the architectural decisions, trade\-offs and technical challenges involved. * **Distributed Systems Expertise:** You have practical experience designing scalable, reliable distributed systems and know how to balance performance, complexity and maintainability. * **Sound Technical Judgement:** You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating different approaches and making pragmatic engineering decisions rather than defaulting to familiar technologies or patterns. * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** You enjoy understanding the underlying problem, challenging assumptions and taking responsibility for solutions from initial design through to production. * **Strong Engineering Fundamentals:** You understand how to make thoughtful decisions around system design, data modelling, testing and performance, with a focus on building maintainable, high\-quality software. * **Collaborative Mindset:** You can explain complex technical concepts, constructively challenge ideas and work closely with engineers and stakeholders across different disciplines. * **Technical Proficiency:** You have strong experience with at least one modern backend programming language, such as Go, Java or Python, alongside familiarity with cloud infrastructure, relational databases and event\-driven architectures. * **Real\-World Impact:** You're motivated by solving technically challenging problems and excited to see how your work directly influences a product used by real customers. ##### **Nice to Have:** * **Industry Experience**: Background in Mobility, Logistics, or similar domains. * **Mobile\-First Products**: Experience working on products with a strong mobile integration. * **Additional Tech Stack**: Familiarity with Node.js, gRPC, AWS, Terraform, or NoSQL databases. * **Low\-Level Programming**: Proficiency with C/C\+\+ for performance\-critical components. ##### **Our technology** Our backend is primarily built in Go, supported by cloud\-native infrastructure, relational databases and event\-driven architectures. Experience with Go is valuable, but we're equally interested in engineers with strong backend fundamentals and experience in languages such as Java or Python. We're looking for engineers who understand how to design great systems, not simply those who have worked with a particular set of technologies. #### **Why choose Vay** A global team of smart, motivated people from 30\+ countries who love tackling hard problems and turning bold ideas into reality. Huge scope for impact in a fast paced environment ESOP stock options: A stake in Vay's future – not just a salary. FlexiblePaid Vacation Days 401(k) programme Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance All Vay team members receive 30% off their Vay rides ️‍️ Wellness Hub free gym access \& wellness app subscriptions ️ Exclusive external discounts ✈️ Relocation financial assistance when relocating to Las Vegas Regular team events throughout the year For more information on Vay's physical demands, working environments and safety requirements, you can review this link. We'll also cover anything specific to this role during the first interview. We'd love to stay connected for future opportunities, so feel free to include your LinkedIn profile when you apply. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about shaping something truly groundbreaking, we'd be happy to hear from you. #### **Curious to experience Vay yourself? In Las Vegas? Use the code** ***VAYCANDIDATE*** **for $10 off your first trip in Las Vegas! Download the "Vay" app from the Apple or Google Play store \& off you go!**

across regions. * Establish consistent standards for technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept (POCs), solution design, technical enablement, and reporting on technical engagement and outcomes. * Build a collaborative, accountable, and partner\-focused team culture grounded in continuous technical learning, certification, and knowledge sharing. #### **Partner with Veeam's channel successful partnerships. * Design repeatable, technically validated global and multi\-region offerings, including assessments, workshops, implementation services, and managed services, supported by reference architectures and integration patterns partners can deploy at scale. #### **Build pa ipeline and revenue through technical discovery, demonstrations, POCs, workshops, assessments, and technical co\-selling on priority opportunities. * Align Veeam, Securiti AI, and partner technical teams around priority customers and opportunities, and engage directly on strategic deals. * Lead regular reviews of technical engagements, POC outcomes, win/loss trends, and team performance. * Use win/loss and engagement data to identify technical gaps, target enablement investment, and prioritize the highest\-growth opportunities. ### **How success will be measured** * Technical win rate and conversion of partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced Securiti AI pipeline to revenue. * Securiti AI solutions. * Growth in registered opportunities, new customers, and partner\-led services. * Delivery of technical commitments in joint business plans and alignment with Veeam's channel organization. * Partner and field satisfaction with technical enablement and support, and return on enablement investments. ### **What you'll bring** * At least 10 years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, solution architecture, or technical consulting in enterprise technology, including partner\-facing or channel technical roles. * Significant experience leading and developing teams of solutions engineers or technical specialists in a global, matrixed organization. * A record of building technical partner programs that drive adoption and revenue across regional discovery, solution design, demonstrations, POCs, and technical enablement, with working knowledge of partner\-led selling and pipeline management. * Deep technical expertise in cybersecurity, data jobs.title: Snowflake dbt Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **ABOUT VICTAULIC** Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50\+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real\-world challenges across a wide range of industries. Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high\-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures. **An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation** At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people. **Let's Build a Better World Together.** Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: * We build from within. * We stand behind our people. * We foster an environment for constant learning. * We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. **YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE** We're seeking a skilled Snowflake dbt Developer to join our growing IT team and build the dbt\-based data transformations and Snowflake\-native data applications that power reporting, integrations, and AI. This role will focus primarily on developing and extending our production dbt project across the medallion architecture, building the semantic models that power BI and AI consumption, and delivering user\-facing solutions with Snowflake Streamlit. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on developer with deep expertise in dbt and Snowflake, strong data modeling and SQL skills, a working understanding of data warehousing and lakehouse patterns, and experience building data applications for business users. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD \& OWN** **dbt Transformation Development (50%)** * Develop, test, and maintain dbt models across the silver, gold, and platinum layers of the medallion architecture. * Extend the production dbt project, including migrating remaining legacy transformation logic, such as Qlik Data Integration, into dbt. * Build and maintain semantic\-layer models in the consumption layer to support BI, integration, and AI consumers. * Implement incremental models, snapshots, and materialization strategies optimized for Snowflake performance and cost. * Author dbt tests, including generic, singular, and source freshness tests, and enforce layer contracts, naming conventions, and coding standards. * Maintain dbt documentation, lineage, and exposures so downstream consumers can trust and trace data. * Develop reusable macros and packages to standardize transformation patterns across subject areas. * Participate in pull request reviews and follow the team's GitHub branching and release process for the dbt codebase. * Troubleshoot and resolve dbt model failures, data quality issues, and performance bottlenecks. * Partner with BI analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into well\-structured dbt models. **Snowflake Native Application Development (25%)** * Design and develop interactive data applications using Snowflake Streamlit for self\-service analytics and operational workflows. * Implement data\-driven solutions leveraging Snowflake's native capabilities to enable jobs.description: * 538159 * Blacksburg, Virginia * Electrical and ComputerEngineering * Administrative \& Professional * College of Engineering **Job Description** The Technical and Research Infrastructure Director provides strategic and operational leadership for the Virginia Tech Micro\-/Nanofabrication Cleanroom and Laboratory within the Bradley Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in the College of Engineering. This shared research and education facility supports semiconductor devices, nanophotonics, microelectromechanical systems, quantum technologies, advanced materials, biointerfaces, and emerging devices. Reporting to and working under the guidance of the Faculty Director, the position translates approved scientific and institutional priorities into implementable equipment, engineering, instrumentation, process\-support, data\-acquisition, and facility capabilities. The Director leads the facility's technical roadmap, major equipment programs, infrastructure modernization, engineering standards, configuration control, vendor technical relationships, and integration of validated research capabilities into routine shared\-user operations. The position supervises technical personnel, including the Nanofabrication Process and Integration Engineer, and coordinates activities across the Whittemore Hall Cleanroom, Electron\-Beam Lithography Laboratory, university service units, faculty laboratories, equipment vendors, and approved user projects. The Director also oversees facility budgets, cost\-recovery and user\-fee structures, the laboratory information management and billing platform, external partnerships, and eligible extramural infrastructure\-funding efforts. **Required Qualifications** * Advanced degree in engineering, physical science, applied science, or a related field, or a bachelor's degree with significant relevant professional experience. * Professional experience in semiconductor fabrication, microfabrication, nanofabrication, scientific instrumentation, advanced manufacturing, or research infrastructure. * Experience commissioning, integrating, modifying, troubleshooting, or managing sophisticated equipment. * Experience with vacuum systems, lithography, plasma processing, thin\-film deposition, instrumentation, controls, sensors, networking, laboratory automation, or a comparable technical area. * Experience leading complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders. * Experience with budget or resource\-management responsibilities. * Experience developing technical specifications, procedures, configuration records, or engineering documentation. * Experience supervising, mentoring, or coordinating technical personnel. **Preferred Qualifications** * Doctoral degree in a relevant engineering or physical\-science discipline. * Proven history of progressively responsible technical leadership experience in a university cleanroom, shared\-user facility, semiconductor facility, national laboratory, or advanced industrial research environment. * Experience with advanced fabrication and characterization technologies, such as electron\-beam lithography, plasma etching, atomic\-layer deposition, chemical\-vapor deposition, physical\-vapor deposition, or advanced metrology. * Experience with equipment procurement, commissioning, acceptance testing, vendor coordination, and lifecycle planning. * Experience with laboratory automation, equipment connectivity, data acquisition, industrial networking, or related technologies using platforms such as Python, LabVIEW, programmable logic controllers, OPC Unified Architecture, SECS/GEM, EPICS, or SiLA. * Experience with scientific\-data systems, digital modeling, machine learning, cyber\-physical systems, or automated laboratories. * Experience with facility financial management, cost\-recovery or user\-fee models, laboratory information management systems, or laboratory billing platforms. * Experience with cleanroom or laboratory planning, construction, modernization, or expansion projects, including coordination with architects and contractors. **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Restricted **Salary Information** $121,000–$131,000, Commensurate with Experience **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** 10/23/2026 **Additional Information** The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** problem\-solvers.
